After being shot and left for dead, an injured Numeon was taken prisoner by the Word Bearers. However, his fate was not to remain in chains. Rescue came in the form of an Ultramarines strike force under [b]Aeonid Thiel[/b], who launched a daring assault against the traitors.

notes.title: The Heresy continues in September!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/3b973bccfe53b926c4bc255d857ed1a872b0cbf2.jpg[/img]
[i]"One hundred and seventy-five kills. Biggest haul yet."[/i]
– Endryd Haar

August is now a memory, and a new Warmaster has seized the glory of the ranked ladder! A hearty congratulations to the new Warmaster and the players who guided their decks to the top during the previous season.

Players who achieved a rating of 500 or more in Standard have been rewarded with crates corresponding to their division, with the most substantial prizes reserved for the top 200 worldwide. In addition, all players on Terra will see their rating reset to 2500. Points exceeding 2500 in Standard have transitioned into Legendary Points, while those surpassing 2500 in Legacy have been converted into Legacy Honours.

Claim your rewards and get ready to forge your legend in the heat of battle! Also, keep an eye out for the upcoming meta report!

notes.title: Celebrating a year of growth and evolution in Legions!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/f48a6c1f84ab0d995cf4f6d81c9232e0874e2f0d.jpg[/img]

[b]2024: A Year of Unstoppable Growth in Legions![/b]

[i]"On 2024, Legions has kept growing without any signs of stopping!"[/i] Throughout the year, renewed versions of classic Legions have stormed the battlefields of the Horus Heresy, each boasting new mechanics to translate their unique philosophy of battle to the game. 

We've introduced 6 new factions, more than 30 new Warlords, and over 300 new cards. The migration of the Traitor Auxilia to the Chaos faction has also added a new dynamic to the game. The battlescape never stops changing, and we can’t wait to see how the game continues to evolve in the years ahead.

But for now, please join us in celebrating the memorable year that was, and get ready for your next match, because there is an even more exciting year ahead! [b]What thrilling delights will it bring? Which new faction will fly under your command to claim glory?[/b]

Thank you for playing, and see you next year. [i]"Let the Galaxy burn!"[/i]

Theirs is a culture of predator and prey, of hunt or be hunted, and this expertise in pursuing their quarry has led to the introduction of a new trait: [b]"Hunt"[/b].

Units with [i]“Hunt”[/i] trigger an effect when the hunting unit attacks an enemy, but does not kill them. This aims to represent the Rout's hunter-killer tactics, with Astartes squads hunting as a pack of wolves, hurting an enemy numerous times before delivering the final blow.

notes.title: Balance hotfix: Lotara Sarrin
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/14fd508b214e60b8b61916164ddb79f3f932f6d7.jpg[/img]
[i]"This is New Kershal all over again. Disengage!"[/i]
– Lotara Sarrin

Lotara returned to the battlefields of the Horus Heresy in force, and her initial performance sounded all of the alarms. Even though we have seen in the past how new cards and Warlords have achieved higher-than-average win rates while the meta reacts and players learn how to counter the new challengers, Lotara became a force to be reckoned with. This created a frustrating ladder to take part in, and a repetitive and tiresome competitive environment.

For this reason, today we are releasing an emergency balance hotfix addressing the situation and tweaking the main offenders of Lotara's ranked dominance:

[b]IMPERIAL ARMY[/b]
● [b]Lotara Sarrin[/b]: Changed Savage ability to [i]'Give Flank to adjacent troops'[/i] (it no longer buffs adjacent troops)

[b]MECHANICUM[/b]
● [b]Glaividian Ursarax[/b]: Increased ability cost from 0 to 1 and changed ability to [i]'(1) Stun a random enemy troop'[/i] (instead of a random enemy).

These changes are now live in the game. We will continue to monitor the situation, as well as monitor the rest of the meta in preparation for the next balance update, currently scheduled for the first full week of the next competitive season.

[list]
[*] Alpharius' alternate art can now be used in Standard mode, if you own the new Standard Alpharius card.

notes.title: The Nights Lords are ready to haunt the battlefield
notes.content:
[i]"Night falls. The hunt begins."[/i]
– Konrad Curze

[h1]AVE DOMINUS NOX[/h1]
At the end of light, the shadows grow only larger. The macabre hosts of Konrad Curze are ready to bring the night to the battlefields of the Horus Heresy! The Hidden Dagger expansion for Warhammer Horus Heresy: Legions begins with the release of the new Night Lords collection, featuring fresh new artwork and game mechanics perfect for the murderous VIII Legion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/37743070b31f12fbd7ef17b381081be96919e5e8.jpg[/img]

[h1]NIGHT LORDS WARLORDS[/h1]
Many Night Lords warriors engulfed the Galaxy in terror, but among them, three of their mightiest heroes were chosen to lead the Legion into battle:
[list]
[*][b]Kheron Ophion[/b]: Possessing a sense of honour rare among his Legion, his shield is a constant reminder of his greatest failure.
[*][b]Sevatar[/b]: Arrogant, ruthless and utterly infamous, Sevatar is a living avatar of the VIII Legion’s dark purpose.
[*][b]Konrad Curze[/b]: The feared Primarch of the Night Lords, who brought judgment rather than deliverance to the worlds he claimed.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/f2344d122ccadd815be7cbefdb7ca738cf9544f7.jpg[/img]

[h1]EVISCERATE ENEMY LINES WITH BRUTAL ACTS OF VIOLENCE[/h1]
The Night Lords do not perform clean kills. Their sadistic souls seek to punish their prey with physical and psychological methods before making an example out of any poor soul that stands in their way. Their new Murder trait befits these blood-soaked killers, triggering an effect after defeating an enemy if the damage they dealt in the killing blow is superior to the poor victim’s remaining health.

Unlike Battle Honour, Murder will still trigger even if the troop with Murder dies while attacking. Murder is also not troop-exclusive and can be found on Tactics. Plan your attacks carefully and exploit their new mechanic to get as much value as possible out of your troops!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/b2594882afdae3f9b28ad325448b85b754975b7f.jpg[/img]

[h1]CHECK OUT THE FULL CARD GALLERY[/h1]
Visit the website’s [url=https://www.horusheresylegions.com/card-list-hidden-dagger-expansion/nggallery/hidden-dagger/night-lords]Card Collection[/url] to check the complete collection of incoming cards! From the new Warlords to the new tactics and troops. Take a peek at the full extent of the new Night Lords collection so you know how to master the darkness when the Legion’s release comes tomorrow. Check out the new cards and share your ideas in the #deck-building channel of the [url=https://discord.com/invite/horusheresylegions]official Discord server[/url].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/241252305e4bd191f5135dcd5e2339ba8fe20a5c.jpg[/img]

[h1]A BLACK FRIDAY SPECIAL[/h1]
Get more bang for your buck with the Black Friday special offers and gather the new Night Lords under your banner faster than ever! Find new gold offers with added value, perfect for all the upcoming content in the new expansion.

To celebrate their release, claim an exclusive Night Lords avatar for free! Log into the game during the Black Friday season to receive your reward and imbue your in-game profile with the murderous soul of the VIII Legion.

Preferring to be on the attack, the Space Wolves would not be on Terra when it came to the final siege, a regret that Russ carried with him as the Heresy continued.

notes.title: v3.1.5 Release Notes
notes.content:
A new patch is live, fixing the incorrect behaviour of a few of the new Raven Guard cards and a couple of edge cases and undesired interactions. Take a look at the full list:

● Fixed edge case error which could cause some incorrect interactions (eg. with Fierce Onslaught) in troops that gained First Strike or Sneak Attack on Ambush. 
● Fixed Lunar Eclipse bug so that the correct number of friendly units receive Stealth.
● Fixed Kraa Squad and Contemptor Edagar so that their ability isn't triggered by your Warlord's Ambush.
● Fixed Corvus Corax's wings to represent his Unstoppable trait.
● Matches in Standard mode using an alternate art version of warlords will now count correctly towards Achievements and Warlord stats.
● Improvements to automatically recover when a crate fails to open normally due to a server timeout.
● Fixed Ambush abilities not always triggering when a troop dies from Poison at the start of its turn

notes.title: Become the Gorgon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/99075b90c102204bd2cf8cac11e1d6ed4aa3ccbe.jpg[/img]

[i]"My wrath burns like the molten heart of Medusa."[/i]
– Ferrus Manus

Ferrus Manus marches into this weekend's deal! Become the mighty Gorgon and add his alternate artwork, 10 Iron Hands crates, an exclusive card back, and an exclusive premium avatar to your collection with this weekend's bundle deal! 

To mark the occasion, Ferrus Manus will also be available in the game's shop. Gather the Iron Hands and command them against the so-called brothers who betrayed the Imperium! For the Emperor!

notes.title: New forces join the event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/d13522bde46741786bb6b54c10a32a34e3c1e704.jpg[/img]

[i]"Now we hunt!"[/i]
– Raum

The seemingly unstoppable daemonic horde advances inexorably towards the tear in reality. Aiming to regain some terrain, the loyalists deploy one of the grand Psi-Titans of Ordo Sinister onto the battlefield! Seeing this new threat, the forces of Chaos send forth another abomination in the form of Raum. How will the scales of battle hold?

Fight with the new Warlords that have joined the event as reinforcements and claim victory! Which side will you join?

notes.title: Deliver the wrath of the Omnissiah on your enemies!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/b3d8c5ddf86c4262e2275fd2b4f755c16e991f41.jpg[/img]

[i]"Knowledge bows before nothing."[/i]
– Sota-Nul

Deploy the Paragon of Metal on the battlefield and deliver the wrath of the Omnissiah on your enemies! Take a look at today's shop and find this terrifying engine of war, together with other Mechanicum essentials available.

While each Battle-automata of the Legio Cybernetica is itself a creation of a near-lost age of human power, there remains among them war machines with powers and capabilities far beyond their peers. The Paragon of Metal is counted in this last group, a near-unstoppable engine of war, albeit a machine perhaps not to be trusted even by its master.

notes.title: Blades out, brothers!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/d55a4cfe3eb6dbf732ee9e7675613e0535aabbe9.jpg[/img]

[i]"We will lose this war unless we kill the thing that started it."[/i]
– Meros

The Blood Angels campaign on Signus Prime is now featured in the Campaign Library, freely available for all players for two weeks. Check out the trailer:

[previewyoutube=7IPkfvNj-8U;full][/previewyoutube]
Fight your way through the tarnished plains of Signus Prime, surpass the Warmaster's challenges to discover what lies at the centre of this betrayal, and reap glorious rewards. Blades out, brothers! Learn more about the Campaign Library [url=https://www.horusheresylegions.com/new-campaign-library/ ]here.[/url]

notes.title: The Soulless Queen is back!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/4604a397f5fe50039eaa563f174937662fc2cc4f.jpg[/img]
[i]"We are the light that delivers justice to the wicked."[/i]
– Jenetia Krole

Jenetia Krole, the Soulless Queen unleashes her powers in this weekend's bundle deal! Add the alternate art for the Knight-Commander of the Silent Sisterhood to your collection, together with 10 Sisters of Silence crates, an exclusive card back, and an exclusive premium avatar with this weekend's bundle.

To mark the occasion, Jenetia Krole will also be available in the game's shop. Command the Silent Sisterhood against the dark forces of the traitors and cleanse their warp-tainted stain off the battlefields!

notes.title: Join the fight in the Webway in a new event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/961d58fd1b29bb889b5fe1f668568009865ab8da.jpg[/img]
[i]"Slit throats cannot beg for mercy."[/i]
– Jenetia Krole

The traitor attacks on Terra have opened a breach into the Webway! If unchecked, the forces of the Warmaster would enter realspace right into the heart of the Imperium. Will the Emperor's finest be able to close the breach?

Join the Talons of the Emperor in their fight against the daemonic interlopers, or become part of the hellish invasion and lead the warp-tainted forces against the last bastion of Terra. Which side will you choose?

notes.title: Complete the battlepass missions!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/8c7bb4e53a64f62dedcf19850ae78e6c158fca36.jpg[/img]

[i]"Lay your eyes on me, meet your radiant slayer."[/i]
– Eidolon

Also known as the Exemplar, Eidolon is what all Emperor's Children aim to be. His excellent combat record and overwhelming arrogance combined with his unfailing loyalty to his Primarch, however, led to his fall to Chaos during the Horus Heresy.

Complete the current Premium Reward track and earn an exclusive alternate art version of Eidolon! This month's Battle Pass might be slightly shorter, but it also has a higher count of seasonal missions to get its rewards faster than ever. Lead the Emperor's Children into the battlefield and unleash a perfect whirlwind of pain and sensation!

notes.title: The Ignis Vincit features in today's shop for the first time!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/de14a21e7a7de6d3c627df454264300126d9d423.jpg[/img]
[i]"Victory isn't earned, it's orchestrated."[/i]
– Saul Niborran

Deploy the heaviest imperial tanks on the battlefield and lead a campaign of destruction like no other! The Ignis Vincit features in today's shop for the first time. Don't Miss your chance to add it to your collection!

Crushing debris and anyone foolish enough to get close under their treads, the super-heavy tanks are among the oldest and most extended war engines taken into battle by the Imperial Army, sometimes dating back to the Dark Age of Technology.

To mark the occasion, Corax will also be available in the game's shop. Lead the Raven Guard out of the shadows and into the battlefield to clean the stain of the Isstvan V Atrocities! Victorius aut Mortis!

notes.title: May 2023 balance patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/356b693f9f7492bb3e43b1cb15f0fb6936f28b2a.jpg[/img]

[i]"So excessive. I love it!"[/i]
– Daemon Prince Fulgrim

Fulgrim continues perfecting his craft on the battlefield, dominating the top of the ladder alongside his newcomer brothers, the World Eaters. This balance update brings a few changes aiming to lower both legions' dominance, while also tweaking down one of Malcador's agents.

– Branne Nev

New forces enter the battlefield! While Fulgrim pushes forward in his search to fulfill his desires, Perturabo calls more warriors in to hold back the incoming waves of warriors from the Shattered Legions. Branne Nev and Barban Falk join the event as reinforcements!

The battle does not relent! Fight with the new forces that have just joined the battle to unlock your preferred cosmetic and fill your collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/747fdc8059517096f766b56617749d1080ce5a12.jpg[/img]

How did your favourite Warlord perform this month?

notes.title: Defend Prospero in the featured single-player campaign
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/77bedd08ab46946797ad1ca97e889098141e79a5.jpg[/img]

[i]“Swim into the Great Ocean, brothers.”[/i]
– Phosis T'Kar

The Thousand Sons single-player campaign is back in the spotlight! Check out the Campaign Library to play the Burning of Prospero campaign for free during the following two weeks and beat it to earn the exclusive card back.

Upon learning of Horus’ betrayal, Magnus the Red tried to warn his Father by projecting his astral form to Terra. The Emperor, enraged that Magnus had violated the Edict of Nikaea, dispatched a Censure Host to Prospero to apprehend him. Magnus has decided to accept his punishment and atone for his mistakes, but his sons are not to let that happen.

Check out the campaign trailer!
[previewyoutube=8B163kqzi8I;full][/previewyoutube]

Learn all about the campaign in its [url=https://www.horusheresylegions.com/new-campaign-the-burning-of-prospero/]original announcement post[/url].

notes.title: A new demo of Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge is now live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/0315a6cbc19ca17b76a4a2774515729a8149eeea.jpg[/img]

[i]"Death Wakes, War Calls!"[/i]
– Avatar of Khaine

A new demo of Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge is now live! Check out the new Aeldari army, Craftworld Saim-Hann, and discover the unique mechanics of the Wild Host.

The demo will become available today, April 28th, at 18:00 UTC, and run until Tuesday, May 2nd.

Play now and bring forth Khaine's fire!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1985170/Warhammer_40000_Warpforge/

notes.title: New Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge demo, introducing a brand new army!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/d8f2dcdb24d55c045e527c114aa3ee47837ff8b0.jpg[/img]

[i]"Ready to face the might of the Saim-Hann."[/i]
– Autarch Medreyal Ghaelyn

Get ready for a brand new demo of Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge! To coincide with Warhammer Fest, all players will be able to enjoy the game for a few days and to discover a brand new army - the Aeldari of Craftworld Saim-Hann! 

Prepare your jetbike-riding skills to lead the Wild Host kindreds of Saim-Hann to victory in battle! Renowned for its preference for fast, mobile warfare, this Craftworld commands an array of heavy-hitting vehicle-focused strategies and will make use of its new Shuriken weaponry and Spirit Stones mechanic to get the upper hand in battle.

The demo will become available today, April 28th, at 18:00 UTC, and run until Tuesday, May 2nd. Don't miss this chance to discover a new army and get a head start for when the game is released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1985170/Warhammer_40000_Warpforge/

notes.title: Fight in a new event to achieve daemonhood!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/711c486f46a09e3f82601d2c0ec41cf92d8ffae4.jpg[/img]
[i]"This promises to be a momentous day, brother."[/i]
– Fulgrim

Desiring to ascend to Daemonhood, Fulgrim tricked Perturabo to join him on a mission to Iydris. The plan was to fulfil his goal while the Iron Warriors fought the planet's defenders but, when it was set in motion, a band of Orphans of War struck from the skies.

Choose your side and fight for which new cosmetic avatar will make its way into the game! Will you aid the traitor's mission to unlock the Apotheosis avatar, or side with the Orphans of War and achieve retribution and a Garuda avatar? Log into the game and fight!

notes.title: Seek new thrills in the new Battle Pass
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/8c7bb4e53a64f62dedcf19850ae78e6c158fca36.jpg[/img]
[i]"Let ceramite clash once more!"[/i]
– Eidolon

A new Battle Pass starts today, focused on the new Emperor's Children! Take a look at all the details in the new [url=https://www.horusheresylegions.com/emperors-children-battle-pass/]web post[/url].

Make sure to claim all the rewards you unlocked in the previous Battle Pass and then progress to the new one to gain access to a whole new Reward Track and a new set of seasonal missions. Please note that unlocked rewards from the previous Battle Pass can only be claimed before selecting the option to start a new Battle Pass.

After progressing to the new Battle Pass, all reward points earned from daily and seasonal missions, as well as the weekly challenge, will start counting towards the new reward track, featuring exclusive cosmetic items inspired by the Emperor's Children, as well as cards, in-game currency and more! Purchase the Premium Pass to gain access to an additional reward track and get a whole new array of exclusive rewards, including cosmetics, legendary cards and an amazing new Eidolon alternate art!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/7df25da106e1ee780adee90dc9157787b5674b96.jpg[/img]

Event reinforcements! In a fell swoop, the traitor's influx of troops suddenly stops, as a single-winged figure descends with righteous fury. Sanguinius, the Great Angel, joins the event! Refocusing his efforts on the World Eaters' true objective, Dreagher returns the shell-shocked troops to their rageful selves and rallies them so that the bloodbath may continue. 

The battle continues! Will the loyalists manage to stop the World Eaters or will Angron's Legion continue their offerings to Khorne? Fight to tip the scales of victory!

notes.title: Play the White Scars single-player campaign
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/4e21e847d4ca03ae1a9be359fcdacfebba325418.jpg[/img]
[i]"Here they come, hungry for more battle!"[/i]
– Jaghatai Khan

Find a way to get the White Scars to Terra in the Path of Heaven single-player campaign, now freely available during the next two weeks! Check out the trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-K7ySnsCyaA

Trapped behind the Traitor’s lines early in the Heresy, Jaghatai Khan led his White Scars on several years of hit and run attacks against the Warmaster’s supply lines. As time went by, the 5th Legion realized they were becoming bogged down in battles of attrition, and must return to Terra to stand by their loyalist brothers. notes.title: Incoming changes to Legacy Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/89da85fb0252231946cfbca19065ff3bc1dab8f7.jpg[/img]
Greetings, players!

Following up on the last update's changes, we will soon make some additions and tweaks to Legacy Mode. After reading the feedback received from the release of the last expansion, we will be taking some measures to improve the game mode.

Firstly, in the same manner as Standard Mode, Legacy Mode will count with a Ranked / Unranked toggle. To avoid splitting the player base, players on both Ranked and Unranked will sometimes be matched against one another, but they will only earn or lose ranked points if they entered the battle with the Ranked toggle activated.

At the end of the Season, Legacy Rating will also start acting like in Standard Mode. Players above 2500 Legacy rating will be reset to 2500 rating, and the difference will be added to a new tally of Legendary points.

In this first season change after the update, all players who have a lower ranking on Legacy than Standard will see their Legacy rating raised to match their Standard rating. This is a one-off adjustment. Going forward, the ratings on Standard and Legacy may diverge and won't be adjusted again each season (other than to bring them down to 2500 rating as usual).

These changes will be making their way into the game in a future update.

notes.title: Terror on Thramas
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/f7deb14943b98b3e02dfbe2997f15a4e47eb6944.jpg[/img]

[i]"Darkness falls on Thramas."[/i]
– Sevatar, First Captain

As the loyalists tried to reach Terra to help defend the Imperial Palace, the Night Lords deployed the vast majority of their forces in the Eastern Fringes. In their darkest fashion, they set in motion a savage campaign across the void, staining world after world in red. This seemingly maddened effort was not senseless though, and their truest intentions soon came to light.

notes.title: Update v3.0.2 release notes
notes.content:
Update v3.0.2 is now live for both PC and Mac, with a number of important bug fixes:

[b][u]Missions[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Fix ‘Edit Deck’ mission so that it works with buttons and not only dragging.
[*] Allow using Tybalt Marr for seasonal Sons of Horus missions.
[*] Fix Mission to put Flank troops in play.
[*] Fix Battle Pass points provided by Missions replaced (it was always the same, but can now vary).
[*] Tweak description of some starter Missions to add information on how to complete them.
[*] Update text on Starter pass text, to avoid incorrectly referencing the tutorial.
[/list]

[b][u]Other bug fixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Fix alternare art for Abaddon & Horus, so that they can be used in Legacy mode as previously, and as ‘skins’ for new Sons of Horus warlords in Standard mode.
[*] Fix bug causing some cards to crash the game in certain edge cases (eg. Unshakable Warden, Desperate Defence).
[*] Fix error which caused the Avatar in profile to revert to Aximand after changing decks.
[*] Fix Sentry Turret image not always visible in tutorial.
[*] Fix Daemons created by Kurtha Sedd and Lorgar Transfigured, to use the newly released Lesser and Greater Daemons.
[/list]

[b][u]Interface improvements[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Invulnerable VFX now remains on unit for as long as it has the trait.
[*] Change font color of Chat messages while being auto-translated, to provide instant feedback.
[*] Prevent some unnecessary notifications of new chat preview area.
[*] Increase size of Chat and Action Log buttons in battle.
[*] Display menu animation in Legacy mode even with particles disabled.
[*] Change label of ‘Deck List’ button to ‘Change Deck’.
[/list]

We are taking this extra time to ensure the most (in)famous of all Legions receives the treatment it deserves, and to polish a number of new features that will be released with it.

We apologize for the change in plans, and appreciate everyone's patience. A major announcement will follow soon confirming the definitive release date, and numerous reveals will take place in the days before the expansion.

notes.title: Become a Light in the Shadow with the Ultramarines' campaign!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ms4BimUBYU4;full][/previewyoutube]
"It is easier to forgive an enemy than a brother."
– Remus Ventanus

The Ultramarines campaign arrives to the Campaign Library! Betrayed by the Word Bearers at Calth, take control of Aeonid Thiel, Remus Ventanus and Roboute Guilliman as they race to save the Legion from the treacherous assaults of Daemons and traitor Astartes. Cleanse the Macragge's Honour, and take control of the surface to defeat the Word Bearers!

Relive the brutal attack on the Ultramarines, and how they fought back against their once brother Astartes!

Check out the trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ms4BimUBYU4

Learn all about the campaign in the latest blog post:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/ultramarines-campaign

notes.title: Can you catch the Callidus Assassin?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1482b78457d87598eeb689bf69957ac3cc0a89ba.jpg[/img]
"No one will thank me for completing this mission."
– Callidus Assassin

Flash sale! Fresh with a new set of secret identities, the Callidus Assassin strikes from where least expected. Don't miss your chance to add the legendary Callidus Assassin and her exclusive collector's card back to your collection with today's exclusive deal.

A master of Polymorphine, this dangerous drug allowed the assassin to infiltrate nearly any organization, from the Solar Auxilia to the Legiones Astartes themselves. Prepare to constantly adapt against the ever-changing skills of the Callidus Assassin.

notes.title: Embody the might of the Imperial Fists!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/0b346738367ab570035d36066584b984529dba68.jpg[/img]
"If we fail for an instant, all is lost."
– Rogal Dorn

The recently unlocked badge 'Abiding Ramparts' is in the shop for the first time today! Don't miss the chance to pick up this badge, representing the strength of the Emperor's Praetorians!

While some may call the Imperial Fists inflexible and stubborn, they often played these quirks to their strength. Holding the line longer than any would expect, or pushing forward against the hardest of obstacles, the 7th Legion made a virtue of their tenacity.

notes.title: Discover the Necron armies of Sautekh Dynasty in Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=mHkIWHGMFT4;full][/previewyoutube]
"The last apocalypse forms beneath our feet."
– Iapto, Knight-Errant

An ancient menace awakens, as the Necrons of the Sautekh dynasty are unveiled as one of the starting armies in Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge. 

Check out the new gameplay trailer on Youtube, and join the exclusive demo from 19th to 22nd January!
https://youtu.be/mHkIWHGMFT4

Wishlist the game now hear when the demo starts and stay up to date with all the development news.

notes.title: Moment of Truth event winners
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/7f8ec7687fa12eb1d38101a35def333a024f866e.png[/img]
"Let it be war!"
– Warmaster Horus

The forces battling on Terra have succeeded in staving off the Warmaster's wrath, but for how long? Horus' power keeps growing, threatening to drown the Imperium in flames, but the loyalists stand resolute and ready to do whatever it takes to stop him.

Congratulations to the top lodges in the event! Thanks to the efforts of all participating players, all the raid rewards have now joined the game. Don't forget to claim your event rewards!

notes.title: The Lord of the Flies arrives
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/f9dc1eaf32da05eb02a7a51e314f6f057a041432.jpg[/img]
"You can't kill the rot!"
 – Lord of the Flies

The long awaited Lord of the Flies manifests into this weekend's deal! Do not miss the first ever chance to add this powerful daemonic entity to your collection!  Embrace corruption with a new legendary Warlord, a full deck and an exclusive card back. Only this weekend!

Will you succumb to the swarm and become a harbinger of Nurgle's rot?

notes.title: New Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge demo coming soon!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Anmv8VDKtp4;full][/previewyoutube]
"You'll enjoy this."
– Roboute Guilliman

Big news coming for Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge. Take a look at the teaser trailer on Youtube:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Anmv8VDKtp4

Subscribe to the Youtube channel to hear them first!

Wishlist the game now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1985170

notes.title: Can you harness two Legions to survive The Drop Site Massacre?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/395c543d923267dd59fd636500490b864c5963d5.jpg[/img]
"This is the end."
– Cassian Vaughn

Choose your side and combine the strengths of two factions under the same banner in the new event: The Drop Site Massacre! After the start of the Heresy, many loyalist Legions were deployed on Isstvan V to cut off the traitor's advance before it had truly begun. During this intense clash against their former brothers, choosing their allies wisely became vital to any who hoped to achieve victory.

Pick a Warlord, select an allied faction and draft a deck with cards from both factions! Hone your drafting skills and get ready to discover unexpected card combinations.

Check out all the details in the latest web post:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/the-drop-site-massacre/

notes.title: Flash sale! The Lion has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/bddba3970f9f1745d34f005676c3aae06c2320b9.jpg[/img]
"Men may keep secrets for good reasons."
– Lion El'Jonson, Primarch

Flash sale! Master of the First Legion and Lord of the Dark Angels, Lion El'Jonson's dashing alternate art arrives as a one day special offer! Pick up the Lion's art, voice lines and Dark Angel themed cardback today!

Don't miss the chance to get this alternate artwork as part of a premium deck in a time-limited offer. To mark the occasion, his normal version will also be available in the shop!

notes.title: Harness the might of two Legions!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/72a4eec753ea8a2938ae6ff426b1c1765448f318.jpg[/img]
"Let the Galaxy burn!"
– Warmaster Horus

Prepare to celebrate the original Isstvan III Legions with the new event, starting this Friday! Featuring the rare opportunity to use cards from two Legions, who will you ally and fight alongside? 

Combine the strength of multiple Legions to create the ultimate deck and dominate the battlefield! Will you survive the Dropsite Massacre?

notes.title: Iapto lands in the shop!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/57d32045bbfa5183eeb3e5b34db3fd94052588cf.jpg[/img]
"My turn now."
– Iapto

Iapto arrives to the shop today for the first time. Stand alongside the Agents of the Sigillite against the forces of the Warmaster!

Once known as Severian of the Luna Wolves, Iapto was abandoned by his Legion and was soon recruited by Malcador into the Knight's Errant. A ferocious warrior with an uncanny talent for stealth, he became a valuable addition to the secretive warriors of the Sigillite.

notes.title: The Gorgon of Medusa arrives this weekend!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/0f72e6c0929def726fbec4ef8230cb600257bad0.jpg[/img]
"By my hands, I will end it."
– Ferrus Manus

Ferrus Manus, Primarch of the Iron Hands and Lord of Medusa marches into this weekend's deal! Become the mighty Gorgon and add his alternate artwork, voice lines and an exclusive card back to your collection in today's time-limited deal!

To mark the occasion, his normal version will also show up in the Daily Shop.

notes.title: January's balance patch has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/ce8b12c0e957ea867814910fcf0d57dc27eb49ad.jpg[/img]
"We have come. We are death." 
– Farith Redloss, Dreadbringer

New balance patch! The Dark Angels restock their armouries and rearm for the next stage of their push towards Terra, while Nassir Amit receives some changes to make up for his recent dominance.

Check out the balance changes:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/january-2023-balance-patch/

notes.title: The Moment of Truth Raid event receives reinforcements!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/dc382c5964c3794a5a5a10581aaf279b729f02e3.jpg[/img]
"If you have any last words, speak now."
– Constantin Valdor

Event reinforcements! Constantin Valdor arrives on the battlefield to cross blades with the Warmaster. Magnus the Red manifests from the warp to wreak vengeance on the Custodians, in return for the destruction of Prospero. With these two legendary figures joining the fight, will anyone be able to defeat the Warmaster? 

The Moment of Truth continues! Fight for victory!

notes.title: The March of the Gorgon continues!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1cc900f92df152865a9b1f9efe7e294afdafdf3f.jpg[/img]
"Nothing will stop me. Nothing."
– Ferrus Manus

The fighting on the surface of Isstvan V intensifies as the Iron Hands continue to push forward into the traitors, their resolve never faltering. Ferrus Manus and Gabriel Santar lead the assault, but they are soon bogged down as the battle turns into a desperate slog between once close brothers.

The March of the Gorgon has been extended by one week! If you haven't yet been able to defeat Fulgrim's daemonic form and earn the exclusive card back and deck deal, now is your chance to strike once more!

notes.title: December's meta report has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/cbce4c035838d6be400b23e55f817f99357eff07.jpg[/img]
"The future can be changed."
– Sanguinius

The stats are in! The Blood Angels stand triumphant on Terra in this month's ranked season. Will anyone be able to hold them back?
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/december-2022-meta-report/

Where does your favourite Warlord rank?

notes.title: Flash sale: Gabriel Santar returns!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/79ca3f244c17084eb7cbe9b57fdc3075c581ec3c.jpg[/img]
"We deliver His fury with our iron fist!"
– Gabriel Santar

Flash sale! Charge alongside the sons of the Gorgon with Gabriel Santar's brutal alternate art! Don't miss the chance to get his custom made art, a full deck with the legendary Medusan Carapace card, and the exclusive Avernii Clan card back.

Celebrate the Iron Hand's campaign, March of the Gorgon, with their ferocious First Captain today!

notes.title: New ranked season!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/f764b398026965c60e4733603ae2ad3a99af9512.png[/img]
“Someone get this one some Mjod!”
– Leman Russ

December's ranked season has ended. Congratulations to all the winners!

All players with 500 or more rating have received a reward crate based on their division, with the top 200 players worldwide getting the best prizes. All players on Terra will also have their rating reset to 2500, and all points above 2500 are converted to Legendary Points.

A new ranked season is already underway. Claim your rewards and get ready for a new competition!

notes.title: Join the end of year tournament!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/4fe5619e34fc69a226b4c41d5dcb65dec5eb576e.jpg[/img]
"I drink to my impending triumph." 
– Lucius

End the year with the final Horus Heresy: Legions tournament and earn the chance to win thousands of gold, and a free legendary card! Registrations are currently open!

Take a look at the event below and get signed up today, and finish 2022 with a bang!
https://challonge.com/hhlslaaneshmas

notes.title: The newest Defender of Caliban has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/323d61f7375ec272f50dfad15e3eee88a4d93f82.jpg[/img]
"The will of Caliban be done." 
– Vassago

Weekend deal! Find Vassago, an apprentice of the Calibanite Mystai and follower of Zahariel, in this weekend's offer! Don't miss the chance to get a full 30-card deck featuring the mysterious psyker, a legendary card and an exclusive collector's card back. Only this weekend!

A native of Caliban, Vassago was recruited to the renegade Luther's cause by Zahariel, and inducted into the ancient order of the Mystai, a coven of psykers pledged to the world itself. Vassago accompanied Corswain to Terra, alongside other recruits, and struck a blow against the Warmaster's forces at the Astronomican.

notes.title: Check out the Developer Q&A!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/cf7aa4c35f98f87d202cc232b3300539b36f2e3f.jpg[/img]
"This is but a glimpse of the times to come."
– Warmaster Horus

The latest developer Q&A is now live! Read the answers to your questions and learn all about the new expansion, what will happen with existing content, and what to expect in the near future! 

Check it out in the latest blog post:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/developer-qa-shadow-of-the-warmaster/

Be sure to give it a read, and we'll see you on the battlefields of the Horus Heresy in the new year!

notes.title: New Major Raid: Moment of Truth
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/da54c0e087f397c09408916bd7037a596fb2040b.jpg[/img]
"I will do what must be done."
– Warmaster Horus

Prepare to face the Warmaster in the new Raid event! The final battle is coming, Horus must be stopped now or the Imperium will crumble. With the powers of Chaos flowing through the Warmaster's body, the Siege of Terra enters its final stage and the greatest champions of the Imperium lead the assault on Horus' flagship, to finish his Heresy once and for all.

Check out the web post here:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/new-raid-moment-of-truth/

Join the raid and work together with all other players to unlock new content in the game, including the Lord of the Flies, a new legendary neutral warlord!

notes.title: Prepare yourself for the next Raid event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/0d9bd09dfb50f7a9ed8ba5ffef920e25e5942878.jpg[/img]
"No turning back. I will conquer the future, or erase it."
– Horus Lupercal

The final battle is coming, Horus must be stopped now or the Imperium will crumble. With the powers of Chaos circling through the Warmaster's body, the Siege of Terra enters its final stage and the greatest warriors the Imperium has seen will walk the battlefield in a fight that will change the future of humanity.

Join the next massive Raid event, starting tomorrow: Moment of Truth! Collaborate with all other players to stop Warmaster Horus, and unlock amazing new content in the game.

notes.title: March with the Gorgon once more!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=pwo_aGsISpk;full][/previewyoutube]
"Only one of us will walk away from this."
– Ferrus Manus

The Iron Hands return! First to respond to the Warmaster's treachery, Ferrus Manus and his Iron Hands stormed the surface of Isstvan V to secure a landing zone for the loyalists and press the attack against the traitors. Meanwhile the fleet in orbit was forced to defend itself from a series of brutal boarding actions.

Relive their doomed offensive in the campaign, March of the Gorgon, and face down the traitors!

Learn all about the campaign in their blog post:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/iron-hands-campaign/

notes.title: Magnus the Red returns!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/5ee0c9f46e790e2009cae0a1f90a273cd4e129a7.jpg[/img]
"I will return to the world of flesh and blood."
– Magnus the Red, Primarch

Flash sale! Raging with power, Magnus' alternate art returns just for today to attempt to breach the Imperial Palace! The Primarch of the Thousand Sons Legion continues to battle against the psychic shield of the Emperor. Get his alternate art, starter deck and exclusive collector's card back in today's special deal!

To mark the occasion, the regular version of Magnus will also be for sale in the Shop today. Don't miss your chance to add him to your collection and do nothing wrong.

notes.title: The Avenging Son returns!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/147cdd2e120d884541f1dfe9675feeff95e63b60.jpg[/img]
[i]"In the name of Terra, hail!"[/i]
– Roboute Guilliman

Roboute Guilliman, the Avenging Son, charges into battle with an amazing alternate art! Discover his voice lines and exclusive collector's card back. Don't miss the chance to get this alternate artwork as part of his premium deck in a time-limited deal, only today!

Will you save Ultramar from the predations of the traitors?

notes.title: Get Dorn during this weekend!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/f2be32be67a86dcfb18f61a2c3362806dd37ae94.jpg[/img]
[i]"In these dark times, nothing can be certain."[/i]
– Rogal Dorn

Weekend offer! Rogal Dorn, Praetorian of Terra, returns with his exclusive art! Add him to your collection this weekend and discover his collector's card back and voice lines. Don't miss the chance to get this alternate artwork as part of this time-limited value deal.

To mark the occasion, the regular version of Dorn will also be featured in the weekend's shops. Let none past your mighty defences as Terra's mightiest protector.

notes.title: New forces arrive to the Hollow City
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/77733636fe1df27c42d84968a52851fd889b8ca2.jpg[/img]
[i]"There is no hope for you."[/i]
– Vassago

Event reinforcements! Vassago of the Mystai unleashes his might on the traitors in the Hollow City, his psychic abilities empowering his allies to better fight the daemons. Summoned by the Warp, Ar'gakhol the Goreborn manifests to bring carnage to the lackeys of the Emperor.

Corswain's Gambit continues! Take part and fight for your chosen reward!

notes.title: The Captain-General calls you to war!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/d71d46903f0e970c1bb1cbc6fbf60fbd264e3179.jpg[/img]
"I will show you exemplary efficiency."
– Constantin Valdor

Flash sale! Another defender of Terra prepares to hold the line! The Captain-General of the Legio Custodes stands ready to pierce through the traitor invasion. Get Constantin Valdor's alternate art, exclusive collector's card back and a full deck with this value package. Available only today!

To mark the occasion, the regular version of Valdor will also be for sale in the Shop during the day.

For the Emperor of Mankind!

notes.title: Stand with the Great Angel!
notes.content:
"Without Daemons, there can be no Angels."
– Sanguinius, Primarch

Flash sale! Stand against treachery with Sanguinius as he defends the walls of the Imperial Palace! Don't miss the chance to get his alternate artwork, exclusive collector's card back and full deck in today's time-limited deal!

To mark the occasion, his regular version will also be in the shop.

notes.title: Fight for the 5th Defenders of Caliban warlord!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/9b31e810f829a0bfd12d2b99f1063791ad058387.jpg[/img]
"You will break, eventually."
– Chapter Master Galedan

The chance to determine the 5th collectable warlord of the Defenders of Caliban is here! If the loyalists claim victory, Vassago, agent of the Mystai, will be added to the game. If the traitors force their way to glory, then Chapter Master Galedan will join the Defenders of Caliban roster.

Every player victory in the event contributes points towards the faction of the warlord they are playing. Choose your side and help determine the fate of the game!

As usual, the top 10 lodges will also receive the winning Warlord as part of their reward crates. Fight to make your lodge stand amongst the greatest!

notes.title: The Soulless Queen returns!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/9ffe8b0263b22750f9ba8f82b2d6fa5f1e97f693.jpg[/img]
"May my blade be true to this moment."
– Jenetia Krole

Jenetia Krole returns to defend Terra in this weekend's exclusive deal! Add the Knight-Commander of the Sisters of Silence to your collection together with her collector's card back and deck to become a force of nature against the traitor invasion.

Don't miss the chance to get her alternate artwork as part of this weekend's deal! Lead the Sisters of Silence into battle and enact the Emperor's will all over the Imperium.

notes.title: The Battle of Trisolian is over!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/6975425775b7b4ad0dc9f54999806fc07fa537f9.jpg[/img]
[i]"I will see the Galaxy freed once more!"[/i]
– Horus Lupercal

Try as they might to stop the Warmaster's push for Terra, the traitor armada opened a path through the blockade and is now en route to Terra. Horus' forces might have dwindled, but there is now nothing that could stop him from reaching the Imperial Capital.

Congratulations to the top lodges in the event! A new cosmetic Sons of Horus card back joins the game! Don't forget to claim your rewards!

notes.title: Developer Q&A
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/5fd6f9cfb8ffada7294f5ab110d42720c71de7ff.jpg[/img]
"Only a fool would not heed my sermon." 
– Kor Phaeron

With the Shadow of the Warmaster expansion just around the corner, we anticipate lots of questions regarding the new factions and Legacy mode. 

Be sure to get your questions into the qa-requests channel in the Discord, or send in your questions through Facebook, and keep your eye out for the Dev Q&A release next week!

notes.title: Battle for the Astronomican in Corswain's Gambit!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/569fb0830ac4b275e687188b20f5fd68b4b242b9.jpg[/img]
"Sometimes history tilts on a narrow edge." 
– Corswain, Paladin-Captain

The Dark Angels arrive to Terra! Corswain reinforces his ranks with fresh Calibanite troops and breaks through the traitor blockade above Terra. The loyalists land in the Hollow Mountain, eager to relight the Astronomican, which unfortunately had been claimed by the Emperor's Children.

Fight for which 5th Defenders of Caliban Warlord will join the game! Claim victory with the traitors and unlock the taciturn skill of Chapter Master Galedan, or fight for the loyalists and reveal the mystical gifts of Librarian Vassago. Choose your side!

notes.title: Steam Deck Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/72063d76225a6e6f951c79deda47cd2b536592d3.jpg[/img]
"Don't fear technology."
– Kelbor-Hal, Fabricator General

An update has been released for Steam, fixing the minor compatibility issues with Steam Deck. The keyboard will now come out automatically when selecting a text field, rather than requiring the player to bring it up through a shortcut.

Embrace the latest archeotech and take the battle to your enemies wherever you are!

notes.title: The Emperor's Children campaign returns!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=V7bNBwDFM60;full][/previewyoutube]
"Death by noise!"
– Marius Vairosean

Since the beginnings of the rebellion, the Emperor's Children have been at the centre of the Horus Heresy. From the betrayal of Isstvan III to the Drop Site Massacre at Isstvan V, they played a key role in many of the opening moves of the Warmaster's plans. 

Relive the Isstvan atrocities from both sides of the conflict in their single-player campaign! You can play for free in the Campaign Library over the next two weeks. Face loyalists and traitors alike, and take part in a battle that would change the galaxy forever.

Learn all about the campaign in the official announcement:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/emperors-children-campaign/

notes.title: Become the master of House Devine!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/da29b3082cae4f84804134abd24e90f4070f198c.jpg[/img]
"The Serpent Gods provide."
– Albard Devine

Albard Devine marches into the shop today for the first time! Prepare to take the Throne Mechanicum and pilot your Knight alongside the ranks of the Warmaster's forces!

Firstborn scion of Cyprian Devine, Albard was corrupted by the forces of the Serpent Cult and tainted by Slaanesh. He lead his Knight House into the service of the Warmaster, and fought alongside the traitors through the Horus Heresy.

notes.title: Vulkan Lives!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1afd43ba108318282e6d6b77961cd5661d53af6b.jpg[/img]
"I will teach you about sacrifice."
– Vulkan, Primarch

Vulkan is back! Accept the gift of battle and charge unto the anvil of war with Vulkan's alternate art, the Lord of Drakes! Get him in this returning premium bundle including the legendary Warlord, a premium deck and an exclusive collector's card back. Only until the end of the weekend!

To celebrate the holiday season, his normal version will also be available in the Daily Shop during the weekend. Don't miss the chance to add him to your collection!

notes.title: December balance changes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/0871e63eaaf17a0f8c90170f54d2a0e8dce2b34e.jpg[/img]
"We will wreak vengeance upon you!" 
– Sanguinius, Great Angel

New balance patch! The Blood Angels prepared to unleash their rage and fury on the Warmaster's forces, with several buffs to their core units. Sanguinius also recieves a notable change to his ability!

Check out the balance changes:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/december-2022-balance-patch/

notes.title: Release notes v2.3.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/15ebdcceab2fb1451197d6d54f51bed0400c2250.jpg[/img]
"May our futures fly beyond this battle."
– Sanguinius, Primarch of the Blood Angels

Update v2.3.4 is now available to download in all platforms. This update prepares the game for the latest balance patch and for a major upcoming timed event, and brings a few bug fixes:
- Fix problem when searching for a lodge, which caused the game to crash on some devices
- Fix wrong interaction between Displaced Civilians and Talons of the Emperor (Sisters of Silence mission reward)
- Fix some errors when playing with particles disabled

notes.title: Reinforcements arrive for the Battle of Trisolian!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/a37c37b0abd63e1b3667b465ce6398cebbeba094.jpg[/img]
"My sword mourns you already."
– Horus Aximand

Event reinforcements! Unleashed as part of the second wave, Bjorn of the Space Wolves leaps into battle, leading his packs into the midst of the Sons of Horus formations! Horus Aximand is forced to join the fight as Space Wolves converge on his position aboard the Vengeful Spirit.

The Battle of Trisolian continues! Take part and fight for your chosen reward!

notes.title: Fight for Worldbreaker or the Spear of Russ!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/629a23c8223a64aa2bf8149da37dd70195753bbb.jpg[/img]
"Your efforts are admirable, yet futile."
– Warmaster Horus

The chance to determine a new cosmetic has arrived! Will you join with the loyalists and fight to unlock the Spear of Leman Russ cardback, or will you side with the traitors and battle to release the Worldbreaker cardback instead?

Every player victory in the event contributes points towards the faction of the warlord they are playing. Choose your side and help determine which cosmetic will be added to the game.

As usual, the top 10 lodges will also receive the winning option as part of their reward crates. Fight to make your lodge stand amongst the greatest!

With the Ultramarines, Imperial Fists and elements of Dantioch's own forces, the loyalists were able to stop the Pharos falling into enemy hands, but at the great sacrifice of the beacon being overloaded and destroyed. Sometimes, the only victory achievable is to stop your opponent from winning.

Congratulations to the top lodges in the event! A new cosmetic Imperial Fist badge joins the game! Members of the Top 10 lodges will also receive the newly unlocked cosmetic in their reward crates. Don't forget to claim your rewards!

Fight for a brand new cardback to be added to the game! Will you join the forces of the Space Wolves and battle to unlock the Spear of Leman Russ cardback, or fight for the traitors to unleash the Worldbreaker cardback?

Where does your favourite Warlord rank?

notes.title: November's ranked season has ended!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/5b4775bac55c0747902e0a2969ee0884be3b3aad.png[/img]
“Someone get this one some Mjod!”
– Leman Russ

November's ranked season has ended. Congratulations to all the winners!

All players with 500 or more rating have received a reward crate based on their division, with the top 200 players worldwide getting the best prizes. All players on Terra will also have their rating reset to 2500, and all points above 2500 are converted to Legendary Points.

A new ranked season is already underway. Claim your rewards and get ready for a new competition!

notes.title: Enter the Fires of Nucturne!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/116a22dc4045f4bc25ce0a43402b2ca2342190fc.jpg[/img]
[i]"Into the fires of battle!"[/i]
– Artellus Numeon

Vulkan is dead. The vile traitor plot on Isstvan V took a heavy toll on the loyalist legions, but a small party led by a brave Artellus Numeon believe they can rekindle their father's heart, and bring him back into the world of the living. Will you accept the Salamanders' most dangerous mission in the Fires of Nocturne campaign? 
[previewyoutube=yCfmKuI051o;full][/previewyoutube]
Follow the journey of Artellus Numeon to the world of Nocturne after the Isstvan Atrocity. Play the Salamanders campaign while it's available for free in the Campaign Library during the following two weeks and unlock its great rewards!

Discover all about it in the [url=https://www.horusheresylegions.com/salamanders-campaign/]blog post[/url] and kickstart your Salamanders collection with the campaign's amazing rewards!

notes.title: Celebrate Cyber Monday with Canis Vertex!

Bringing the fury of a Legion betrayed, can he withstand the traitorous assault? Drawn by the brutal fighting, Konrad Curze swoops into the thick of the fighting, eager to sow terror and chaos amongst the loyalists.

The war for the Pharos continues! Take part and fight for your chosen reward!

notes.title: Alexis Polux arrives with new alternate art!

A giant of an Astartes, Alexis Polux was a genius at void-warfare, almost overcoming Perturabo and the Iron Warriors at Phall, before they were ordered to retreat. Finding himself stranded at the Pharos, he was charged by Roboute Guilliman to protect the device at all costs.

Take a look at the latest [url=https://www.horusheresylegions.com/shadows-of-the-warmaster-announcement/]blog post[/url] to learn more about the times to come.

From the skies of Terra to the galactic rim, war rages across the Galaxy. Prepare for the Shadow of the Warmaster expansion. Prepare for the Horus Heresy.

notes.title: The True Firstborn Mission is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/641f230be0b8894ea1246bf3e6feb2629db9169f.jpg[/img]
"Time and tide wait for no man."
– Constantin Valdor

True Firstborn arrives to the daily veteran shop for the first time! Don't miss your chance to add it to your collection and become the talons of the Emperor today!

Many believed the Legiones Astartes, or even the Thunder Warriors to be the Emperor's first warriors. In truth, the golden figures of the Legio Custodes fought alongside the Emperor before any of them. Warriors rather than soldiers, the Custodians were on a level of genetic manipulation far closer to the Emperor than even the Legiones Astartes.

notes.title: A new expansion is coming

[previewyoutube=V0efdmjOREc;full][/previewyoutube]
Sharpen your sword, reload your bolter and stay tuned. The cycle begins anew, and the Warmaster is ready to unleash his Legions against his Father.

A strategic mind to rival Rogal Dorn, Perturabo would get his chance to test the defences of the Imperial Palace during the Siege of Terra. Become Perturabo today and add him to your roster in this time-limited deal or by checking today's shop.

Hunted by former brothers and Knights of the Emperor, Iapto made the choice to remain loyal to the Throne. Casting away his former name of Severian, he joined the Knights-Errant of Malcador.

notes.title: New timed event: Pharos Assault!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/6fb0b15ffcedf0ccd2af41d76b68af6dbd1f2cc2.jpg[/img]
"Temper your enthusiasm, I still breathe." 
– Barabas Dantioch, Warsmith

Cloaked by nefarious means, the Night Lords launch an assault on the world of Sotha. With Mount Pharos in danger of falling into enemy hands, the Ultramarines and Imperial Fists detachments on the planet prepare for its defence.

Will you side with the forces of Imperium Secundus and protect the Pharos beacon, or align yourself with the cruel warriors of the Night Lords? Fight to unlock a new cosmetic for either the Imperial Fists or Night Lords!

notes.title: Besiege the Palace alongside the Iron Warriors!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=U7Xha7nsRNU;full][/previewyoutube]
"Is it that hard to accept that I am superior?"
– Perturabo

Take command of the assault on the Lion's Gate and lay waste to Terra's defences in the Iron Warriors campaign, now featured in the Campaign Library! Make sure to check out the new trailer!

Since their fall to the service of the Ruinous Powers, the Iron Warriors dutifully followed the Warmaster in his effort to reshape the Galaxy. They made great sacrifices holding the loyalists at bay but their time to shine arrived with the Siege of Terra, when they were tasked to find a way to exploit any weakness in the Imperial Capital's defences.

Discover all about it in the blog post and kickstart your Iron Warriors collection with the campaign's amazing rewards!
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/iron-warriors-campaign/

notes.title: Become the Seneschal of a Knight House!
notes.content:

"Impressive. Fierce like the great beasts of Molech."
– Albard Devine

Prideful Seneschal arrives to the daily veteran shop for the first time! Don't miss your chance to add it to your collection and become the true leader of your Knight House!

Honour and nobility meant as much to the various Knight Houses as anything else. It was often seen as the greatest privilege to lead a Knight detachment, and it was only right that the Lord of the House would lead from the front, striking the first blow!

The regular version of Malcador will also be available in the shop while the deal is up, so don't miss this opportunity to add him to your collection.

"You are beneath me. In every way."
– Vulkan

Meanwhile, Ahriman breaks from his sacred enumerations to join the battle against the Sigillite's agents, eager to buy his Primarch more time.

The war in the Dungeon continues. Choose your side and decide which new Agents of the Sigillite Warlord will join the game!

notes.title: Celebrate the 11th November with Luther's alternate art!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/badce4d800098475bff202788379e22b62021093.jpg[/img]
"I'm in no mood for jests."
– Luther

Cast out of the Great Crusade by The Lion, Luther was ordered to remain on Caliban in order to train the next ranks of the Dark Angels. In his lonesome duty Luther had been given the power to reshape Caliban, and its future. Get his alternate artwork, voice lines, exclusive card back in this collector's deck!

Become the Arch-Betrayer today and add him to your roster in this time-limited deal or by checking today's shop.

Become the Reaper today and add him to your roster in this time-limited deal or by checking today's shop.

notes.title: Lord of Chaos arrives in the daily shop!

Nearly splitting the galaxy in twain and cutting off Ultramar from the Imperium, the Ruinstorm was an immense warpstorm. With its opening came hordes of powerful daemons, all eager to spread chaos and corruption across the realms of humanity, like a gate unsealed.

notes.title: Become the Master of Molech this weekend!

Lead House Devine into a new era under the Warmaster's banner as Albard. Bear your weapons against the False Emperor, and follow the Serpent Gods' decree to achieve victory!

notes.title: Aerion Mersaror arrives on the battlefield!

notes.title: Celebrate Halloween with Konrad Curze!

notes.title: Event reinforcements arrive for the Fall of House Devine!

– Warmaster Horus

Seeing the apex of the battle approaching, a small team of Agents of the Sigillite follow Iacton Qruze and infiltrate the Vengeful Spirit in an attempt to halt their former brothers once and for all.

The war for House Devine and Molech continues. Choose your side and decide which new Knight House Warlord will join the game!

– Erebus

One of the self-styled architects of the Horus Heresy, Erebus was a conniving and duplicitous Astartes who fought only for his own power. Get his alternate artwork, voice lines, exclusive card back and the legendary Book of Lorgar card in this collector's deck!

Add the architect of Heresy to your roster in this time-limited deal or by checking today's shop.

notes.title: Summon the Solar Auxilia today!

– Lord Commander Thaddeus Fayle

Solar Pattern arrives to the daily veteran shop for the first time! Don't miss your chance to add it to your collection and assemble the might of the Imperial Army to defeat your foes!

The Solar Auxilia were hardened veterans from across the galaxy who formed the elite regiments of the Imperial Army. Without these countless millions of soldiers, the Great Crusade would likely have failed in the scope of its ambitions.

Don't miss the chance to add Debeeran Kalimakon, a full 30-card deck including the Mikaelor Cobernus Legendary troop and an exclusive collector's card back to your collection. Only this weekend!

Lead the Custodians into battle with Debeeran Kalimakon and crush your enemies with the might of the Imperium's finest warriors. Don't miss out on this amazing deal!

notes.title: Witness the fall of House Devine in the new timed event!

The invasion of Molech started as Horus reached the system. The insidious whispers of Slaanesh slowly lured House Devine to the Warmaster's servitude. As loyalists and traitors fought, the fate of House Devine hung in the balance.

Choose your side in The Fall of House Devine event and decide which 5th Knight House Pilot will join the game!  Fight for the loyalists to unlock the noble and resolute Cyprian Devine for the Knight Houses, or will you side with the traitors and battle to unlock his corrupted scion, Albard Devine.

notes.title: Raze Ultramar with the Word Bearers!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=I3TJ5WNaie0;full][/previewyoutube]
"The hell behind reality stole my sense of humour."
– Argel Tal

It is the time for retaliation! Lay waste to the Ultramar realm in the single-player campaign: The Shadow Crusade as it enters the Campaign Library! 

When the Horus Heresy erupted the Word Bearers organized a military operation that would bring terror to the realm of Ultramar, both as a way to serve Horus and in retaliation for the razing of Monarchia. World by world Lorgar and his sons laid waste to Guilliman’s realm and performed a dark ritual that drastically changed the state of the galactic war.

Become a Blessed Son and punish those who wronged the Legion before with the whole strength of the Word Bearers. Discover all about the campaign in the latest blog post and kickstart your Word Bearer collection!
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/new-campaign-shadow-crusade/

notes.title: Defend Ravendelve in the Raven Guard campaign!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=TswKwe5FDQg;full][/previewyoutube]
"I cannot allow you to put us at risk any longer."
– Vincente Sixx

The future of a whole Legion rests on your shoulders in the Battle of Ravendelve single-player campaign, now featuring in the Campaign Library! 

After the start of the greatest betrayal in the history of the Imperium of Mankind, the traitors still had plans to wither the forces of those still loyal to the Emperor. The Raven Guard was able to escape from Isstvan V, but the Legion's survival is uncertain. The Raven Guard's rebuilding efforts have begun, but traitor conspirators are intent on finishing their earlier work.

Rebuild the Legion and earn great rewards! Begin your Raven Guard collection while battling back the forces of the Warmaster in an effort to save the 19th from extinction!

One of the most skilled riders and pilots in the Dark Angels, Aloceri was promoted to Voted-Lieutenant of the Ravenwing following the First Legion's breakout from the Ruinstorm. He stood alongside his Primarch as they proceeded on a campaign of vengeance throughout the galaxy during the Heresy.

All players with 500 or more rating have received a reward crate based on their division, with the top 200 players worldwide getting the best prizes. All players on Terra will also have their rating reset to 2500, and all points above 2500 are converted to Legendary Points.

A new ranked season is already underway. Claim your rewards and get ready for a new competition!

Embody the power of betrayal and treachery with the possessed form of Tormageddon in this weekend's deal! To mark the occasion, his regular version will also be in the shop during the weekend. Make sure to test his recent balance changes in battle!

notes.title: Witness the beginnings of the Heresy
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=4isFze5tiaQ;full][/previewyoutube]
"Some warriors actually enjoy war."
– Khârn

Relive the start of the Horus Heresy from a different perspective in the single player campaign: Isstvan III, now featured in the Campaign Library! Check out the amazing trailer:

Reports of rebellion sprouted on the world of Isstvan III. Under orders of Warmaster Horus, four Legions are dispatched to quiet these revolts. Captain Ehrlen leads a company of World Eaters to face the Isstvanite rebels. Their challenge to Imperial rule must be put down swiftly, but it might not go as expected.

Fight your way through the beginning of the Heresy! Sharpen your axes and get ready for the red harvest! Complete the campaign and start building your World Eater collection with the free Warlord and faction cards included in the rewards!

notes.title: Magnificum Incendius stomps into the shop!

One of the deadliest engines in Legio Ignatum, the Magnificum Incendius proved to be a lynchpin in the defences of Mercury Wall. One of three Imperators of Ignatum, the Magnificum Incendius would uphold the legacy of valour and strength of its Legio.
