notes.title: New timed event: Mercury-Exultant Killzone
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/9fe3df36abda9f7ab85ef97b210cc9e2d31ee163.jpg[/img]
"We will set the Emperor's lies aflame."
– Princeps of Caligo Flaminis, Nemesis Titan

Horus issues a massive Titan assault to breach Terra's mightiest walls. The ground of the Imperial Palace trembles as the loyalists form up their ranks and prepare for battle. Can the might of the Traitor Legios breach the defences of the Mercury-Exultant killzone?

Choose your side at the Mercury-Exultant Killzone and decide which 4th Traitor Legios Warlord will join the game! If the Loyalists succeed, Ceraunthanato, an Iconoclast of Legio Tempestus will enter the battle. If the Traitors are victorious, the power of Caligo Flaminis, Nemesis Warbringer of Legio Fureans will march to war!

notes.title: September Balance Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1c88c818ee1f3b6a18f902ff36781bfeaf708f11.jpg[/img]
"Our true masters have called upon us."
– Kor Phaeron

New balance patch! The Word Bearers receive several mighty boons for their sacrifices to the Warp, while the Titan Legios' begin to feel the streins of war in their plasma reactors. The Emperor's Children receive further changes, and a Sons of Horus Warlord gains a powerful new ability!

Check out the balance changes:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/august-2022-balance-patch/

notes.title: The Iron Hunter arrives in shop
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/cd79369394b4d7af22546134c8572c39f0fcb55b.jpg[/img]
"You can't hurt us!"
– Princeps of Dies Irae

For the first time, the Legendary Iron Hunter appears in the shop! One of the few Warhound class Titans in the ranks of Legio Mortis, it saw service through the Horus Heresy, fighting alongside the more numerous Warlords and Reavers of the Legio.

Find the Traitor Legios Legendary card in the veteran shop today!

notes.title: Return to Signus Prime!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=7IPkfvNj-8U;full][/previewyoutube]
"We will lose this war unless we kill the thing that started it."
– Meros

Following the Warmaster's orders and lured by the possibility of a cure for the Red Thirst, the Blood Angels took to the Signus system to cleanse a xenos incursion. En route, Meros felt vast psychic energies striking the ship and an unforeseen enemy appeared before him. Doubt now loomed upon him: had they just walked into a trap?

The Blood Angels campaign on Signus Prime is now featured in the Campaign Library, freely available for all players during two weeks. Check out the amazing trailer:

Fight your way through the tarnished plains of Signus Prime, surpass the Warmaster's challenges to discover what lies at the center of this betrayal and reap glorious rewards. Blades out, brothers!

Learn more about the Campaign Library here:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/new-campaign-library/

notes.title: The August Meta report has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/8fe90576aa7acfd8a69708f902cd1be8f4a5a2c8.jpg[/img]
"We are the shadow that kills."
– Corvus Corax, Ravenlord

The stats are in! Does Lucius the Faultless Blade remain on the top spot for the third ranked season, or has a challenger removed him from his dominance in the meta? Check out August's report below!
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/august-2022-meta-report/

Where does your favourite Warlord rank?

notes.title: Gather the Silent Sisterhood
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/cb27106bf7545ce3b8124549606549d0a91db8fb.jpg[/img]
[i]"We are mute, but not without power."[/i]
– Jenetia Krole

The Sisters of Silence mission features in the daily shop for the first time today! Rally the might of the Silent Sisterhood and lead them into battle against the agents of Chaos!

Short in number but not in power, the Sisters of Silence are a specialized unit dedicated to fighting against psychic threats and unnatural horrors. The sisterhood is composed purely of Blanks, beings with a mutation that grants them great resistance against psychic attacks.

notes.title: Raze the battlefield as Ar'gakhol the Goreborn!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/51887b8f32b6af16aec0588226e952e0372783bf.jpg[/img]
[i]"I bring fire! I bring ruin!"[/i]
– Ar'gakhol the Goreborn

Weekend deal! Unleash the Daemon Lord Ar'gakhol the Goreborn on the galaxy in his exclusive deck offer, featuring a full 30 card deck, exclusive cardback, and the Daemon Lord himself.

Unleash the rage of Khorne on your enemies, and be sure to try out Ar'gakhol in the new Harrowing of Pyrrhan event!

notes.title: Harrowing of Pyrrhan event reinforcements!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/47df15a74af720754eb2b49eca4e3d736f979d78.jpg[/img]
"We hunt in the dark."
– Holguin, Voted-Lieutenant of the Deathwing

Event reinforcements! Holguin returns to face the daemonic hordes once more, while Ar'Gakhol the Goreborn emerges from a warp rift to battle the assembled might of the Legiones Astartes.

Choose your side at the Harrowing of Pyrrhan and fight! Your actions will determine which new Warlord becomes available to the Dark Angels: Aloceri of the Ravenwing, or Holguin of the Deathwing.

notes.title: Find the Chosen of Terra today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/3551649459f5e951d66e591d7d63ac5423de71fc.jpg[/img]
"I like your tricks."
– Iota, Culexus Assassin

For the first time, the Agents of the Sigillite mission, Chosen of Terra, features in the daily shop! Harness the might of Malcador's hidden secrets to defeat your enemies.

Recruited from amongst the length of the galaxy, Malcador's agents utilized a vast array of tactics and possessed hidden knowledge that the Regent used to defeat the forces of the Warmaster. Those who were granted the Seal of Malcador were given near ultimate authority to carry out their duties.

notes.title: Flash Sale: Ahriman alternate art!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/a918729f4fda51dc962b4380adf6607e485b67a2.jpg[/img]
“You fear what you do not understand.”
– Ahzek Ahriman

Flash sale! Ahriman brings his fury into battle in his enchanting alternate artwork! Only today, get it in a premium constructed deck, also featuring an exclusive collector's card back. The perfect way to grow your Thousand Sons collection!

Prepare your incantations and unleash your psychic powers as you fight for the future of your Legion with the Magister Templi of the Corvidae. For Magnus!

Have you never commanded the Thousand Sons into battle? Test them out in the current campaign and earn some of their cards as a reward! Check out the amazing campaign trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8B163kqzi8I

notes.title: Learn about the Master of the Ravenwing!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/c205470c6fec2993ebc5954b412cce84ec56cac9.jpg[/img]
"I've faced worse in the forests of Caliban."
– Aloceri, Voted-Lieutenant of the Ravenwing 

Master of all forms of fast attack vehicles, Aloceri embodies the Ravenwing in all aspects of war. A native of Caliban, he fought and rose alongside Holguin, who backed him for command of the Ravenwing when its former master fell crossing the Ruinstorm. 

Command the Dark Angels as Aloceri in the new timed event and fight for his release!

notes.title: Sheed Ranko arrives in the shop!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1a62c4449cc73db8f5fbaacf616f4e3f357a520f.jpg[/img]
"It seems you can take care of yourself."
– Sheed Ranko

For the first time, uncover Sheed Ranko in the daily Veteran shop today! Master of the Lernaen company and confidante to the Twin Primarchs, Sheed Ranko managed a vast network of Alpha Legion agents and spies. Now it's the time to call them into action.

Make sure to pick up the newest Alpha Legion warlord today!

notes.title: Unlock the 5th Dark Angel Warlord!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/736e8e9f648fa6ef3767502fbf23c9d726937136.jpg[/img]
"Nothing happened here."
– Holguin, Voted-Lieutenant of the Deathwing

The chance to determine the 5th collectable warlord of the Dark Angels is here! If the loyalists claim victory, Aloceri of the Ravenwing will join the roster of The First. Were the traitors to take the battle, Holguin would join the collection to lead the Deathwing against the betrayers.

Every player victory in the event contributes points towards the faction of the warlord they are playing. Choose your side and help determine the fate of the game!

As usual, the top 10 lodges will also receive the winning Warlord as part of their reward crates. Fight to make your lodge stand amongst the greatest!

notes.title: The Magnificum Incendius has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/e83edecf2d3124515374c001c37cccb5acafc22d.jpg[/img]
"Magnificent!"
– Princeps of Magnificum Incendius

Weekend deal! Get the Legendary Magnificum Incendius for the first time in this weekend's exclusive deck offer! Command a full deck of 30 cards, complete with a collector's cardback and master the might of the machine!

Magnificum Incendius was one of three Imperators of the Legio Ignatum and formed part of their vital defence during the Siege of Terra. It stood tall against the attack of Legio Mortis at Mercury Wall and exacted a fearsome toll against the traitors.

notes.title: New timed event: Harrowing of Pyrrhan
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/cfbbac441a09b972a253b106b7caf86c85b22e31.jpg[/img]
"I only strike if it's going to hurt."
– Aloceri, Voted-Lieutenant of the Ravenwing 

The fleets of the Ultramarines, Blood Angels and Dark Angels are halted by a mysterious force in the Pyrrhan system, as  they seek to cross the Ruinstorm. While investigating a daemonic fortress, the three Legions come under attack by a Neverborn assault!

Choose your side at the Harrowing of Pyrrhan and join the battle! Your actions will determine which Dark Angel Warlord becomes collectable: Aloceri, Master of the Ravenwing or Holguin, Deathbringer of the First Legion.

notes.title: The Burning of Prospero enters the Campaign Library!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/4988bc5bbd7f73014480e109435c15d7ecc145e0.jpg[/img]
"Are you seeking to humble me?"
– Magnus the Red, Primarch

Play the Burning of Prospero single-player campaign while it's featured in the Campaign Library! Upon learning of Horus' betrayal, Magnus the Red tried to warn his Father by projecting his astral form to Terra. The Emperor, enraged that Magnus had violated the Edict of Nikaea, dispatched a Censure Host to Prospero to apprehend him.

Check out the trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8B163kqzi8I 

Experience the invasion of Magnus' homeworld from the eyes of the Thousand Sons. Space Wolves, Custodes, Pariahs... The Emperor's punitive force has enough power to wipe out the entire Legion. Prepare your weapons, focus on your conjurations and get ready to avoid execution.

Learn more about the Campaign Library here:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/new-campaign-library/ 

Unleash your powers against the invaders and reap glorious rewards!

notes.title: Learn more about the Orientalis-Echion Psi-Titan!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/be5226946d6b82f5a63b192984c488ad628052c4.jpg[/img]
"The voices of the damned shriek your name."
– Princeps of Orientalis-Echion

The Ordo Sinister was created in secret by the will, and hand of the Emperor. 25 Warlord Titans were adapted and changed to a far more esoteric nature. Created to fight against warp-spawned powers or blasphemies, each Ordo Sinister Psi-Titan was a devastating nemesis to any other war machine or warp horror that stood in its way. Several of these monstrous Titans fought during the Siege of Terra, and became the scourge of the Traitor Legios.

Play as the Orientalis-Echion Psi-Titan in the Gates of Terra event!

notes.title: Cleave your foes with the Reaver Chainfist!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/46a0215b0c25d81c57d47cc22b2763b4c3a92ab4.jpg[/img]
"Scream to your dear Emperor! He won't come for you!"
– Princeps of Hatred Unbound

For the first time, the cruelly serrated edge of the Reaver Chainfist arrives to the shop! Carve up enemy Titans, troops and Warlords with brutal cleaves of the Chainfist, and charge into combat once more!

Make sure to pick up this legendary weapon of the Traitor Legios today!

notes.title: Witness the Angel Sanguinius!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/d8a8fe4fcabe307b5e131114c463bee9c7499449.jpg[/img]
"You will have your destiny, but not your redemption."
– Sanguinius, Primarch

Lord of the Blood Angels, the Brightest One and Great Angel of the Imperium, Sanguinius was said to be the most perfect of the Primarchs. But a dark secret lay within his blood, and that of his Legion. A powerful, bloody fury would descend upon the 9th Legion, one which Sanguinius was unable to cure. He sought to temper and train his sons to deal with this Red Thirst, as it came to be known, but would ultimately be unsuccessful.

Find Sanguinius in this weekend's special premium deck, featuring his alternate art and exclusive collector's card back!

notes.title: Grab Sanguinius in this weekend's deal!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/48f3f8fda58cf41b79c92bb1635ce31755549614.jpg[/img]
"Without Daemons, there can be no Angels."
– Sanguinius, Primarch

Weekend deal! Stand against treachery with Sanguinius as he defends the Helios Gate! Don't miss the chance to get his alternate artwork, exclusive collector's card back and full deck in this weekend's time-limited deal!

To mark the occasion, his regular version will also be in the shop during the weekend.

notes.title: Event reinforcements arrive at the Gates of Terra!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/2bba5f5687aca87af5b6b8d3793e557087cd241c.jpg[/img]
"The walk of war has commenced."
– Princeps of Orientalis-Echion

Event reinforcements! New warlords join the battle for Helios Gate. The Ordo Sinister unleashes Orientalis-Echion, one of its dreaded Psi-Titans, to join the battle. Meanwhile, the bloodthirsty 12th Legion charge to the fray, lead by the terrifying might of their Primarch Angron. 

Choose your side at the Gates of Terra and fight! Your actions will determine which new Titan becomes collectable for the Loyalist Legios: the Imperator Magnificum Incendius or the Psi-Titan Orientalis-Echion.

notes.title: Reaver Volcano Cannon in shop
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/41ab21e60aec753af127b98917d9ba1e359d7b00.jpg[/img]
"We burn with this world."
– Princeps of Magnificum Incendius

For the first time, the devastatingly powerful Reaver Volcano Cannon of the Loyalist Legios features in the shop! Equip your Reaver titan with a weapon capable of turning tanks to dust, or obliterating enemy Titans with a single shot.

Make sure to pick up this legendary weapon today!

notes.title: Fight for the Loyalist Legios you want released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/e9898dbc69a54c15fc6392ee50ecb119ba0d93c2.jpg[/img]
"I am a monster made to fight monsters."
– Princeps of Orientalis-Echion

The chance to determine the 4th collectable warlord of the Loyalist Legios has arrived. If the loyalists prevail in the current timed event, they will unlock the mighty Magnificum Incendius. If the traitors win the event, the dreadful Psi-Titan Orientalis-Echion will become a collectable warlord instead.

Every player victory in the event contributes points towards the faction of the warlord they are playing. Choose your side and help determine the fate of the game!

As usual, the top 10 lodges will also receive the winning Warlord for as part of their reward crates. Fight to make your lodge stand amongst the greatest!

notes.title: Orphans of War Mission in shop today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/27a4474bfffd54f3af4f631094075d660ce61229.jpg[/img]
"No more running. No more hiding."
– Crysos Morturg

For the first time, the Orphans of War mission features in the in-game shop! Find the Legendary Blackshields among the offered cards and recruit your own myriad of Legions to your banner!

Orphans of War, or Blackshields as they were sometimes known, were made up of many different Legions. Some had grown disillusioned with their Primarch and Legion and fought for no one but themselves, while others simply wanted to survive in the treacherous landscape of the Horus Heresy.

notes.title: Sheed Ranko is available this weekend!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/7c13605cf73959ae4de2b44d1ee1d243f211b7c2.jpg[/img]
"I am one of many."
– Sheed Ranko
 
Uncover Captain Sheed Ranko for the first time in this time-limited deal, featuring a full deck commanded by the Lernaen Captain, and an exclusive collector's card back. Only this weekend!

Bringing countless hidden agents to fight against the Legion's foes, and sometimes the Legion itself, Sheed Ranko was a skilled and adept commander, responsible for the elite Terminator companies of the Legion.

Command the heads of the Hydra this weekend!

notes.title: New event: Gates of Terra!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/b639c3aae3ff4c3f5a9bbfdcdb534006c203e917.jpg[/img]
"Triumph or oblivion!"
– Princeps of Magnificum Incendius

The Traitors have established a strong foothold upon Terra! After their successful initial assault, Sanguinius has no choice but to open the Helios Gates and issue a counterattack. The Legiones Astartes and Titans march as one!

Will you fight to push back the Traitors and discover the brutal might of the Magnificum Incendius, or fight with the traitors and unlock the esoteric might of the Orientalis-Echion, an Ordo Sinister Psi-Titan?

notes.title: New Developer Q&A With SkuffD and Definitely Not Your Physics Teacher

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/a88597a88a0787743ce9fd8f0c8c74cda0434a48.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Fight in the Battle of Phall!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/4255e00436ab535ec6ddef57b381a582ca25729b.jpg[/img]
"Let us prove our domain of warcraft."
– Rogal Dorn

Test your mettle in the Battle of Phall single-player campaign and experience the story from the perspective of the Imperial Fists! Make sure to complete it and collect its rewards before it rotates in two weeks. Check out this video explaining everything you need to know about the Campaign game mode:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bZmU-1qFJGE

Are you ready to face challenges and reap glorious rewards anew? Play as the Imperial Fists against Perturabo and his Iron Warriors. Check out the details in the blog post:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/new-campaign-mode-battle-of-phall/

Be sure to read about the new Campaign Library feature below:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/new-campaign-library/ 

Embody the Imperial Fists, stand firm against the Emperor's foes and Kickstart your collection today!

notes.title: Introducing the Campaign Library
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/eda45ebc6fa432c9c9522fe758bf0ea2de7d8583.jpg[/img]
[i]"Glory matters nought to me."[/i]
– The Emperor of Mankind

Introducing the new Campaign Library! Browse the new feature and experience the story of the greatest warriors of the Horus Heresy through a series of single-player campaigns.

Find out more about the Campaign Library feature in the following blog post, including how to access unique, special offers and about the new Retry Battle option during campaign stages:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/new-campaign-library/

notes.title: Titanica Infernus arrives in shop!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/f4f968254452adb53734b6a6655d37079c4d733b.jpg[/img]
"I see only red."
– Princeps of Nuntio Dolores

For the first time, find the legendary Titanica Infernus in the shop today! By embracing the powers of the warp, the Titans of the Traitor Legios found themselves imbued with further strength. Corrupt your Titan by equipping Titanica Infernus and marshal the might of Chaos!

notes.title: The Lord of Shadows returns!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/92c743461c2beccf0acc9647d3febb682d9048ae.jpg[/img]
"I do what I must, not what I please."
– Corvus Corax, Primarch

The Lord of Shadows, Corvus Corax's alternate art, features in this weekend's deal to celebrate the Battle of Ravendelve! Get his premium deck to start playing with the Primarch of the Raven Guard and his exclusive collector's card back!

The regular version of Corvus Corax will also be available in the Shop today, so don't miss this opportunity to add him to your collection.

notes.title: Event reinforcements arrive!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/6cc3410000016a96b04620b3af1906f4ab8b6629.jpg[/img]
"This is about victory. True victory."
– Alpharius

Reinforcements arrive for Ravendelve! Corax, the Ravenlord himself, joins the battle in defending his Legion's future, while Alpharius (or Omegon) emerges from the shadows to cause more havoc and chaos in the Raven Guard midst.

Choose your side in the Battle of Ravendelve and decide the victor!

notes.title: August's balance changes are here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/3e2f3d05a9e83042619cb78da7ea49c595fbc677.jpg[/img]
"Judgement comes to us all."
– Lion El'Jonson

Balance changes arrive! The Dark Angels, first amongst peers, receive an array of changes as they step up their campaign against the Traitors, while several other factions receive balance tweaks, including the Emperor's Children and Titan Legios.

Check out the details in the latest [url=https://www.horusheresylegions.com/august-2022-balance-patch/]blog post[/url].

notes.title: July's Meta Report has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/8aad20fbda9d9e7fbc5598c725452ea14ae0cb15.jpg[/img]
"Give me your tears and blood."
– Nerat Kirine

The stats are in! With the Titandeath Expansion settling into the meta, we see one Warlord remain dominant, while others solidify their position at the top of the meta!

https://www.horusheresylegions.com/july-2022-meta-report/

Where does your favourite Warlord rank?

notes.title: August Tournament Announcements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/b241395a206e4534c87b67c61299a98a54a6b585.jpg[/img]
"Go on. Finish it."
– Tarik Torgaddon

The open tournaments for August have been announced! With multiple tournaments open to any player, all with gold prizes, as well as legendary cards for coming first. Make sure to check out the calendar, and log onto either Discord or VK.com to learn more! 

Check out the fixtures here:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/events/

notes.title: Dark Mechanicum cardback released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/12bf3b703c23531fdd9a97264ad72f9c15e4ec3a.jpg[/img]
"I see dark genius in you."
– Anacharis Scoria

After the traitor victory in the latest event, Schism of Mars, the new Dark Mechanicum cardback is available in the shop for the first time! Become one of Kelbor-Hal's adepts and show your allegiance to the traitor Mechanicum with this new cosmetic.

Don't miss this chance to add the new cardback to your collection!

notes.title: Steel Claw in shop today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/4c78dcc8ed182c88145f03f0a0cddb04f1016f28.jpg[/img]
"None can stand before us!"
– Princeps of Aurem Castigator

For the first time, find the Steel Claw in the shop today! A veteran Warhound-class Titan of the Legio Metalica, the Steel Claw was equipped primarily to deal with fortifications and enemy troop concentrations. Armed with twin Inferno Cannons, it was often found on the front lines, utilizing its rare configuration to best effect.

notes.title: Colonel Ornatov arrives!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/34bc43de15ac6f76fb468a3feabf716a88115956.jpg[/img]
"It's a glorious day!"
– Colonel Ornatov

Collect the new Solar Auxilia Legendary Mission and marshal the might of the Imperial Army with this time-limited deal, featuring a full 30 card deck commanded by Colonel Ornatov, and an exclusive card back. Only this weekend!

Commander of the Urslavik 12th Infantry, Colonel Ornatov fought alongside his men throughout the entirety of the Horus Heresy, remaining loyal to the Emperor.

Take control of the Imperial Army this weekend!

notes.title: New timed event: Battle of Ravendelve
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/3338998346063c6cd674c2f118caff5b7d58548e.jpg[/img]
"All is in place."
– Sheed Ranko

After the Dropsite Massacre, the Raven Guard retreated to Deliverance to rebuild their strength. Given the gift of pure Primarch DNA, the Raven Guard quickly became a target for the forces of the Warmaster. The Alpha Legion infiltrated the Raven Guard's homeworld and turned the local Mechanicum forces against them, forcing the 19th Legion to battle against both the might of the Mechanicum, and the insidious sabotage of the Alpha Legion.

Will you fight to defend Ravendelve, or assist the infiltrators? Whichever way the fighting goes, Sheed Ranko will be added to the game as a new collectable Warlord at the conclusion of the event!

notes.title: The Doctor is in!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/17c166bcb24f37a3e6fd037f939f6745efc849c5.jpg[/img]
"Quite a commendable action."
– Ireton MaSade

Once a medicae upon the world of Agathon, Aevos Jovan was conscripted into the Solar Auxilia after news of his illegal and dangerous experiments came to light. A healer of unmatched skill, Aevos Jovan would work tirelessly as Surgeon-Primus to protect his fellow soldiers, and the world of his home.

Find the notorious medicae officer in the shop today!

notes.title: The Primarch of the Luna Wolves flash sale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1a097f041963861869b8d9be1ef24b3428d29715.jpg[/img]
"The stars are our birthright."
– Horus Lupercal

As the Siege of Terra grows in ferocity, take a moment to commemorate the glorious days before the start of the Horus Heresy. Don't miss this chance to get Horus' alternate art, depicted as Primarch of the Luna Wolves at the height of the Great Crusade, with an exclusive collector's card back. Only for today!

Take the Emperor's preeminent son into battle and fight for the memory of the Imperium!

notes.title: Banelash arrives in the shop!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/8105baa58e061bcf193a2a26131eae3d1f30a325.jpg[/img]
"Where we walk, the Imperium ends."
– Dies Irae, Imperator

For the first time, the Traitor Legios feature in the in-game shop! Find the Legendary Banelash among the offered cards and take advantage of awakening your units!

A unique pattern of Questoris Knight, Banelash was the main steed for the corrupted Raeven Devine as he led his once noble house into the worship of Slaanesh. Will you be able to master the machine spirit?

notes.title: Ingethel Weekend Deal!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/34f76158c042db9cae3738e252c340fe4849c57f.jpg[/img]
"I have a vision of your doom."
– Ingethel the Ascended

Get the new Cultist Uprising legendary Mission and spread distress across the galaxy with this time-limited deal, featuring a full 30 card deck commanded by Ingethel, and an exclusive card back. Only this weekend!

Once a tribal priestess on the world of Cadia, bordering on the Eye of Terror, Ingethel was transformed by the might of the Chaos Gods to act as a guide to Lorgar and Argel Tal as they sought to uncover the truth behind reality. 

Will you master the powers of the Primordial Truth?

notes.title: Event Reinforcements arrive for the Schism of Mars!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/0369ca893682433738f3dd81a87c86c014c0c0ec.jpg[/img]
"Do you still think you're in control?"
– Remiare

Reinforcements land on Mars! Sigismund of the Imperial Fists leads a contingent of Astartes to secure vital supplies on the surface of Mars. Meanwhile, Kelbor-Hal deploys the infamous tech-assassin Remiare to eliminate those who would stand in his way!

Choose your side in the Schism of Mars and try out the new event reinforcements today!

notes.title: New Campaign: Shadow of the Warmaster
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/a5a9feafbf656b9e8febb380744f766e5f24f175.jpg[/img]
“You shall salute me.”
– Warmaster Horus Lupercal

Command the elite Sons of Horus Legion in the new campaign! Experience the many battles of the Warmaster's Legion, from the Dropsite Massacre at Isstvan, all the way to Horus' confrontation with Leman Russ in the Trisolian system. Take control of Tybalt Marr during his hunt for the Shattered Legions following Isstvan V, marshal the strength of the Justaerin as Abaddon conquers Molech, and command the Warmaster as he lays siege to the Trisolian system and faces the Space Wolves.

Learn all about the new campaign in the latest blog post:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/sons-of-horus-campaign/

Take command of the XVIth Legion and earn great rewards to fill the ranks of your Sons of Horus collection! Overcome the final challenge and you will receive an exclusive legendary card back.

notes.title: The Old General lands on the battlefield
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/a6d291b58ad38518d7e1ff02d6b9b618b7a75bcb.jpg[/img]
"Quite a commendable action."
– Ireton MaSade

For the first time since his release into the game, you can find the Old General, Ireton MaSade, in today's Veteran shop! Keep the Solar Auxilia in fighting shape with his powerful buffing ability, and summon the famous 1522nd Cohort to conquer the battlefield.

notes.title: Shadow Wars Event Winners
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/5440d9a80f6f576e98d31a394773cea81e4653e7.png[/img]
"A new level of cunning."
– Tybalt Marr

As the armies of the Emperor, Warmaster and renegades clashed in the shadows across the galaxy, it was the traitor forces who finally took the upper hand. With the might of the Ruinstorm, Sons of Horus and Alpha Legion, the balance of power tipped in favour of the Warmaster and they were able to claim victory.

Congratulations to the top lodges in the event! Traitor victory means that the House Makabius cosmetic badge is added to the game. Don't forget to claim your rewards!

notes.title: Become the Fabricator-General!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/3b3c0416233dc377bc693ff5b9243134769ec4b1.jpg[/img]
"Don't fear technology."
– Kelbor-Hal

Master the might of the Mechanicum with the power of the Fabricator-General at your fingertips! With the outbreak of the Horus Heresy, fully half of the Mechanicum followed Kelbor-Hal into treachery with the Warmaster. Add the Fabricator-General to your collection with the new time-limited deck deal, featuring a full deck including the legendary Machine Spirit Mission and an exclusive cardback. Only this weekend!

Can you tame the machine-spirits of Mars?

notes.title: New event: Schism of Mars
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/cfbb3c326cb441fd1e2eefad4b63cb1d0a2ee125.jpg[/img]
"Rust never sleeps."
– Kelbor-Hal

Even at the heart of the Imperium, the Warmaster's betrayal causes chaos and mayhem. Civil war erupts on Mars, where the Fabricator-General, Kelbor-Hal, and many of his fellow Forge Lords, pledge loyalty to Horus Lupercal. A series of devastating battles take place across the Red Planet, with Knights, Titans and Mechanicum adepts all marching to war against one another.

Will you be able to survive this treachery? Play in the new event, Schism of Mars, and test the new neutral cards in battle!

notes.title: Titandeath Crates released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/c09e59e84c80d4c9ce8ca0afc59f6b84e5fa03d7.jpg[/img]
"No more running. No more hiding."
– Crysos Morturg

The final batch of cards in the Titandeath expansion is now available in the game, bringing new neutral troops and tactics which can be used to strengthen any deck!

With their release comes the arrival of the Titandeath crates, which provides 5 cards from among those released in this expansion, including the new neutral cards, the Loyalist and Traitor Legios, and the new cards for the 6 factions reinforced in the previous batch.

Learn all about them in the announcement post:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/titandeath-neutral-cards-release/

Choose your side!

notes.title: The final cards of Titandeath arrive soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/418c9cbe99dc6b1a0a894fbd36a7ad3be22097a3.jpg[/img]
"Loyalty is a dangerous word these days."
– Thaddeus Fayle

Get ready for the final cards of the Titandeath expansion arriving to he game on Friday, 15th July!

This batch brings new neutral cards and a legendary Mission for each of the 3 neutral factions: Imperial Army, Mechanicum and Chaos! Check out the details:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/titandeath-neutral-cards-release/

Looking to get a head start? Check out the card reveals by your favourite content creators, now brought together into a Youtube playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLyCOhtGUOzRygn_HmqDqCyQDj2OpDx_mk 

The new content will become available on Friday 15th July, at 9am UTC. Get ready!

notes.title: The final wave of Titandeath approaches!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/208f4b1b9ab2e373a4af53566c2742d40aeac165.jpg[/img]
"The fight for justice never ends."
– Ireton MaSade

The Titandeath expansion will conclude with new cards for Chaos, Imperial Army and the Mechanicum on 15th July, including the first neutral Mission cards!

Your favourite content creators will be unveiling some of the upcoming cards. Check out the schedule and join the premiere!
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/titandeath-neutral-card-reveals/

notes.title: The Harbinger of Vermin arrives!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/826eee38044ca51d5495530223a1cf649fd5aa8f.jpg[/img]
"Welcome to my world of rot!"
– Cor'bax Utterblight

The Harbinger of Vermin is in the shop today for the first time! Make sure to pick up this sturdy daemon of Nurgle who is able to poison your enemies, and heal your own board at the same time! 

For Chaos!

notes.title: Weekend Deal: The Red Angel arrives!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/8aa34a54c9b497709338a80f15625c61ff529424.jpg[/img]
"I am bound to the ruin of all things."
– The Red Angel

Harness the power of the Ragefire with the Red Angel! When Meros of the Blood Angels sacrificed himself to save Sanguinius from the corruption of the warp, he was transformed into a vengeful daemonhost. Add the Red Angel to your collection with the new time-limited deck deal, featuring a full 30 card deck including the legendary Lord of Chaos Mission and an exclusive cardback. Only this weekend!

Can you endure the Ragefire?

notes.title: Event Reinforcements arrive!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/3f29407e3893d4a6b94ef240d17bd2e89968a34d.jpg[/img]
"Should you really trust those besides you?"
– Sheed Ranko

New forces join the event! The forces of Chaos take the upper hand across the many skirmishes of the Shadow Wars, however reinforcements arrive for both sides of the conflict. Iapto, Knight-Errant of the Agents of the Sigillite, brings his hidden talents to bare, while Sheed Ranko of the Alpha Legion reveals himself and his infiltrating agents!

Try out the new event reinforcements today, and choose your side!

notes.title: Update v2.2.8 has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/fb2df25f2a16ca7ed8d181b6b31d343b6473bc76.jpg[/img]
"I have come back from worse."
– Crysos Morturg

Update v2.2.8 has been released on all platforms, with several fixes for common issues and adding in the Loyalist and Traitors to the Challenge crate selection.

- The new armies, Loyalist and Traitor Legios, can now be selected as preferred faction for Challenge crates
- Improve UI of cosmetics in Shop, particularly for warlord chats
- Fix for Ancient of Death error when not enough cards in deck
- Fix for Ordnance damage being applied to other abilities or effects by the card
- Fix Titan Weapons order in Collection, so that they appear sorted by card name
- Fix for summoning Knight Weapons with a health buff from hand
- Fix interaction of Malcharion's ability with King of terrors and Irresistible Charisma
- Fix position of Knights weapons in battle, on iOS devices

notes.title: The June Meta Report has arrived
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/0096e7131ec96c76bff3896accc87ed28f63aeb7.jpg[/img]
"Do you really think you can beat me?"
– Lucius

The stats are in! The newly released Titan Legios make their first showing on the meta report, but one Warlord claims the top spot in both High and Low Terra. Where does your favourite Warlord rank?

Take a look at this month's meta report:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/june-2022-meta-report/

Did your favourite warlord make the list?

notes.title: The Aquilon Guard have arrived!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/934e38fc5dbddfb1cd24fe2d441dbcb724ca83c4.jpg[/img]
"I shall never falter."
– Debeeran Kalimakon

Plated in the mightiest armour of the Legio Custodes, the Aquilon Guard were the elite bodyguard of the Emperor himself. Tasked with ensuring no harm befell his person, they were armed with the deadliest weaponry and strongest protection available.

Don't miss this chance to add the new troop to your collection!

notes.title: July Tournament Fixtures are open!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/99aa73bce6e3994b1e8490dcacafd76d6c3356cf.jpg[/img]
"Ha! Now for the next one."
– Jangsai Khan

The open tournaments for July have been announced! With multiple tournaments open to any player, all with gold prizes, as well as legendary cards for coming first. Make sure to check out the calendar, and log onto either Discord or VK.com to learn more! 

Check out the fixtures here:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/events/

notes.title: Legio Vulpa Badge in the shop!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/0056a82cedb11a2c75d0cdea1e78051796b59b1a.jpg[/img]
"No more quiet. No more idleness."
– Princeps of Nuntio Dolores

The new Legio Vulpa badge is available in the shop today. Tame the corrupt, molten heart of your Engine and march to war! 

Don't miss this chance to add the new badge to your collection!

notes.title: The Traitors Break the Needle!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/e407c873a6a296172900e627c44795a5eea65546.jpg[/img]
"Unlimited firepower!"
– Princeps of Dies Irae

With the immense firepower of the Traitor Legios marching as a unified force, there was little the Loyalist forces could do to slow down their inevitable victory. Even the might of Legio Solaria was battered aside by the wrath of the fallen Chaos Titans. The Needle was broken, and Horus had his victory.

Congratulations to the top lodges in the event! Traitor victory means that the Legio Vulpa cosmetic badge is added to the game. Don't forget to claim your rewards!

notes.title: June's Season Winners
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/d79e05d79c834714a8e293b5850469e909f216c1.png[/img]
“Let the trial begin.”
– Melaena Verdath

June's competitive season is at an end, and a new Warmaster has risen to the top. Congratulations to all the winners!

All players with 500 or more rating have received a reward crate based on their division, with the top 200 players worldwide getting the best prizes. All players on Terra will also have their rating reset to 2500, and all points above 2500 are converted to Legendary Points.

Claim your rewards and get ready for a new competition! Which warlords will you ascend through the ranks with?

notes.title: Crysos Morturg time limited deal!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/f074d0579c3e31effa1b790b61d1f021a1f9879f.jpg[/img]
"No more running. No more hiding."
– Crysos Morturg

Become a true Blackshield with the brand new Warlord for the Orphans of War, Crysos Morturg. Originally a Death Guard, he has forsaken his loyalty to his Legion and now fights for vengeance! Add Morturg to your collection with the new time-limited deck deal, featuring a full 30 card deck including the legendary Blackshield Mission and an exclusive cardback. Only this weekend!

Will you survive the horrors of the galaxy?

notes.title: New timed event: Shadow Wars
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/5d96a867714eec2de74bfe67c350527d109956d7.jpg[/img]
"There is no turning back now."
– Debeeran Kalimakon

Across the galaxy, battles were waged not only by the might of the Legiones Astartes, but also by those who the Imperial records would not remember. Both sides of the war, and those caught in the midst of the fighting, embarked on secret missions that pitted loyalist, traitor and renegades against one another in brutal, small-scale skirmishes.

Test out the new cards from the third wave of the Titandeath expansion in the new Shadow Wars event!

notes.title: Get ready for the third wave of the Titandeath expansion!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/239025e8367c6a885e2d879aabeada7e84c7cca1.jpg[/img]

[i]"Any last words?"[/i]
– Crysos Morturg, Blackshield Captain

Get ready for the third wave of the Titandeath expansion!

This wave brings new cards and a legendary Mission for 6 different factions: Legio Custodes, Sisters of Silence, Agents of the Sigillite, Orphans of War, Knight Houses and Daemons of the Ruinstorm, plus a new collectable warlord for three of them. Check out the details!
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/titandeath-wave-3-announcement/

Looking to get a head start? Check out the card reveals by your favourite content creators, now brought together into a Youtube playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLyCOhtGUOzRyD_MaCQj-90VGiEa7qxuDz

The new content is now available in the game. Join in and choose your side!

notes.title: New White Scars Campaign: Path of Heaven
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-K7ySnsCyaA;full][/previewyoutube]
“Someone must ride beyond the horizon.”
– Targutai Yasugai

Take command of the masterful Qin Xa, Chief Stormseer Targutai Yasugai and the legendary Jaghatai Khan as the Vth Legion fights through both their former brothers and daemonic forces! Will you be able to save the Legion, and defeat the Lord of Death himself?

Learn all about the new campaign in the latest blog post:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/white-scars-campaign/

Take command of the Vth Legion and earn great rewards to kickstart your White Scars collection! Overcome the final challenge and you will receive an exclusive legendary card back.

notes.title: Ride with the White Scars!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/a7ffc72b0fdc4d0db8f11151fb765baee83bd59d.jpg[/img]
“This turmoil is not natural.”
– Targutai Yasugei

Trapped behind the lines of Horus' conquests, the White Scars Legion begins a series of hit and run attacks against traitor supply lines. After years of fighting, the Khan makes the decision that they are to return to Terra and stand alongside his loyal brothers, but will they be able to survive the trap laid for them by the traitors?

Ready your engines and prepare to open a path in the void for the White Scars tomorrow with the release of their new campaign!

notes.title: The Scavenger King arrives in shop
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/a884b35d789850a4091d850e550ac237820915c1.jpg[/img]
"My agents have already infiltrated your ranks."
– Alpharius

Sork, the self proclaimed Scavenger King, is in the shop today! A pirate operating in the Sol System, Sork was utilized as an Alpha Legion asset during their Assault on Pluto in the early stages of the Horus Heresy. Make sure to pick him up and use him to smuggle new troops into your hand!

Are you Alpharius?

notes.title: The Third Wave of the Titandeath Expansion is Coming
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/cfe7d146a277326cd1f5fc8414c53988aca4f0f4.jpg[/img]
"With courage, we bring the Emperor's judgement."
– Melaena Verdath

Reinforcements arrive for six existing factions, including new Warlords, Legendary Missions and a slew of troops and tactics! Make sure to check out the blog post below to see which new Warlords will be arriving, and which content creators you can check out to catch the reveals! 

https://www.horusheresylegions.com/titandeath-expansion-third-wave/

notes.title: Nuntio Dolores marches to war!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/2012b6fc5bd4304c6c084d5ce404aa66c7aa4c70.jpg[/img]
"Mine is the gift of brass and blood!"
– Nuntio Dolores, Legio Vulpa Warlord

Become the Butcher of Biphex! Embrace the power of Legio Vulpa and command the wrath of the Nuntio Dolores in the battlefield. Customize this Warlord-class Titan to either destroy your foes at range, or crush them with your power claws! Find Nuntio Dolores with a full 30 card deck including the legendary Banelash troop and a legendary cardback in this weekend's time-limited deal!

Will you embrace the will of Chaos?

notes.title: Event Reinforcements arrive!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/bf55e8f125001f0279d96b3de9a90785216c07dd.jpg[/img]
"Eternity is for the strong."
– Excoriator Vita, Warmaster of Legio Mortis

As the Traitor Legios reap a devastating tally against the Loyalists defending the Needle, further reinforcements stream into the battlezone. Excoriator Vita, the Iconoclast Warmaster of Legio Mortis, marches to war! The agile Legio Solaria responds to the assault with a fast moving Reaver, hoping to stem the traitors assault.

Try out the new event reinforcements today, and choose your side!

notes.title: Dies Irae Balance Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/3918589898e8dce6c60c06dff1242c7b717c2ddc.jpg[/img]
"May the Warmaster watch over us."
– Dies Irae, Legio Mortis Imperator

Balance changes arrive! The Dies Irae receives several balance changes to check its dominance in Ranked and Event play, alongside the Hatred Unbound receiving an improved ability. Two important neutral cards also receive changes which may affect the performance of many Titan decks.

Check out the details:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/dies-irae-june-2022-balance-patch

notes.title: The Hand of Ruin arrives!
notes.content:

"God of war, save me from peace."
– Nuntio Dolores, Legio Vulpa Warlord

Make sure to pick up the Hand of Ruin Traitor Legios troop today in the shop! A veteran Reaver Titan who fought alongside the Sons of Horus on multiple occasions, including amongst the battlefields of Istvaan III and V. Will you be able to harness it's awakened machine-spirit?

For the Warmaster!

notes.title: Nuntio Dolores in shop today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/27818b560bf937b2698d630d25e97573907df8ae.jpg[/img]
"The Blood God smiles today."
– Nuntio Dolores, Legio Vulpa Warlord

Find the new Traitor Warlord Titan, Nuntio Dolores, in the veteran shop for the first time today! Equip it with the devastating Quake Cannon, or build him to crush your opponents with brutal melee weapons!

For the Warmaster!

notes.title: New timed event: Breaking the Needle!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/baad3d586792e5795755dbaa04026d5384cc4951.jpg[/img]
"Well done, you just became a priority target."
– Princeps of Dies Irae

The Traitor Legios launch a devastating assault on the Needle upon the surface of Beta-Garmon II, an Astropathic choir responsible for communications with Terra! Can the forces of the Imperium hope to withstand such a brutal attack from the Titans of the Fallen Legios? Reports have arrived that an Imperator Titan of Legio Mortis leads the attack!

Test the new Traitor Legios and their new mechanic, Awakened! Each reward crate in the event includes a guaranteed card from the Traitor Legios, so it's also the perfect way to build your collection. Join the fight!

notes.title: Hatred Unbound Starter Deck
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/2bea7cc71b14c8f6ddc8308c39bfc6d96b9b3774.jpg[/img]
"All will be engulfed in our flame!"
– Hatred Unbound, Legio Magna Reaver

Tame the corrupt machine-spirit of the Hatred Unbound Reaver Titan in this fully playable 30-card deck! Raise the banner of Legio Magna with its exclusive card back and, for a limited time, celebrating the release of the Traitor Legios faction, get 200 extra coins with it!

For the Warmaster!

notes.title: Traitor Legios now available in game!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/4aa67be13dec78a560c7edbcb9053eb0cf1ff878.jpg[/img]

– Princeps of Dies Irae

Tame their possessed engines and start collecting them through special faction crates, their starter deck and many other in-game rewards. Log into the game and start building your own daemonic Titan!

Changed by the ruinous powers and aided by the Warmaster, the Titans of the Legios that turned against the Emperor arrive to the game as the second new faction of the Titandeath expansion. Command them into the many battlefields of the Galaxy and get ready to triumph and bring oblivion to your enemies.

Learn all about them in the announcement post:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/traitor-legios-release/

For the Warmaster!

notes.title: The Traitor Legios are coming
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ZR2hvTHDqkc;full][/previewyoutube]
"Where we walk, the Imperium ends."
– Princeps of the Dies Irae

The Traitor Legios join the battle tomorrow, ready to face their Loyalist counterparts. Check out the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZR2hvTHDqkc]trailer[/url], and read all about the corrupted Engines of War in the latest [url=https://www.horusheresylegions.com/traitor-legios-release/]blog post[/url].

notes.title: June's Balance Changes arrive!

notes.title: Decimate your foes with Death Pulse!

For the Omnissiah!

notes.title: The Traitor Legios arrive!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/401da705489ace0f8ef18c4b522f3d950daabb97.jpg[/img]

https://www.horusheresylegions.com/traitor-legios-announcement/

notes.title: Ireton MaSade arrives in this weekend's special deal!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/b31ce22429da5804d4146c968b846002ee343d24.jpg[/img]

Following the success of all players beating the Titans from Legio Mortis in the latest raid, the Old General arrives as a collectable warlord, rallying and inspiring the Solar Auxilia under his command. Get Ireton MaSade and his legendary card back as part of a full deck in this weekend's special deal! 

Can you marshal the forces of the Imperium and punish the traitors for their crimes?

notes.title: Event Reinforcements for the Battle of Paramar
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/a29488fdef893bf32d5865bf26665b6d32890b18.jpg[/img]
"You are in my hunting grounds."
– Luxor Invictoria

Event reinforcements! The battle of Paramar intensifies by the minute. The loyalist side has taken the advantage during the first part of the battle, but the traitors are not to dwindle in their efforts to invade the planet.

New forces join the battle. The Luxor Invictoria Warlord-Class Titan joins the loyalist side, while the traitors will attempt to sabotage their enemies after Ingo Pech comes to their aid.

notes.title: The New Titan Builder Feature
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/bee81cc82d99cfa9e25b4080b63f66b09d48d449.jpg[/img]
“Take aim! Turn them into cinders!”
– Princeps of Domine Ex Venari

notes.title: Become a Princeps with the new Expansion Starter Bundle

Become the Princeps of the mighty Sabris Regnum and grind your foes beneath your tread with the new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1985190]Expansion Starter Bundle[/url] only available on Steam.

In this bundle you will find a 30 card deck commanded by the Sabris Regnum Warlord-class Titan, an exclusive Legio Praesagius cardback, 500 coins and early access to the Loyalist Legio's faction crates if purchased before the faction's release on the 2nd June.

This Bundle is offered as a DLC. After purchasing the DLC, open the game on Steam and claim its contents. Be among the first to command the full might of the Loyalist Titan Legios a full day before any other players!

Remember that accounts are not locked to a particular platform. If you usually play on a smartphone, just register your account and you will then be able to log in on Steam to take advantage of this offer.

Hail the Legio Praesagius!

notes.title: New expansion: Titandeath
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/4a6c1669096af6d4f7cc7c3d73a99f133980bf1c.jpg[/img]
[i]“Let slip the dogs of war.”[/i]
– Domine Ex Venari, Legio Solaria Reaver 

Build and command your very own Titan in the next major content expansion for The Horus Heresy: Legions, Titandeath! Check out the new trailer:
[previewyoutube=e81twNEz8YA;full][/previewyoutube]
The Horus Heresy rages across the galaxy, and none are to be found wanting in the galactic-scale conflict. Titan Legions, often held back in reserve are now being let loose upon their foes. This will be represented by two new factions, one being the Loyalist Titan Legios, and the other being the Traitor Titan Legios. Six non-Legion factions will also be receiving new reinforcements to complement their strategies!

Are you ready to become a Princeps and harness the power of the God-Machines? Take a look at the latest [url=https://www.horusheresylegions.com/new-expansion-titandeath/]blog post[/url] for all the information about the expansion.

https://www.horusheresylegions.com/steam-broadcast-titandeath/

notes.title: Rogal Dorn fortifies Terra

New Titan Raid event! With the Sanctum Imperialis in sight, Horus unleashes the forces of Legio Mortis against Mercury Wall! notes.title: Update v2.2.3 release notes
notes.content:
Update v2.2.3 release notes
"The skalds will sing of today for eternity."
– Bulveye Greybeard

Update v2.2.3 has been released on all platforms, with several fixes for common issues, as well as preparing the game for the upcoming raid event:
- Fix automated messages related to mentoring so that they appear in the language of the reader, not the sender
- Fix error in list view in Collection
- Fix error in edge case when trying to accept a Recruit that cannot be accepted 
- Automatically remove blank spaces at end of password and email when signing in & registering, to avoid login errors
- Fix error in small description in Collection when changing Energy filter
- Fix edge case when a troop dying due to damage from Sentenced could still be targeted
- Prevent players blocked in chat from sending match invites

notes.title: March Balance Patch Arrives!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/4ad3a0adb66e94eb4d6b56e317879805a9e2a986.jpg[/img]
"You can't run forever!"
– Ekezyle Abaddon

The March balance changes arrives! The Heresy continues unabated, and several Legions update their playstyles and tactics to adapt to the new reality. Some strong cards have been tuned down, while several Warlords and missions that have seen little play return to the battlefield with powerful changes to their abilities.

IMPERIAL FISTS
● Rogal Dorn: Lower Reckoning cost from 30 to 25
● Sons of Dorn: Mission becomes "Start your turn with Astartes with Front Line in play, 4 times" (instead of 5 times)
● Stone Gauntlet: Lower cost from 4 to 3
● Resolve of Stone: Description becomes "Give Front Line until next turn and Bastion 6 to a friendly unit" (instead of Bastion 4)

SONS OF HORUS
● Serghar Targost: Lower health from 7 to 6
● Muster for Lupercal: Lower number Abakhol Squads put in play from 6 to 5

BLOOD ANGELS
● Sons of Baal: Mission becomes "A friendly troop triggers Requiem, 4 times" (instead of 5 times)
● Grieving Pain: Gains additional effect of giving Survivor 5 to your Warlord 

RAVEN GUARD
● Shadow Killers: Increase cost from 5 to 6

WORD BEARERS
● Blessed Son: Cost is now reduced by 3 instead of 2 when Argel Tal kills an unit

THOUSAND SONS
● Magistus Amon: Lower cost of ability from 2 to 1 Psychic Energy

IMPERIAL ARMY
● Displaced Civilians: Increase cost from 0 to 1

MECHANICUM
● Tacitus Proctor: Ability becomes (2) Put in play two Servo-automata

CHAOS
● Chaos Spawn: Gains "Reduce Maintenance of friendly Daemons by 2"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/e348bde5b3b0423093560531328b5b74dbbbba63.jpg[/img]
"Have you finished? Good."
– Gendor Skraivok

Eager to test his daemonic sword in battle, Gendor Skraivok makes his first appearance in the shop today! Add him to your collection and lead the Night Lord contingent against Terra.

Known as The Painted Count for his noble ancestry and use of war paints, Gendor was one of the first atop the walls during the Siege of Terra. There, he fought against First Captain Raldoron of the Blood Angels in single combat.

Don't miss your chance to become the Painted Count!

notes.title: Pick your side and fight for the Warlord you want!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/004af7d880aa131b62dc8660547317d34f8ce660.jpg[/img]
"My strength returns."
– Kor Phaeron

Draft a deck combining the power of two different Legions and choose which new Warlord will join the collection! Choose your side in the A Chance Encounter special multi-faction event and decide each Legion's future! 

Every event victory contributes points to the faction of the warlord being used. At the end of the current event, either Kor Phaeron or Drakus Gorod will become collectable for the faction with the most points. The losing faction will receive its 5th Warlord later down the line. Loyalists or traitors, which side will you help get a new Warlord earlier?

The battle has only started. Pick a side and fight for it!

notes.title: Find the Chosen of Khorne in the shop today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/8b286c82731837e9c9adb3ec809c9f4db8e508f0.jpg[/img]
"Defeat? Never!"
– Angron

The World Eaters have forever teetered on the edge of madness, and with the rebellion of Horus, they were forever marked by the Chaos God Khorne. Always a terrifying opponent to face on the battlefield, they waged war as a horde of bloodthirsty berzerks.

Take up your Chainaxe and find Chosen of Khorne, the new legendary mission card, in today's shop!

notes.title: Exclusive Fafnir Rann time limited weekend deal!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/ec9c019ce50885b964be6b6f865d7f5a01a8d4e9.jpg[/img]
"Honour and death!"
– Fafnir Rann

Get Fafnir Rann, the new Imperial Fists warlord, as part of a premium deck in a time-limited deal including the legendary Archamus card and an exclusive collector's card back, only this weekend!

Fafnir Rann, Lord of the First Assault Cadre of the Imperial Fists and sworn sword brother of Sigismund, joins the game this weekend fresh from his battle in Nyrcon City. Take up his blades and lead your warriors into combat against the traitors!

notes.title: Unite the Legions in the new Chance Encounter event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/b5acdb463d583fe51403d950eda10b1b413007e8.jpg[/img]
"This is your last warning."
– Drakus Gorod

Choose your side and combine the strengths of two factions under the same banner in the new event: A Chance Encounter! The Warmaster's plans kept many Legions away from the battle's front, disrupting their ways to reach Terra. In the Warp and in the void, these Legions worked together both to hunt their prey and to beat back their assailants. 

Pick a Warlord, select an allied faction and draft a deck with cards from both factions! Hone your drafting skills and get ready to discover unexpected card combinations.

Check out all the details in the latest web post:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/a-chance-encounter/

notes.title: February Season Cardbacks revealed!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/4493ab85ac14865965c7ab652f164ccc7efa0900.jpg[/img]
"You were made to be ruled."
– Malcador

The Seal of the Sigillite was a powerful symbol of authority that gave his Knight-Errants and chosen servants unfettered access to anything within the Imperium. This ultimate authority is represented in this month's cardback.

Join the fight for the title of Warmaster and these exclusive card backs! At the end of this month, the top 1, 10 and 50 players on the Leaderboard will receive one of these seasonal cosmetics to mark their achievement.

notes.title: The Ordu of Jaghatai arrives in store!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/785819455bed683d92c74ded2e73d1688a350f98.jpg[/img]
"Ha! Now for the next one."
– Jangsai Khan

The White Scars had always kept to themselves, operating beyond Imperial lines in their effort to hunt down their enemies. During the Heresy, they developed a reputation for rapid hit and run assaults with lightning quick jetbike or speeder squads.

Ride like the wind, and find the White Scars legendary mission card in the shop today!

notes.title: Constantin Valdor Returns!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/87a8576c8d94fc8ef2c6799c0e31461ffeae9694.jpg[/img]
"Eternal loyalty!"

notes.title: Pick up the Emperor's Children Legendary Mission in store today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/f023c363e3e0ae862674527539b22e1ef61cd884.jpg[/img]
"Death by noise!"
– Marius Vairosean

As the Emperor's Children fell into the many armed grasp of the Dark Prince, they became twisted mockeries of their noble selves. Hedonistic and arrogant, obsessed with obtaining corrupt perfection, they became a parody of their once proud name.

Submit to the warp and find the Chosen of Slaanesh mission card in the shop today!

notes.title: Lucius takes to the field of battle to show off his swordmanship!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/a7e714d2a321c435959ffa79047876fa7f8f3846.jpg[/img]
"You are outclassed. You should know that."
– Lucius

Lucius, master swordsman of the Emperor's Children arrives to show off his amazing alternate art, astounding all with his grace and launching himself into battle like never before! Discover his new voice lines and exclusive collector's card back. 

Don't miss the chance to get this alternate artwork as part of a premium deck in a time-limited deal this weekend! To mark the occasion, his normal version will also be available in the shop during the weekend.

Give praise to the Lord of Excess and revel in Lucius' mastery of the blade!

notes.title: Event Reinforcements arrive for the Battle for Nyrcon City!

notes.title: Blood Angels Legendary Mission in Store
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/2382a285f656d55a9a3fd2d3eba336ad97c57494.jpg[/img]
"The future can be changed."
– Sanguinius

The Blood Angels were a Legion known for their controlled ferocity on the field. However, this fury came from a mutation in their genes which risked turning them into maniac berserkers. Watching their battle-brothers fall in combat could trigger the urge to give in to their baser nature. 

Get your hands on the legendary mission, Sons of Baal, and embrace the rage of the Red Angel!

notes.title: The Custodians enhance their gear in the new balance update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/dbc0b5378b1d5483fae39f22b57b7b0951698e2e.jpg[/img]
[i]"Patience is a weapon."[/i]
– Vettranio Shapura

The Legio Custodes return in the new force in the new balance patch. With upgraded gear and renewed purpose, the Emperor's true firstborn warriors are ready to defend the Imperium against any menace. This balance update also sees some changes to missions that felt unsatisfying to play. 

Keep reading or check the latest [url=https://www.horusheresylegions.com/february-2022-balance-changes/ ]blog post[/url] for all the details.

[b]LEGIO CUSTODES[/b]
● Vettranio Shapura: Change description to "Battle Honour: Draw a card. (1) Gain Shield"
● Imperial Bureaucrat: Change description to "Resolution: Draw a card"
● Imperial Emissary: Lower cost of ability from 2 to 1
● Diocleton: Increase stats from 3/4 to 4/4
● Neron Squad: Increase stats from 4/3 to 5/3
● Velt Squad: Increase stats from 3/4 to 3/5, and lower cost of ability from 2 to 1
● Ephoroi Squad: Increase stats from 5/3 to 5/4
● Eratin Squad: Increase stats from 3/5 to 4/5
● The Emperor's Gift: Increase stats from 3/5 to 3/6, and lower cost of ability from 2 to 1
● Adsulton: Increase stats from 5/7 to 6/8
● Tribune: Increase stats from 6/6 to 7/7, and changed the description to "First Strike. Sentinel. Battle Honour: Draw a Custodes from your deck"
● Shield of the Imperium: Change description to "Resolution: Draw a Custodes from your deck"
● Praesidium Shield: Lower cost from 4 to 2
● Only in Death: It now adds the Telemon Dreadnought to your hand instead of your deck
● Benediction of the Emperor: Change description to "Give Survivor 3 to your units. Your next troop or Tactic costs 0"

[b]EMPEROR'S CHILDREN[/b]
● Lucius: Increase Health from 30 to 35
● Chosen of Slaanesh: Lower requirement from 10 to 8
● Fueled by Desire: Now gives +1/0 to your Warlord when played

[b]RAVEN GUARD[/b]
● Gherith Arendi: Change ability to "(2) Give Sentenced 1 to an enemy this turn. If target is a troop, deal 1 damage to it"
● Captain Kyrin: Remove Rally effect

[b]WORD BEARERS[/b]
● Lorgar: Lower cost of Whispers of Chaos to 16, but lower cost reduction to -2 for each Daemon in play
● Chosen of the Gods: Lower requirement from 5 to 4

[b]IRON HANDS[/b]
● Sons of Medusa: Lower requirement from 8 to 6
● Master of Mechanisms: Change description to "Your Warlord gains 'Your Vehicles cost 3 less'"

[b]SALAMANDERS[/b]
● Nomus Rhy'tan: No longer gains +1/0 when playing a Teaching

[b]WORLD EATERS[/b]
● Chosen of Khorne: Lower requirement from 12 to 9

[b]SPACE WOLVES[/b]
● Sons of Fenris: Lower requirement from 10 to 8

[b]MECHANICUM[/b]
● Xanathite Abeyant: Deal 1 damage 4 times instead of 5

[b]OTHER[/b]
● Remove Mission cards from the pool of cards that can be created randomly (eg. by Crucial Choice or Kai Zulane)
● Barricade: Change card faction from Imperial Army to Iron Warriors

Fafnir Rann will join the collection at the end of this event, with a different chat line depending on its outcome. Will you join the loyalist assault or become the bane of the Imperium?

notes.title: Fires of Nocturne new trailer
notes.content:
Check out the new trailer for the Fires of Nocturne single player campaign! 
[previewyoutube=yCfmKuI051o;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yCfmKuI051o[/previewyoutube]

[i]"You are beneath me. In every way."[/i]
– Vulkan

There's still time to play the latest single-player campaign and earn an exclusive legendary card back! 

Although crippled and beaten to near death, the Salamanders never gave up hope and determination to survive, and reforge themselves in the fires of their Creed. Vulkan never surrendered or paused in his journey to Terra, just as Numeon fought through hell to reach Nocturne. Failure never crossed the mind of Nomus Rhy'tan as he defended their homeworld from the Death Guard. 

Embody the endless strength of the Eighteenth Legion and defeat Magnus the Red in the final days of the campaign!

New single-player campaign! Since their brutal decimation at Isstvan V, the Salamanders have been fighting to consolidate their strength upon Nocturne and enable them to return to the war. notes.title: The Eternity Gate must not fall
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1b5dc1ac98d6e3a0d89e70d52b374d84effebc0c.jpg[/img]
"Another day, another battle."
– Saul Niborran

The traitors advance towards the Eternity Gate Spaceport. Hosts of World Eaters charge, imbued by Khorne's bloodthirst, as Terra's defenders prepare to make their last stand before them. The Eternity Wall must not fall!

Test a new event Warlord and the fourth wave's neutral cards in the new event, Safeguarding Eternity. Will you join the carnage as the traitor invaders or as the loyalists in the wall's forlorn defence?

notes.title: Galaxy in Flames: Wave IV release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/200f2af6079fb1f526b80fa7b16ead8b537f53a7.jpg[/img]
"How do you rank in the chain of command?"
– Saul Niborran

While the bloodiest of fighting was done by the Legiones Astartes, the bulk of the war was waged by the Imperial Army, Mechanicum and traitor elements. Millions fought against once comrades, while allied forge worlds tore each other apart, and Chaos cults sprung up on hundreds of loyalist worlds. 

Take a look at how to collect the cards from the fourth wave and at the new event in the latest [url=https://www.horusheresylegions.com/galaxy-in-flames-wave-iv/]blog post[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/eeede1a491daf3c32e5f9e1499012261d4be4e5d.jpg[/img]

[h3]NEW CARDS FOR THE NEUTRAL FACTIONS[/h3]
For the more human elements of the loyalist and traitor forces, the war continued as it ever did. Countless Imperial Army contingents were sent to numerous warzones to fight for either Horus or the Emperor. The Mechanicum was decisively split in twain, with half following the original teachings of the Omnissiah and staying loyal to the Emperor and new Fabricator-General, while the other half turned to embrace the warp and techno-heresy, employing forbidden sciences to bolster their forces. Chaos cults and daemons manifested with more liberty than ever before, as where discord and ruin went, the forces of the Archenemy were never too far behind.

Twenty new cards are added for the neutral factions to bolster either their own decks or be added to Legions as a way of supporting the Astartes’ own wars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/74cd4b003218189176e554fe095f14612ecf83f9.jpg[/img]

[h3]HOW TO COLLECT THE NEW CARDS[/h3]
Complement your deck and complete your collection with the new cards from the fourth wave. There are multiple ways to collect them:
[list]
[*]Galaxy in Flames crates in the shop have 5 cards from the expansion, with at least 1 being rare or better.
[*]A constructed deck in the shop, with Thaddeus Fayle as warlord and the new Sork legendary card. Any duplicates you receive are converted into gems.
[*]Cards for sale with gems in the Daily Shop and Veteran Shop.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1b5dc1ac98d6e3a0d89e70d52b374d84effebc0c.jpg[/img]

[h3]NEW EVENT: ‘SAFEGUARDING ETERNITY’[/h3]
The traitors advance towards the Eternity Gate Spaceport. Hosts of World Eaters charge, imbued by Khorne’s bloodthirst, as Terra’s defenders prepare to make their last stand before them. The Eternity Wall must not fall!

Test the new neutral cards for the first time in the new event, Safeguarding Eternity. Will you join the carnage as the traitor invaders or as the loyalists in the wall’s forlorn defence?

[b]GALAXY IN FLAMES EXPANSION CRATES ARE NOW AVAILABLE. COMPLETE YOUR DECK’S STRATEGIES AND DOMINATE THE BATTLEFIELD WITH THE NEW CARDS![/b]

notes.title: Release notes v2.1.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/83aad2d745afebac1411d2bffab4e72e4c0afb04.jpg[/img]
"You cannot dull my wild spirit!"
– Qin Xa, Master of the Keshig

Update v2.1.2 has been released on all platforms. It prepares the game for the upcoming content in the final wave of the Galaxy in Flames expansion, which will bring 20 new neutral cards and add the expansion crates to the Shop.

This release also brings a few improvements and bug fixes:
- New Achievements related to the Galaxy in Flames expansion
- New Shield animation
- Fix a synchronisation error when winning a match with Qin Xa in certain circumstances
- Fix error viewing related cards in hand, on PC and Steam
- Fix error showing the Bastion trait on units returned to hand
- Fix error showing weapon's health while in hand (except on iOS, where it will be fixed in the next update)

As more and more troops join the fight for Terra, new decks and strategies become available. Adapt and prevail!

notes.title: Attrition takes its toll in the latest balance patch
notes.content:

In the latest set of balance changes, we see the toll of years of war begin to have a potent effect on the Legion’s supply lines and reserves of warriors. Those Legions better suited for this type of war come out stronger, while others suffer after dominating the recent meta.

Check out the changes in the latest [url=https://www.horusheresylegions.com/january-2022-balance-patch/ ]blog post[/url].

Supply lines, strategic targets and enemy commanders were all opportunities for both loyalist and traitor forces to wreak havoc against behind the scenes. Even as the Siege of Terra raged on, countless skirmishes were fought throughout the Imperium between once time brothers.

Try out the new collectable cards for all 6 Legions featured in the Third Wave of the Galaxy in Flames expansion. Will you join the once Shattered Legions in bringing retribution to the traitors who march against Terra, or join the fallen Legions and finish the job started at Istvaan?

notes.title: Pride leads to downfall in the latest balance patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/5e08839593d4c052da6729633dcbca4fc560f6d8.jpg[/img]

[i]"Borrowed power is no power at all."[/i]
– Lord Cypher

Balance changes! With the release of the Galaxy in Flames expansion in full swing, the meta is shifting and all Legions are looking to find their place on the rapidly evolving battlefield. Nevertheless, November also brings a few balance changes to restrain a few decks which were becoming overly dominant in ranked play.

Jangsai Khan also receives a nerf to limit his growing supremacy in the current timed event, though it will not affect players who are in the middle of an event run with him.

Check out the details:

[b][u]Sons of Horus[/u][/b]
[b]Sarpati Squad[/b]: Change bonus when playing a Chaos card from +1/+1 to +1/0

[b][u]Emperor's Children[/u][/b]
[b]Hold at All Costs[/b]: When played with Perfection, refill only 5 Energy (instead of all Energy)

[b][u]Defenders Of Caliban[/u][/b]
[b]Pride of Caliban[/b]: Change ability to allow warlord to act only once more each time, rather than twice if it has Blood Thirst

[u][b]Ultramarines[/b][/u]
[b]Captain Alcaeus[/b]: Change ability so that it triggers on Courage, rather than being activated

[u][b]Event balance change[/b][/u]
[b]Jangsai Khan[/b] receives a nerf to limit his growing supremacy in the current timed event, and will no longer refill Energy every time you activate Streak.

Players in the middle of an event run with Jangsai Khan will not be impacted by this change, but all new event runs started after the patch will only be able to choose the new version of Jangsai Khan.

notes.title: Get a burst of speed in the new balance patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/ce645629677fdf7da780b82a8de3810e5a43c87f.jpg[/img]
[i]"Distrust the path of ease."[/i]
– Jaghatai Khan, Primarch

During the Siege, the White Scars found themselves in their darkest hour after a failed assault. But in that darkness, they managed to find a second wind and rally once again against the enemies of Terra.

This update brings an exciting new prospect for the White Scars, with the introduction of a new trait and changes to some of their least used cards. Take a look at the complete list of changes:

[u][b]NEW TRAIT[/b][/u]
● Streak: Cards with this trait will activate an additional effect if they are not the first card played during that turn.

[u][b]WHITE SCARS[/b][/u]
● Kondhali Scouts: Changed description to “Rally: Deal 1 damage. If target dies, return to your hand”
● Kumblai Bikes: Increased attack from 2 to 3 and changed the description to “Flank. Streak: Create Kumblai Bikes in your hand”
● Captain Hakeem: Increased attack from 2 to 3 and changed the description to “Sneak Attack. When you trigger Streak, gain Stealth until your next turn”
● Tangahi Attack Bikes: Lowered attack from 3 to 2 and changed the description to “Fast. Streak: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy”
● Vindhalli Bikes: Increased health from 2 to 3 and change the description to “Flank. Streak: Gain Sneak Attack this turn”
● Aghutai Head-Taker: Increased health from 4 to 5 and change the description to “First Strike. When you trigger Streak, gain Precognition until your next turn”
● Anagal Veterans: Changed description to “Your Warlord has +1/0. Streak: Give +2/0 to your Warlord this turn”
● Ebon Keshig: Changed description to “Front Line. (0) Your next troop this turn cost 2 less”
● Thunderhead Predator: Changed description to “Rally: Deal 2 damage. Streak: Deal 3 additional damage”
● Tempestuous Orders: Lowered cost from 3 to 1 and changed the description to “Return a friendly troop to your hand. Streak: Give it +1/0”
● Chogoris: Changed description to “Choose a Vehicle from your deck and draw it. Streak: It costs 2 less”
● Swift Strike: Changed description to “Deal 2 damage. Streak: Draw a card”
● Ride the Winds: Increased cost from 2 to 3 and change description to “Give +1/0 to Vehicles in your hand and deck. Streak: Draw a Vehicle”
● For the Khan!: Changed description to “Give +2/0 to your units this turn. Streak: Heal 2 to your units”

These changes are now live! There's still time to join the fight in the new competitive season and claim the title of Warmaster!

Stay tuned to the [url=https://www.horusheresylegions.com/white-scars-balance-update/]blog[/url] to know all about the game.

notes.title: Update 2.0.8 release notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/a5fe693d4b68c85c94a8ada05372e305f1528852.jpg[/img]

[i]"I can't wait."[/i]
– Tybalt Marr, Sons of Horus Captain

Update 2.0.8 is now live, preparing the ground for the Galaxy in Flames expansion! As the final battle for the Imperium rages, reinforcements and new stratagems are unleashed by all of the warring Legions. All Space Marine Legions, from the Angels of the First to the deceptive heads of the Hydra, will have new cards added to their card pool for collection.

This update lays the ground for the upcoming content and fixes some bugs:
● Prepare the ground new card mechanics: Streak and Mission cards
● Enable link to easily see cards referenced in card description (to be released shortly) 
● UI improvements, including new 'Your Turn' animation
● Make Battle Honour abilities trigger when target unit is destroyed with a passive ability (eg. Barnard Sappers)
● Fix error displaying enemy warlord name in unranked matches in Battle Log

The first wave of the expansion arrives on Friday, November 26th. Expect new cards, powerful warlords and exciting game mechanics. Nothing will ever be the same!
