Balance update! As the Battle of Terra reaches its highest point yet, the warriors of the Emperor's Children are filled with unparalleled bloodlust, rampaging against the hosts of Terra in a majestic whirlwind of violence. Seeing a new opening, the lines of the Sons of Horus become a bigger threat as they plan a new spearhead assault.

This update brings changes to the Emperor's Children, with new Perfection effects and improving Fulgrim's odds to play his Whispers of Chaos. The Sons of Horus receive some tweaks and the Ultramarines see some adjustments after last month's changes. Check out all the changes:

[u][b]Emperor's Children[/b][/u]
● Fulgrim: Lowered cost of Whispers of Chaos from 18 to 16
● Chaplain Charmosian: Changed description to "Rally and Backlash: Give your non-Daemon troops a Mark of Chaos"
● Enhanced Warrior: Changed stats to 5/5 and description to "Resolution: Gain +1/+1. Perfection: "Enhance" this troop"
● Hammer of Justice: Changed stats to 7/8 and description to "Front Line. Perfection: Destroy a random enemy troop with 4 or less Attack"
● Diversionary Tactics: Gains "Perfection: Draw a card"
● Concentrated Fire: Gains "Perfection: Also heal 2"
● Hold at All Costs: Changed description to "Draw 3 cards. Perfection: Refill your Energy"
● Erewhon: Changed cost to 2 and description to "Choose an Astartes in your deck and draw it. Perfection: Give it Drop Pod"
● Peak Condition: Gains "Perfection: Also give it a Mark of Chaos"
● Ruined Palace: Lowered cost from 4 to 3

[b][u]Sons of Horus[/u][/b]
● Second Wave: Changed cost to 3 and description to "Draw and put in play 2 Astartes from your deck that cost 3 or less"
● Treachery: Lowered cost from 3 to 2
● Frontal Assault: Changed cost to 7 and description to "Give +3/0 to your units this turn"

[b][u]Ultramarines[/u][/b]
● Ingenuus Command Squad: Lowered attack from 4 to 3
● Apothecary Theon: Lowered Health from 6 to 5
● Ancient Marcellus: Lowered damage on Rally from 3 to 2
● Logos Lectora: Lowered cost reduction from 2 to 1 when used to draw an Astartes from the deck

These changes are now live! Join the fight in the new competitive season and destroy your enemies to claim the title of Warmaster!

notes.title: The Ultramarines update their arsenal in the new balance update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/5914bff3967cd2b564e518f23077670fe0c8d3d4.jpg[/img]
[i]"We all serve according to our courage."[/i]
– Roboute Guilliman, Primarch

Balance update! Lured far away from the Imperium by the Warmaster right before the start of the Heresy, the Ultramarines break free of the Ruinstorm and finally head to Terra with renewed strength and purpose. Meanwhile, the Thousand Sons achieve a razor-sharp focus during the Siege of Terra and wreak havoc among their enemies. How will this affect the result of the battle?

This update brings big changes to the Ultramarines, focusing on improving the impact of their troops and the viability of some of their tactics. The Thousand Sons receive a fine-tuning of their previous rework that should improve their capacity to generate psychic energy. Check out all the changes:

[b]Ultramarines[/b]
● Bellarius Squad: Changed description to "Rally: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy troop. Courage: Deal 1 additional damage"
● Scipio Bike Squadron: Changed description to "Courage: Deal 1 damage to all enemies"
● Cossos Squad: Changed description to "Courage: Deal 3 damage to a random enemy in Stealth"
● Ingenuus Squad: Changed description to "Rally: Deal 2 damage to an enemy or heal 2 to a friendly unit"
● Captain Alcaeus: Lowered cost of ability from 2 to 0
● Apothecary Theon: Changed stats from 3/5 to 3/6 and description to "Resolution: Heal 2 to two random friendly units"
● Honour Guard: Changed stats from 4/5 to 5/5
● Captain Corvo: Changed stats from 5/5 to 6/5
● Stillus Veterans: Changed description to "Courage and Battle Honour: Create a random Practical in your hand"
● Ancient Krato: Gain "Courage: Gain +1/+1"
● Captain Mysander: Changed passive ability to "Give +1/0 to adjacent units instead of troops"
● Steloc Aethon: Changed description to "Courage: Destroy the enemy troop with highest Attack"
● Retribution Strike: Changed description to "Deal 2 damage. Courage: Draw a card"
● Relentless Pursuit: Lower cost from 2 to 1
● Interlocking Tactics: Change description to "Draw 2 cards. Courage: A random enemy with Stealth loses it"
● Mantle of Ultramar: Change description to "Give your Warlord: "Resolution: Give +1/+1 to adjacent troops"
● Lords of Ultramar: Change cost to 4 and description to "Give +1/+1 to Ultramarines troops in your hand and deck"
● Wrath in Betrayal: Lower cost from 7 to 6

[b]Thousand Sons [/b]
● Prades Squad: Changed stats to 2/3 and description to: "Psyker 2. Rally: Gain Precognition until your next turn"
● Amunis Squad: Change description to "Unstoppable. Rally: Gain 2p"
● Penthu Daast: Increase Psyker from 1 to 2
● Hidden One: Gain Psyker 2, and ability now costs normal Energy instead of Psychic Energy
● Ahriman's Cabal: Changed stats from 5/6 to 6/6 and description to "Psyker 3. Rally: Gain Precognition until your next turn (1) Gain 4 Psychic Energy"
● City of Light: Lowered cost from 3 to 2
● Flesh Change: Gain 'Draw a card'

[b]Salamanders[/b]
● Hope: Changed description to "Draw a troop from your deck. It costs 2 less."
● Resilience: Increased cost from 4 to 5

[b]Iron Hands[/b]
● The Hammer: Increased cost from 8 to 9

[b]Defenders of Caliban[/b]
● Luther (Arch-betrayer): Changed ability to "(2) Take control of an enemy troop with 5 or less remaining Health"

[b]Imperial Army[/b]
● Lucretia Elunnirai: Cost reduction now applies only to Infantry troops

[b]Mechanicum[/b]
● Forbidden Protocols: No longer includes Blood Thirst among the random effects it can grant to Vehicles

[b]Chaos[/b]
● Khorne's Favour: Changed description to 'Your warlord gains +1/0 and Blood Thirst until your next turn'

These changes are now live! Join the fight in the new competitive season and destroy your enemies to claim the title of Warmaster!

https://www.horusheresylegions.com/balance-changes-october/

notes.title: The Salamanders are reborn in the latest balance update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/c13a8aef507d561e234b71ac202cc5fae292d4fe.jpg[/img]
[i]"I can show you my superiority."[/i]
– Vulkan, Primarch

During the Horus Heresy, many Salamanders fought in small-scale missions focused on delaying the traitor's progress, as well as taking out key strategic points and limiting their ability to resupply. With all attention focused on Terra, it's now the perfect time to strike the traitors all across the galaxy with an updated arsenal!

This update brings changes to the Sacrifice trait, as well as many cards and Warlords of the Salamanders Legion. In the remote world of Caliban, Luther also receives an important update. Check out all the changes:
[list]
[*]Sacrifice: This trait now triggers when the troop is killed during its controller's own turn, regardless of whether it is attacking or not.
[/list]
[h3]Salamanders[/h3]
[list]
[*]Vulkan: Changed ability to "(2) Create a random Teaching in your hand"
[*]Cassian Vaughn: His special card, The Twice Dead, now costs 10 instead of 20.
[*]Nemetor: Gain Survivor 2
[*]Chaplain Xavier: New artwork, and changed description to "Resolution: Give Survivor 1 to adjacent units. Sacrifice: Create a Teaching in your hand"
[*]Ancient Dak'Lyr: Changed description to "Resolution: Gain Survivor 2. Sacrifice: Deal 4 damage to a random enemy"
[*]Ancient Xavor: Changed stats from 6/7 to 8/7, and description to "Survivor 3. Sacrifice: Deal 4 damage to all other units"
[*]Forgefather T'Kell: Changed description to "Survivor 5. (2) Choose a Tactic from your deck and draw it. Can act again"
[*]Dallor Squad: Changed stats from 5/3 to 5/4
[*]Orbital Combat: Lowered cost from 2 to 1
[*]Storm Eagle: Changed description to "Deal 2 damage. If the target is an enemy, Stun it"
[*]Benevolence: Increased cost from 2 to 3 and changed description to "Heal 4 to a friendly unit. If it has Sacrifice, trigger it"
[*]Devotion: Increased cost from 1 to 3 and changed description to "Give +1/+1 to your troops. If you don't control any, put in play two Sorkar Hunters"
[*]Hope: Increased cost from 2 to 3 and changed description to "Choose a troop from your deck and draw it. It costs 2 less"
[*]Resilience: Increased cost from 3 to 4 and changed description to "Choose a friendly Astartes that died this game and put it in play"
[*]Artificer Armour: Increased cost from 3 to 5 and changed description to "Give +4/+4 to a friendly troop"
[/list]
[h3]Defenders of Caliban[/h3]
[list]
[*]Luther: He now starts with a card, "Arch-Betrayer", in hand. When played, Luther transforms into The Arch-Betrayer
[*]The Arch-Betrayer: New Luther transformation. 3/40 Warlord with the ability "(2) Take control of a damaged enemy troop"
[/list]
[h3]Thousand Sons[/h3]
[list]
[*]All Warlords start the battle with an extra point of Psychic Energy
[*]Magnus the Red: Changed ability to "Deal 1-3 damage"
[/list]
[h3]Chaos[/h3]
[list]
[*]Khazdrak: Changed stats from 4/6 to 4/5
[*]Khorne's Favour: Lower cost from 6 to 5 and changed description to "Your warlord gains +3/0 until your next turn"
[/list]

These changes are now up in-game. Jump from the fires of battle straight unto the anvils of war in this new competitive season.

The stats are in! July's competitive season has finished and it's time check who were the greatest warriors of the season. Check out the full report on the latest [url=https://www.horusheresylegions.com/july-2021-meta-report/]blog post[/url]!

Did your favourite warlord make the list?

notes.title: August ranked season begins
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/f8d311d68f885ecb2d7ebaa8ffe576f05e5a2321.jpg[/img]

[i]"Fight with determination, or fall."[/i]
– Sigismund

July's ranked season is over! A new Warmaster has earned the title, and warriors from all factions prepare for a new chance for bloodshed. Congratulations to all the winners!

All players with 500 or more rating have received a reward crate based on their division, with the top 200 players worldwide getting the best prizes. All players on Terra will also have their rating reset to 2500, and all points above 2500 are converted to Legendary Points.

Did you reach Terra this season? Claim your rewards and get ready for the next chance at the title!

notes.title: Weekend deal: Horus Lupercal

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/165d41f3ee6d7e0b636100386610db2fcd448db2.jpg[/img]

[i]"The stars are our birthright."[/i]
– Horus Lupercal

As the Siege of Terra grows in ferocity, take a moment to commemorate the glorious days before the start of the Horus Heresy.

Don't miss this chance to get Horus' alternate art, depicted as Primarch of the Luna Wolves at the height of the Great Crusade, with an exclusive collector's card back. Only this weekend!

Take the Emperor's preeminent son into battle and fight for the Imperium!

Double ticket weekend! To celebrate the game's 3rd anniversary, the Daily Mission crates will provide twice the usual number of tickets this weekend. Get two tickets from a normal crate, or FOUR tickets with a VIP subscription! 

Use them to take part in the current event to decide which Sisters of Silence warlord will become collectable. The fight is close!

notes.title: War Within the Webway: event reinforcements
notes.content:

Event reinforcements! A new daemonic presence makes its appearance. Samus, the Lord of Murder, joins the assault on the Webway, threatening to overrun the Sisters of Silence keeping the daemons at bay. To counteract this new menace, Arascid Nassau charges into battle leading a contingent of Legio Custodes.

Arascid Nassau and Samus are now available to play as reinforcement warlords in the War Within the Webway event. Will you help defend the Imperial Palace, or join the daemonic forces of the Warp? Have your say!

Did you know you can select your preferred ones to display them in your Profile? Check out the latest web post explaining how!
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/achievements-overview/

notes.title: Legions turns three! A big thank you (and a Primarch raffle!)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/ea49d7c56b2935ed4adfd5aa95f0202348c6eb7e.jpg[/img]

"You deserve praise."
– Archamus

Legions turns three! After 7 major content expansions, all the Astartes Legions have finally joined the battle and the war has reached the gates of the Imperial Palace. A big thank you to the community for supporting the game this far!

To celebrate this milestone, a Primarch raffle has started on the official Facebook page. It only runs until tomorrow, so check out the post and share it to have a shot at winning a free Primarch of your choice!
https://www.facebook.com/HorusLegions/posts/833027870742048

Moreover, stay tuned this Saturday for a double-ticket weekend! The War within the Webway is proving to be a close battle, so make sure to log in, complete your Daily Mission and fight in the event to help your faction come on top.

Once again, a big thank you to all players for your support through the years! Now that all Legions are in the game, who are you siding with? How are you finding the game after the 2.0 update? What are you most looking forward in the next months? Let us know your most memorable stories!

notes.title: Weekend deal: Camba Diaz
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/e95f855536d39576627825e147910a2359ab64da.jpg[/img]

[i]"Not one step back."[/i]
– Camba Diaz

New collectable Warlord! Camba Diaz joins the roster of the Imperial Fists with unparalleled determination. From now on, Camba Diaz will be appearing in crates, ready to take the siege to the traitors. 

He is also featured in a new time-limited starter deck, with a matching card back and the Fortified Outpost epic card. Add the Siege Master to your collection and don't take a step backwards ever again!

notes.title: War within the Webway
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/19d76ecd541fde2513d48bdf7d5b77afbd7c0dcf.jpg[/img]

[i]"Evil won't remain unpunished."[/i]
– Jenetia Krole, Knight-Commander

New event: War Within the Webway! Hidden from the sights of most of the Imperium, the Sisters of Silence were key in the defence of Terra when the malfunctioning Golden Throne allowed the entrance of daemons through the Webway Portal of the Palace. To defend Terra from this invasion, they would have to take the fight to the Webway.

This battle will decide which Sisters of Silence warlord will become collectable. A loyalist victory will promote Kaeria Casryn to collectable status, while a traitor victory will allow Melaena Verdath to join the ranks of the Sisterhood. Fight in the Webway and decide the future of the Imperium!

notes.title: Major update 2.0 released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/ea49d7c56b2935ed4adfd5aa95f0202348c6eb7e.jpg[/img]

[i]“This war is just beginning.”[/i]
– Corswain

The battle starts now! Legions celebrates its update 2.0 with a raft of improvements and new features for veteran and new players alike. 

Join the Battle of Phall to discover the new single-player campaigns and start collecting the Imperial Fists, aim for the greatest glory (and bragging rights) with the new system of Achievements, and enjoy the polished new look of your card collection.

Check out the amazing [b]release video[/b]:
https://youtu.be/1UhL_qHSWj0

And then read all the details in the [b]web announcement[/b]:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/the-battle-starts-now

With these many changes and improvements, there has never been a better time to be in the game or to start playing. Join the battle!

A loyalist victory will earn Camba-Diaz a spot in the Legion's collection, while a traitor victory will give Fafnir Rann that honour. The protectors of the Colossi Gates have been able to hold the traitor's assault thus far, but lowering the guard is not an option, for through the expanding tides of Chaos, new traitor reinforcements arrive to the battlefield! Seeing danger arise, the protectors of the Imperial Palace are forced to send a detachment out.

Constantin Valdor and Ingethel join the battle for the Colossi Gate as reinforcements! Will you assault the Throneworld with the invading forces or help the defenders of the Imperium's capital world? Decide the fate of the galaxy!

Have your say!

Are your friends not playing Legions yet? Share this trailer with them and invite them into the game! All the Astartes Legions are now in the game, and the best is yet to come.

Will you stay loyal to the Emperor, or join the Warmaster's ploy?

notes.title: WARHAMMER SKULLS – THE COMING OF AR’GAKHOL THE GOREBORN
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/d99e20bc42a7de0650fa7c718ccf2328e062b570.png[/img]
[i]“Your skull shall adorn our master’s throne!”[/i]
– Ar’gakhol the Goreborn, Daemon Lord of Khorne

The time for the taking of skulls is upon us! Once every year, Khorne’s followers rampage all across the galaxy with only one objective: to please their master. The Warhammer Skulls event, starting on June 3rd, is a celebration of all Warhammer video-games, with new content, special offers and exclusive announcements. Do you wish to know what this means for The Horus Heresy: Legions? Keep reading to learn about all the activities and offers planned, for Khorne!

[previewyoutube=Xzdlckk5yYk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]AR’GAKHOL THE GOREBORN TAKES TO THE BATTLEFIELD[/h3]
Through the fires of the Immaterium, a new daemonic Warlord arrives to reinforce the hosts of Chaos! Ar’gakhol the Goreborn, Daemon Lord of Khorne, comes to The Horus Heresy: Legions as a new Legendary Warlord for the neutral Chaos faction.

Ar’gakhol will become collectable at the end of the event, but you can add him first to your collection with his premium deck bundle! Brandish the new skull-themed card back, take this monstrous spawn of the Warp to battle and conquer the Ranked Season’s leaderboards!

[h3]STARTER BUNDLE DISCOUNT[/h3]
Jump-start your journey of galactic warfare in The Horus Heresy: Legions on a discount with the Starter Bundle available on Steam! Embody the Sons of Horus’ First Captain and crush your enemies with Abaddon’s alternate art and voice lines included in this bundle. Get it now with a 30% discount, its lowest price to date.

Also in this bundle you will find Abaddon’s ‘Justaerin Commander’ deck, which includes a Legendary card, an exclusive collector’s card back based on Abaddon’s iconic Terminator Armour, 1000 coins and 5 event tickets to take part in the new raid event.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/f5798029bbbaba113b5106404699887b70bcbc23.jpg[/img]

[h3]THE CHAMPIONS OF KHORNE FIGHT![/h3]
Khorne’s most loyal servants clash in an all-out skirmish! Nuceria’s red sands become the perfect arena for a battle of the ages as six of the greatest warriors of Chaos fight for the favor of the God of blood and murder! Ar’gakhol finds himself among these savage warriors, ready to take the skulls of anyone who dares cross his path, for the glory of Khorne. Take part in this event, and try Ar’gakhol the Goreborn before he becomes collectable. Choose your champion and let the slaughter commence! 

This event will last for an entire week, and if the taking of skulls and shedding of blood wasn’t enough for you, taking part in the most savage fight of the year can also unlock new content into the game. Every victory in this event will yield skulls that are added to a global tally. Once this tally reaches a certain threshold, Khorne will reward his servants with new content to increase their barbarity!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/bce85a265eefdc52cbf885765d1a2336f6b11a88.jpg[/img]

[h3]RAID REWARDS[/h3]
And what exactly could Khorne yield his most loyal servants? Well allow us to show you how the depravity of the Blood God will affect the game. There are 3 total thresholds in the reward track. Reaching every one of those thresholds will unlock new content into the game. Let’s take a closer look at the gory rewards of this battle for the ages:
[list]
[*]Reaching 500.000 skulls will unlock [b]Ruinous Offerings[/b], a new Khorne-inspired card back to adorn your deck.
[*]Reaching 1.000.000 skulls will add a new card to the collection. [b]Khazdrak, Daemon Chosen of Khorne[/b], will join the Chaos faction as a new collectable Epic troop, ready to create mayhem wherever he goes.
[*]Reaching 3.000.000 skulls, [b]Khorne’s Favour[/b], a new Legendary tactic will become collectable at the end of the event.[/list]
[h3]COLLECT THE CHAMPIONS OF KHORNE![/h3]
All throughout the week, the most brutal warriors of the Galaxy will become available for a limited time. Don’t miss your chance to add the regular versions of these savage soldiers to your collection through the Shop or their alternate arts with exclusive deals! Log into the game daily to walk the scarlet path with the likes of Angron, Kharn and Ka’Bandha!

[b]What are you waiting for? Skulls do not collect themselves! Sharpen your axes, take a step into the sands of Nuceria and join the greatest slaughter for the glory of Khorne. Blood for the Blood God! Skulls for the Skull Throne![/b]

notes.title: The Agents of the Sigillite fight in the Silent War
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1a405b3bbd7156128ee751f3de2248d0c2f7eab7.jpg[/img]
[i]"The hour is upon us."[/i]
– Malcador the Sigillite

During the Horus Heresy, countless battles matched massive regiments and Legions against one another, yet not many of them could match the ramifications of the secret small-scale operations taken by Malcador and his agents. Take control of the Agents of the Sigillite and enter the realm of secrecy!

[h3]New faction: Agents of the Sigillite[/h3]
While the Emperor was busy with His secret project in the vaults beneath the Imperial Palace, Malcador was named Regent of Terra and took up many major responsibilities in the capital world of the Imperium. Seeing menaces and dangers where no one else dared to look, Malcador started to work on many secret projects too. Among these classified projects, the founding of the Officio Assassinorum and the creation of the Knights-Errant proved to be of great importance after the start of the Horus Heresy. The forces that the Sigillite mustered were able to venture deep behind enemy lines and take part in secret missions that were capable of turning the tides of the entire civil war. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1a405b3bbd7156128ee751f3de2248d0c2f7eab7.jpg[/img]

[h3]Agents of the Sigillite warlords[/h3]
Three collectable Warlords lead the secret forces of the Regent as they fight to protect the Imperium:
[list]
[*]Malcador: A powerful psyker who served as the Regent of Terra and the Emperor's most trusted confidante.
[*]Tylos Rubio: Former Codicier of the Ultramarines, a powerful psyker who become one of the first Knights-Errant recruited by Malcador.
[*]Iota: Assassin of Clade Culexus who was tasked to assassinate Horus in the first ever Execution Force.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/7761e92cb487e51e7b5a46852c125f0bee24d971.jpg[/img]

[h3]How to get Agents of the Sigillite cards[/h3]
You can collect Agents of the Sigillite cards in several ways:
[list]
[*]Each reward crate in the 'The Buried Dagger' event has at least 1 Agents of the Sigillite card.
[*]Agents of the Sigillite crates in the shop have at least 3 Agents of the Sigillite cards, 1 of them rare of better.
[*]A constructed deck in the shop, with Iota as warlord and an exclusive card back. Any duplicates you receive are converted into gems.
[*]Cards for sale with gems in the Daily Shop.
[*]VIP subscribers will find 1 guaranteed Agents of the Sigillite card in their Daily Mission crate during the 'The Buried Dagger' event.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1a4823e6733bab91d8238228d1215acb9f3a667a.jpg[/img]

[h3]New event: 'The Buried Dagger'[/h3]
Mysterious happenings have been reported near Terra's White Mountain. After knowing of the area's multiple disappearances and strange gathering, Malcador takes matters into his own hands and leads an investigation. Unfortunately, after Malcador's arrival with his agents, a plot seems to start to unravel! The followers of Chaos clash against the Agents of the Sigillite during their first mission! Join the event and test the Agents of the Sigillite against the forces of Chaos! Keep your eyes open, and watch your back.

[b]The Agents of the Sigillite are now live. Muster the secret forces of the Imperium and play your role in the Hidden War to defend it![/b]

The Sisters of Silence confront the Immaterium and the invisible forces that conspire against the Imperium as they join the game in the Siege of Terra expansion. Lead the Silent Sisterhood and hunt the witch for the Imperium!

[h1]New faction: Sisters of Silence[/h1]
Hard to perceive, clad in Vratine, fast and skilled warriors, the Sisters of Silence have always been fearful opponents whenever they arrive to the battlefield. Their unique status as blanks makes them essentially impervious to the powers of the Warp, and that transforms them into the greatest psyker hunters in the Imperium. Their presence in Prospero's Censure Host was no coincidence, and it will be key once again in Terra if the loyalists expect to defeat the traitor's onslaught.

[h1]Sisters of Silence warlords[/h1]

[list]

[*]Varonika Sulath: High ranking member of the Sisterhood. She oversaw the implementation of the Unspoken Sanction.
[*]Jenetia Krole: Great leader of the Silent Sisterhood, who became one of the Emperor's personal battle confidantes.

[*]Each reward crate in the 'Battle of Somnus Citadel' event has at least 1 Sisters of Silence card.

[*]A constructed deck in the shop, with Amendera Kendel as warlord and an exclusive card back. Any duplicates you receive are converted into gems.
[*]Cards for sale with gems in the Daily Shop.
[*]VIP subscribers will find 1 guaranteed Sisters of Silence card in their Daily Mission crate during the 'Battle of Somnus Citadel' event.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1783248a82934c979b0d35ed5e4d72e0977a7c86.jpg[/img]

[h1]New event: 'Battle of Somnus Citadel'[/h1]
The first event of the Sisters of Silence tests them against the forces of Chaos that invaded the Somnus Citadel. At the start of the Heresy, the Sisters of Silence took in refugees from the Death Guard in the Somnus Citadel, their headquarters on Luna. Unfortunately Solun Decius, one of these survivors, gave in to Nurgle and started a warp infestation inside the citadel. Which side will you fight for in this battle? Will you aid the Sisters of Silence or the daemonic forces of Nurgle?

The Sisters of Silence are now live. Take control of the Silent Sisterhood and scour the battlefield!

notes.title: New expansion: Siege of Terra
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/e924c914d17ba89ea6cad864f14bbd1ceccebe3b.jpg[/img]
[i]"I will shape Terra to be a bastion of the Imperium."[/i]
– Rogal Dorn, Primarch

The shadows of treachery are grasping for Terra, but the capital world of the Imperium stands ready to fight back. In the midst of the Great Crusade, the Emperor called upon Rogal Dorn and his Imperial Fists to ready the defensive systems of Terra. Their efforts will now pay off, for the coming battle aims to best the Imperium's defenders, and conquer the planet in the name of chaos.

The Imperial Fists will be the first faction of the expansion to come into the game when it releases on April 23rd! With 140 new cards, 9 Warlords and new cosmetics, this expansion brings exciting new mechanics and many iconic characters into the game! 

The road to Terra is open, but Terra is ready. Stay tuned for more details! The battle rages now more than ever. Which side will you fight for?

Read the full announcement [url=https://www.horusheresylegions.com/siege-of-terra-announcement/]here[/url]!

notes.title: Balance changes – April 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/9f054d4628cdbcb39e813cde20b2793f812d1509.jpg[/img]

[i]"A novel strategy!"[/i]
– Thaddeus Fayle

In the thick of battle there might not be time for second guessing, but all sides always try to update their arsenal to gain the upper hand. A new balance patch has been released, with slight touch-ups to the Imperial Army, Sons of Horus, Dark Angels and Mechanicum.

Imperial Army:
● Malcador's Observer: Lowered cost from 5 to 4.
● Triumph of Ullanor: Changed the description to reduce the cost when any troop dies, not only enemies.
● Close Call: Now returns the a friendly troop to your hand instead of your deck.
● Compliance: Gain additional effect "Draw a troop". 

Sons of Horus:
● Serghar Targost: Change description to "Drop Pod. Relentless: Give a Mark of Chaos to your Astartes troops".
● The Punisher: Increased health from 10 to 12 and lowered its ability's cost from 4 to 2.

Dark Angels:
● Eskaton Imperative: Changed description to "Deal 2 damage to all enemies. For each unit killed, lower the cost of a troop in your hand by 1".

Mechanicum:
● Hereteknica: Changed cost to 3 and description to "Give a Mark of Chaos to all your Mechanicum non-Daemon troops. Draw a card".

notes.title: Balance changes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/5758ae7296e395c955ee2ab12f8508a67acb8dbe.jpg[/img]

[i]"I am faceless, yet I can become anyone."[/i]
– Callidus Assassin

Balance changes! War, gruelling and dire as it is, takes its toll on everyone, even the brightest sons of the Emperor. This balance update focuses mainly on Reckoning-type cards, Lion El'Jonson and Callidus Assassin. Check out the details!

● Healing reduced from 8 to 5 in special cards including Whispers of Chaos, Reckoning, Madness, Dreadnought Interment and General of Signus.
● Lion El'Jonson: Changed ability to "Choose a Wing. Draw a troop from that Wing".
● Lion El'Jonson's Reckoning: Change cost from 14 to 15, but increase cost reduction from -1 to -2 when a friendly troop completes a quest.
● Flame Cannon: Changed ability to "Deal 2 damage to the enemy warlord and adjacent units".
● Callidus Assassin: Gained new passive ability "Relentless: Heal 1", and updated list of warlords it can transform into: the list now includes Israfael, Sergeant Cork and Kheron Ophion, and no longer includes Hierophant, Hommed, Carya and Meros.

notes.title: Legions turns three!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/dbfce5326935e1f6d048e1ee5257d6589f73057b.jpg[/img]

[i]"That was quite a sight."[/i]
– Lotara Sarrin

Today marks the third year since The Horus Heresy: Legions went live on Google Play's Early Access. A lot has changed since then, but galactic warfare now rages more than ever thanks to the increasing number of warriors that partake in it! 

Just to give you an idea of how much has happened, the game launched with 15 collectable Warlords. Today there are 97 plus more than 60 event-exclusive Warlords. The game started with 288 collectible cards; today it's sitting on more than 1,100. In days of old, there were only 4 factions represented in the game, aside from the 3 neutral ones, but today, that number has increased to 22, each with a distinctive personality and unique take on the game.

All this may sound like a feat only achievable through Heresy, but the truth is that The Horus Heresy: Legions has travelled on the shoulders of a passionate community since day 1. The journey ahead couldn't be more exciting, with more factions to discover and new upcoming ways to play the game.

But today is a day to celebrate your support. Thank you for making this galaxy in flames as fun and epic as it sounds!

notes.title: New raid event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/575a07f0a7c0affc755e55b0f83c2a3726ecc95f.jpg[/img]

[i]"I will slay those who once judged me!"[/i]
–  Anacharis Scoria

New Raid event! In an attempt to prevent Horus from getting three new Ordinatus Ulator weapons, Blackshields led by Endryd Haar invade Xana in an all-out assault. During the confrontation, the Tyrant of Xana breaks free from his imprisonment! Get ready to face the fury of Anacharis Scoria!

Fight with other players to aid or stop the Dark Mechanicum and unlock new content for the game! This new event differs from the standard format in several ways:

[b][u]1. PVE Boss Fight[/u][/b]
● Anacharis Scoria will fight you at a number of fixed stages of every event run. Be careful, he gets stronger through the run! 
● You have only one chance to defeat Scoria at every stage it appears. Losing will cost you an attempt and, if you still have some left, let you continue from the same stage fighting a regular player.
● Victories against Scoria are added to a global milestones tally.

[b][u]2. Global Milestones[/u][/b]
● Gather points defeating Anacharis Scoria to reach milestones and unlock amazing new cosmetics and collectable warlords.
● All players contribute points for victories against Anacharis Scoria, even those who are not in a Lodge.
● Rewards will be unlocked for all players at the end of the event. Check out every icon in the milestones bar to check what's at stake!

[b][u]3. New content to unlock[/u][/b]
● 200.000: Mechanicum War Cry
● 500.000: Xana II badge
● 1.000.000: Myrmidon Destructor warlord
● 1.750.000: Forbidden Protocols legendary card
● 2.500.000: Anacharis Scoria warlord

Start playing now and face the fury of the Tyrant of Xana while you fight for your faction's interests. Can you manage all these enemies at once?

notes.title: Five new languages released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/4877629f73128142903af9e1ddaee6435a341b8b.jpg[/img]

Even in the middle of a galactic-scale civil war, the Imperium does not cease to expand. With the latest update, The Horus Heresy: Legions is now available in 5 new languages! You can now play the game in Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Polish and Czech. The game is also now available on mobile in Japan and South Korea!

Do you know of any friends who were waiting for these languages to be added? Let them know! Remember that tapping on any chat message will auto-translate it to your language, so any player can become a powerful recruit for your Lodge.

With these additions, new challengers will soon join the fight for the title of Warmaster. Stand ready, for the competition just got that much tougher!

● The game has been translated to five new languages: Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Polish and Czech! These join the list of 7 languages already available: English, French, German, Italian, Russian, Spanish and Portuguese.
● The main font of the game has been changed to improve menu and card readability.
● The Settings and Inbox pop ups have been revamped to make them more user-friendly.

● The game features a brand new icon, displaying a traitorous Contemptor Dreadnought from the Death Guard.

Balance changes! The tides of warp are fickle, and have brought some important changes to the Marks of Chaos and the legendary titan Canis Vertex, as well as a few other selected cards. Check out the details!

[b][u]Marks of Chaos[/u][/b]
● Mark of Khorne: Change effect to "Gain +2/0"
● Mark of Nurgle: Change effect to "Gain Poisonous and 0/+2"
● Mark of Slaanesh: Change effect to "Gain Terror and +1/0"
● Mark of Tzeentch: Change effect to "Gain Unstoppable and +1/+1"

[b][u]Canis Vertex[/u][/b]
● Canis Vertex: No longer starts with 1 less card. 
● Canis Vertex's titan weapons: Change Meltdown ability so that it deals 3-5 damage to your Warlord and Titan Weapons (instead of 5-8 to adjacent units)
● Canis Vertex's Power Claws: Change ability to (3p) Deal 2-4 damage

[b][u]Word Bearers[/u][/b]
● Lorgar's Whispers of Chaos: Increase cost to 20, but lower cost by 4 for each daemon in play
● Lorgar Transfigured: Ability now deals 3 damage, instead of 2-3

[b][u]Orphans of War[/u][/b]
● Orros Lydriik: Change description to "Survivor 2. Relentless: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy"
● Moritat Syras: Ability can no longer target the enemy warlord

[b][u]White Scars[/u][/b]
● Jaghatai's Reckoning: Cost now decreases when you control no troops at the start of your turn, instead of at the end of your turn.

notes.title: Release notes v1.8.6: Challenge system revamped!
notes.content:

Update v1.8.6 welcomes the new year with major improvements to the daily Challenges:
● Complete a different goal each day to earn a Challenge reward crate when the time runs out. Each Challenge has 3 tiers of completion, the higher you reach, the better the crate!
● You can now choose which faction you wish to get cards for, and all the cards in the Challenge crate will be from that faction.
● The list of challenges has been revised to focus on those that can be completed over several matches. You will no longer need very long matches or supportive opponents to complete them.
● The thresholds required to complete some of the challenges have been revised down.

This update also brings a number of other improvements:
● Add support for Chinese, Japanese and Korean characters.
● Enable a special New Year offer, offering 1000 coins with any of the starter decks for the Astartes Legions in the game.
● If a lodge leader leaves a lodge, the leadership will now automatically pass on the next most veteran lodge member.
● In deck editing, enable the +/- buttons to add or remove the warlord.
● Fix a bug in the interaction between Hydra Dominatus and Deathshroud.
● Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: The Knight Houses stomp into battle!
notes.content:
[i]"Today, we fight for glory!"[/i]
– Markan Hrotham of House Makabius

The Knight Houses arrive as the final faction in the Angels of Caliban expansion. Raise the banners and fight with pride in the name of your House!

[u][b]New faction: Knight Houses[/b][/u]
Among the most fearsome war machines of the Imperium are the Knights, towering armoured figures piloted by nobles hailing from the ancient feudal Knight Worlds. Each Knight Household followed its own traditions and strict hierarchy. Most were allied with a Forge World, and would walk to war alongside their Titan Legions in return for the advanced technology and knowledge that only the magos of the Mechanicum could provide. The Knight Households introduce exciting new mechanics that let you pilot these formidable machines of war into glorious battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/57b9c7e96ada753fabf72701f330d44735d187d0.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Armours and pilots[/u][/b]
As never before seen in the game, Warlords from the Knight Houses are not predefined. They are divided in two different pieces which players can mix and match to customize their Warlord. These pieces are the armour and the pilot. Both the armour and the pilot that are chosen for a deck will define a part of the final Warlord the player will bring into battle. 

On the one hand, the armour defines the life total and brings a passive ability. On the other hand, the pilot not only gives the final Warlord an activated ability, but also defines its voice lines in battle and the colours painted on the armour. When any Knight armour is obtained, one pilot will be available by default, Alsahr Orhlacc, so players will be able to represent House Orhlacc from the get go.

[b][u]Knight Houses warlords[/u][/b]
Three different battle armour can be chosen for your Warlord:
● [b]Acastus[/b]: A rare sight in battle, Acastus Knights rival Warhound Titans in both size and firepower. 
● [b]Cerastus[/b]: The surprising speed of the Cerastus Knight allowed them to perform fearsome lethal charges.
● [b]Questoris[/b]: The most common pattern in use by the Knight Houses, and the mainstay of their forces.

There are also three different pilots that will be able to take these suits into battle:
● [b]Alsahr Orhlacc[/b]: An impetuous and courageous knight who aimed to become a legend among his peers.
● [b]Elsbet Vorr[/b]: An accomplished scion, slayer of one of the god-like beasts that inhabited Damaetus III/II.
● [b]Markan Hrotham[/b]: Seeking glory, Markan took control of House Makabius and joined the traitors at the start of the Heresy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/0c18f7b6015203fc5a90cc61833e70e6f303346a.png[/img]

[b][u]Weapons[/u][/b]
Knights are unlike any other Warlord in the game, but there's another key difference. On both sides of a Warlord from the Knight Houses, there will be a Weapon Slot. Weapons are a new type of card that is exclusive to the Knight Houses Faction. Weapons can be equipped to a Knight's Weapon Slot, and can be activated the same turn that they are played. 

This new card type has a life value, but can neither be targeted nor affected by any card effect. Instead, equipped Weapons will take damage whenever the Knight Warlord takes damage and heal whenever it heals. In addition, unlike troops, Weapons can be replaced by playing a new one onto an occupied Weapon Slot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/8e59d31667f7e5e1ffc46cfd103ec941af26844c.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Plasma[/u][/b]
Weapons bring exciting options to any Knight that takes them into battle, like being able to deal damage, raising its attack value or giving the Warlord abilities like Shield or First Strike. To activate, players will be spending a new type of resource, Plasma. This new resource will be generated in two different ways: card effects and the new Reactor ability. Any card with the Reactor keyword will generate Plasma at the start of the player's turn. Knights all have Reactor 1 by default, but many troops in the Knight Houses card pool will also feature this ability. In addition, troops and tactics of the Knight Houses will also be able to directly generate Plasma as part of their effects.

[b][u]How to get Knight Houses cards[/u][/b]
You can collect Knight Houses cards in several ways:
● Each reward crate in the 'Liberation of Numinal' event has at least 1 Knight Houses card.
● Knight Houses crates in the shop have at least 3 Knight Houses cards, 1 of them rare of better.
● A constructed deck in the shop, with an Orhlacc Questoris knight as warlord and an exclusive card back. Any duplicates you receive are converted into gems.
● Cards for sale with gems in the Daily Shop.
● VIP subscribers will find 1 guaranteed Knight Houses card in their Daily Mission crate during the 'Liberation of Numinal' event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/babd25675decb1cdcb2aeaa76e4fcefa548a83ba.jpg[/img]

[u][b]New event: 'Liberation of Numinal'[/b][/u]
The Coronid Deeps Sector, one of the most industrialised regions in the Galaxy, became a major scenario of the Horus Heresy in what would become known as the Manachean War, involving many traitor and loyalist Knight Houses garrisoned there.

The Knight Houses are now live. Bear your weapons and take these mechanized beasts of war to battle!

notes.title: Expansion announcement: Angels of Caliban
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/35b60ee6eaa8443817b935935fd5d5af8afedf68.jpg[/img]

[i]"For Caliban and the Emperor!"[/i]
– Lion El'Jonson

The Dark Angels are about to arrive to The Horus Heresy: Legions! Read on to learn about them and which other new factions will be part of the ‘Angels of Caliban’ expansion, [u]starting on October 23rd[/u]!

[b][u]The Dark Angels[/u][/b]
The Dark Angels were the first of the Emperor’s Legions, and one of the most powerful and independent Legions at the time of the Horus Heresy. Remorseless and ruthlessly efficient, they made no compromises in the pursuit of their assigned duty.

The Warmaster’s machinations saw the First Legion sent out beyond the borders of the Imperium, where little news would reach them of his impending rebellion, and from where they wouldn’t be able to return on time to stop his advance on Terra.

Rumours of Horus’ betrayal eventually reached Lion El’Jonson, Primarch of the Dark Angels, who immediately brought back the full might of his Legion to fight in defence of the Imperium.

The Dark Angels will be released on [u]October 23rd[/u], as the first new faction in the Angels of Caliban expansion!

[b][u]Defenders of Caliban[/u][/b]
The First Legion discovered their primarch, Lion El’Jonson, in Caliban, a cruel and densely forested planet where foul monstrosities had long stalked the dwindling human population.

The young Lion El’Jonson was raised by Luther, a champion among the knights of the secretive Orders of Caliban. Together they would lead a crusade to rid Caliban of its curse and unite the Knightly Orders, though its aftermath would see Lion El’Jonson receive all the battle honours, leaving a wound in the pride of his mentor that would fester in the years to follow.

Things would come to a head during the compliance of Sarosh, after which Luther and a cadre of Dark Angels were sent back to Caliban, exiled and ordered to look after training and recruitment duties.

Resentful at being cast out of the Great Crusade, and disgruntled by the changes brought about by the Imperium to their home planet, the seed of dissent would soon spread among the wardens of Caliban.

The Defenders of Caliban will form the second faction of the Angels of Caliban expansion. They will arrive, shrouded in secrets, on [u]November 6th[/u].

[b][u]Knight Households[/u][/b]
Among the most fearsome war machines of the Imperium are the Knights, towering armoured figures piloted by nobles hailing from the ancient feudal Knight Worlds.

Each Knight Household followed its own traditions and strict hierarchy. Most were allied with a Forge World,and would walk to war alongside their Titan Legions in return for the advanced technology and knowledge that only the magos of the Mechanicum could provide.

The Knight Households will become a faction in the game, introducing exciting new mechanics to let you pilot these formidable machines of war. Get ready for their release on [u]November 20th[/u]!

[b][u]Neutral cards[/u][/b]
As always, the expansion will conclude with 20 new neutral cards from Imperial Army, Mechanicum and Chaos, which will be released on [u]December 4th[/u].


Stay tuned for more announcements and for the upcoming card reveals by content creators!

notes.title: Release notes v1.7.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/e12a33f8b1b5a482bb0337a93ba7ced09bd4e135.jpg[/img]

[i]"Never speak of this moment."[/i]
– Raldoron, First Captain of the Blood Angels

An update has gone live on all platforms, fixing a few issues and introducing a change to promote fair play in the top tiers of ranked play.

Check out the details:
● Players with 3000 rating or more will no longer be able to see their opponent name in Ranked games, until the end of the match. This aims to prevent feeding or purposely drawing a match.
● Fix bug which prevented Delta Omega 03 from stunning an attacking enemy that destroyed it through an ability (eg. Durak Rask).
● Fix bug allowing a troop with Blood Thirst that auto-attacked at the start of the turn (eg. Vorax with Cybernetica Cortex) to attack a second time even when it should have died from the first attack.
● Improve interface to prevent adding cards to the deck by accident when scrolling the card list with the left hand on mobile.
● Fix attack sound of your own Warlord in replays.
● Add description box to Counterattack cards.

notes.title: Flashback: The Emancipation of Drune
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/e62073745b132d3b5407bb6067e6f9bc2112f15f.jpg[/img]

[i]"A fine day for a heroic deed."[/i]
– Jaghatai Khan

New Raid event! At Drune, three Legions stood together, each headed by their Primarch, to deliver the brainwashed human population from the yoke of xenos domination. But as the campaign reached its climax, a hideous monstrosity emerged from the Warp to challenge the three Primarchs.

Fight with other players to free Drune and unlock new content for the game! This new event differs from the standard format in several ways:

[b]1. PVE Boss Fight[/b]
● The Behemoth of Drune will fight you at a number of fixed stages of every event run. Be careful, he gets stronger through the run! 
● You have only one chance to defeat the Behemoth at every stage it appears. Losing will cost you an attempt and, if you still have some left, let you continue from the same stage fighting a regular player.
● Victories against the Behemoth of Drune are added to a global milestones tally.

[b]2. Global Milestones[/b]
● Gather points defeating the Behemoth to reach milestones and unlock amazing new cosmetics and collectable warlords.
● All players contribute points for victories against the Behemoth, even those who are not in a Lodge.
● Rewards will be unlocked for all players at the end of the event. Check out every icon in the milestones bar to check what's at stake!

[b]3. New content to unlock[/b]
● 100,000 points: White Scars warcry
● 300,000 points: White Scars card back
● 750,000 points: Ogryn Sergeant, Imperial Army Warlord
● 1,500,000 points: Crucial Choice, legendary Imperial Army card
● 2,500,000 points: The Lord of the Flies, Chaos Warlord

Start playing now and face the Behemoth of Drune, a creature so powerful it could hold its ground against the combined might of three Primarchs. Will you be able to find its weakness?

The patterns of fate are unveiled! A balance patch has been released, with a few select changes. Check out the details!

[b][u]Warlords[/u][/b]
● Samus: Changed ability to '(2) Give Can't Attack until your next turn. The next time, deal 2 damage'.
● Ahriman: He now starts with a special extra card in hand, Patterns of Fate.
● Patterns of Fate: new 4-cost Special card for Ahriman: 'Display 3 troops or Tactics in the enemy hand. Choose one and put a copy in your hand. Reduce its cost by 4'.

[u][b]Chaos[/b][/u]
● Planetary Purge: Changed cost from 6 to 5, and description to 'Deal 4 damage. If the target dies, repeat this effect on another random unit.'

[u][b]Ruinstorm[/b][/u]
● Rot Fly: Renamed to Rot Swarm. The Rot flies put in play by the Rot Swarm's ability have been changed so that they can not create new troops.

notes.title: Release notes v1.6.8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/a5fe693d4b68c85c94a8ada05372e305f1528852.jpg[/img]

[i]"Rust never sleeps."[/i]
– Kelbor-Hal, Fabricator General

Update v1.6.8 is now available. This update prepares the ground for the next events, and brings some bug fixes and quality of life improvements.

● When a warlord dies, all queued effects will now get resolved before finishing the match, making it easier to pull a draw from the jaws of defeat. (Did someone mention Viral Bombs?)
● The Battle Log now shows up to 30 matches, and allows up to 10 of them to be pinned.
● You can now type multiple chat messages on PC/Mac without having to click on the chat each time. Please use responsibly.
● If the game gets stuck in an endless loop saying there is new content to download, the popup will now provide an option to re-download all remote content, which should clear any underlying issues.

● Fixed gameplay error related to auto-attacking troops, which could cause a match to freeze.
● Fixed interaction of Umbra Secundus with Desperate Defence and other cards with similar effect.
● Fixed error when choosing a card while timer is in countdown, which could cause the card choice to happen automatically.
● Fixed bug in certain options of the collection search box.

notes.title: Balance changes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/87a4ae8ea9a89dd0acc3be60e1ba3b3d5273d4aa.jpg[/img]

[i]"Bearers of the word, stand ready."[/i]
– Lorgar, Primarch of the Word Bearers

After the stand-off during the Shadow Crusade, the Word Bearers come back stronger and more determined than ever. They have received the most changes in June's balance patch. Check out the details!

[b][u]Warlords[/u][/b]

● Canis Vertex: Start with one less card in hand. Lower Psyker 2 to 1, and cost of Psychic abilities from 3 to 2.
● Tacitus Proctor: Passive ability now gives +1/+1 to adjacent Vehicles, instead of a single random Vehicle
● Ingethel: Ability now gives a Mark of Chaos and 0/+1 to target 
● Vettranio Shapura: Lower ability cost from 2 to 1
● Cassian Vaughn: Gain special card 'The Twice Dead', with description "Heal 5 to your Warlord and reduce the cost of troops in your hand by 2. Costs 1 after triggering Survivor."

[b][u]Raven Guard[/u][/b]

● Moradus Squad: Change stats from 6/4 to 5/3
● Umbra Secundus: Description becomes "Deal 3 damage. The next Raven Guard troop you play gains Flank."

[b][u]Word Bearers[/u][/b]

● Boradol Squad: Gain "Backlash: Put in play a Signus Acolyte"
● Dagotal Bikes: Gain "Rally: A random enemy with Stealth loses it"
● Gorlem Squad: Description becomes "Rally: Put in play a Wounded Zealot. Relentless: Destroy a friendly Infantry and gain Daemonhost twice."
● Torgal Squad: Description becomes "Unstoppable. Battle Honour: Gain Daemonhost and heal 2"
● Ashen Circle: Increase Attack from 4 to 5
● Kurtha Sedd: Gain "Rally: Destroy a friendly Infantry and gain Survivor 2"
● Rongar Squad: Description becomes "Unstoppable. Sacrifice: Put in play two random 2-cost Cultists"
● Gallek Squad: Gain "Rally: Destroy a friendly Infantry and gain Ward"
● Bargotal Heavy Support: Ability becomes "(2) Deal 4 damage. If target dies, gain Daemonhost"
● Possessed Marine: Description becomes "Cleave 2. Rally: Gain Daemonhost"
● Dark Martyr: Increase Attack from 6 to 7
● Captain-Apostle: Increase Health from 7 to 8
● Kalim of the Annunake: Increase buff from Rally from +2/0 to +2/+2
● Sor Talgron: Increase stats from 7/7 to 8/8
● Testamentum Veritas: Increase cost from 1 to 2, and description becomes "Give +1/+1 to your Daemons. If you control no Daemons, put in play a Chaos Spawn"
● Heralds of Truth: Gain "Draw a card"
● Fanatical Zeal: Description becomes "Heal 3 to your units. If you control no troops, put in play a random 2-cost Cultist"
● Razing of Monarchia: Gain "Draw a card"

notes.title: White Scars Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/929accc18a413e5e2d701cb29b1eca731d01bf2c.jpg[/img]

[i]“We hunt united!”[/i]
– Jaghatai Khan, Primarch of the V Legion

The White Scars ride to war, the third and final faction in the Malevolence expansion. Laughing in the face of danger. The Horde of Jaghatai races into battle amidst a storm of bolter fire, jetbikes, speeders, and the unbridled thrill of the hunt.

[b][u]New faction: White Scars[/u][/b]
Renowned, respected, and feared across the galaxy for their speed and mobility and for their mastery of lightning fast strike actions and hit-and-run raids, they are a proud legion invested with strong traditions and a martial code. 

[b][u]White Scars Warlords:[/u][/b]
● [b]Jaghatai Khan[/b]: known as The Great Khan or The Warhawk, their stoic warrior-poet Primarch, known for his savage fierceness tempered by discipline.
● [b]Qin Xa[/b]: Master of the Keshig, most formidable warrior and master of the hunt from a young age.
● [b]Targutai Yesugei[/b]: Chief Stormseer and loyal advisor to the Great Khan.

[b][u]How to collect White Scars:[/u][/b]
● Each reward crate in the 'The Chondax Blockade' event has at least 1 White Scars card.
● The crates in the shop have at least 3 White Scars cards, 1 of them rare or better.
● A starter deck in the shop, with Targutai Yesugei as warlord and an exclusive card back.
● Cards for sale with gems in the Daily Shop.
● VIP subscribers will find 1 guaranteed White Scars card in their Daily Mission crate during the 'The Chondax Blockade' event.

[b][u]New Event: The Chondax Blockade[/u][/b]
The White Scars have been fighting in the Chondax system, unaware of the Horus Heresy. The Alpha Legion has set up a blockade to prevent them from returning to the wider conflict. Primitive and enlightened, savage and disciplined, the White Scars will let their swift action speak for them.

Are you ready to ride with the warriors of the V Legion?

Learn more on the official website:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/white-scars-released/

notes.title: Balance changes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/12f9a8a6c78f13216d9ec5b8e1b6e49cd672a499.jpg[/img]

[i]"Glory, in the Angel's name!"[/i]

Facing their greatest challenge, the Blood Angels rally to face the hordes of the Warp. Raldoron and Meros have received minor buffs. Elsewhere in the galaxy, the Raven Guard also sees some buffs, and a few other cards receive some balance changes.

[b][u]Neutral[/u][/b]
● Joker Company: Reduce attack from 5 to 4.
● Life Support: Description becomes 'Remove Poison from a friendly unit. If it is a Mechanicum troop, give it Survivor 1 as well'.
● Monster of Pythos: Reduce attack from 7 to 6 and change description to 'Rally: Gain Stealth until your next turn'.

[b][u]Blood Angels[/u][/b]
● Raldoron: Ability becomes '(1) Deal 1 damage. If target dies, give +1/+1 to adjacent units'.
● Meros: Ability becomes '(2) Heal 2 and remove Poison and Stun'.

[b][u]Raven Guard[/u][/b]
● Aloni Squad: Description becomes 'Rally: Deal 1 damage. If target dies, gain Stealth'.
● Moradus Squad: Description becomes 'Unstoppable. Rally: Give Sentenced 1 to an enemy this turn and deal 1 damage to it'.
● Kaedes Nex: Description becomes 'Stealth. While in play, the enemy warlord has Sentenced 1'.
● Inescapable cell: Now increases the cost of card returned to hand by 2 for one turn.
● Deliverance: Lower cost to 3 and description becomes 'Your units gain Stealth until your next turn and heal 2. Draw a card'.
● Blindside: Lower cost to 3 and description becomes 'Give Sneak Attack to a friendly unit this turn. Draw a card'.
● Guerrilla Warfare: Now deals 2-3 damage instead of 2.

[b][u]Orphans of War[/u][/b]
● Ulrach Branthan: Ability now buffs only adjacent troops, instead of all friendly troops.
● Dreadnought Interment: No longer grants Shield.

notes.title: Daemons of the Ruinstorm unleashed!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/047a22228be535f208c37d4a516432a0b1e97e87.jpg[/img]

[i]“I am Ka’Bandha, General of the First Host!”[/i]
-Ka’Bandha, Bloodthirster of Khorne

The die is cast. The trap is sprung. The Daemons of the Ruinstorm have been unleashed. Wash away the living in tides of blood and hellfire!

[b][u]New faction: Daemons of the Ruinstorm[/u][/b]
Called forth from the Warp by the suffering and death of countless billions, the Daemons of the Ruinstorm are the unnameable terrors beyond the veil of space. These forces of darkness will hurtle like a raging thunderbolt through the ranks of the living, ever twisting and changing to suit their violent temperament.

[b][u]Daemons of the Ruinstorm Warlords[/u][/b]
● Ka’Bandha: General of the Daemon Host of Signus and one of Khorne’s most feared servants.
● Cor’Bax Utterblight: A corpulent and bloated creature of Nurgle that spreads a tidal wave of rot and disease before him.
● Kyriss the Perverse: Mastermind of the Signus treachery, an androgynous manifestation of excess, pleasure and pain. 

[b][u]How to get Daemons of the Ruinstorm cards[/u][/b]
● Each reward crate in the 'Fear to Tread' event has at least 1 Daemons of the Ruinstorm card.
● Ruinstorm crates in the shop have at least 3 Daemons of the Ruinstorm cards, 1 of them rare of better.
● A constructed deck in the shop, with Kyriss as warlord and an exclusive card back. Any duplicates you receive are converted into gems.
● Cards for sale with gems in the Daily Shop.
● VIP subscribers will find 1 guaranteed Daemons of the Ruinstorm card in their Daily Mission crate during the 'Fear to Tread' event.

[b][u]New Event: Fear to Tread[/u][/b]
Following the Warmaster’s orders, Sanguinius takes his Legion to the Signus system. Lured by the promise of a cure to the Red Thirst that plagues his sons, Sanguinius finds instead the deadly trap set by the Daemons of the Ruinstorm.

As the foul creatures of the Immaterium are set loose upon the Galaxy, will you take command of them or try to stop their endless tides?

Learn more on the official website:
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/ruinstorm-released/

notes.title: Blood Angels released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/8ef8cdc13ceef68f0df0b891811345eafc544919.png[/img]

[i]"My Father's kingdom of reason will triumph!"[/i]
– Sanguinius, Primarch of the Blood Angels

The Blood Angels have arrived, as the first faction in the Malevolence expansion. Take control of the IX Legion and fly into battle!

[b][u]New Faction: Blood Angels[/u][/b]
Descending from the heavens on wings of fire, the IX Legion was the incarnation of the Emperor's wrath upon those who rejected the gift of Unity. Led by Sanguinius, the Great Angel, their tactical doctrines were heavily focused on the use of orbital drop operations and powerful shock assault. Recognising them as one of the greatest threats to his rebellion, Warmaster Horus would send them on an impossible mission to the distant Signus cluster, where a deadly trap awaited.

[u][b]Blood Angels warlords[/b][/u]
Three collectable Warlords lead the Silver Host as it sails to the Signus system:
● [b]Meros[/b]: Young apothecary of peerless loyalty, who would eventually sacrifice his soul to save his Primarch.
● [b]Raldoron[/b]: First Captain of the Blood Angels and Sanguinius' most trusted advisor. Renowned for his martial prowess and adaptable command style. 
● [b]Sanguinius[/b]: Primarch of the Blood Angels, the Great Angel, the Brightest One. Held in such high esteem by the other Primarchs that many expected him to be the one chosen as Warmaster.

[b][u]How to Get Blood Angels Cards[/u][/b]
You can collect the Blood Angels cards in several ways:
● Each reward crate in the 'War on the Nephilim' event has at least 1 Blood Angels card.
● Blood Angels crates in the shop have at least 3 Blood Angels cards, 1 of them rare of better.
● A constructed deck in the shop, with Meros as warlord and an exclusive card back. Any duplicates you receive are converted into gems.
● Cards for sale with gems in the Daily Shop.
● VIP subscribers will find 1 guaranteed Blood Angels card in their Daily Mission crate during the 'War on the Nephilim' event.

[b][u]New Event: 'War on the Nephilim'[/u][/b]
The first event of the Malevolence expansion introduces the Blood Angels during the time of the Great Crusade. The Blood Angels were dispatched to eradicate the Nephilim, a xenos race that fed on religious worship and was taking over the minds of countless human civilians. Confronted with brain-washed humans on Melchior, the Blood Angels had no choice but to fight them.

[b]The Blood Angels are now live. Fate awaits!
[/b]

notes.title: Orphans of War Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/af3d3a74e18791b71313adc2b480efd7e9161617.jpg[/img]

[i]"Oaths, brotherhood, loyalty... Lies!"[/i]
– Endryd Haar, Blackshield

 The Orphans of War have arrived, fighting for your their own goals and pledging no alliance to either Horus nor the Emperor. Are you ready to lead your warband?

[u][b]New Faction: Orphans of War[/b][/u]
The Heresy's brutality and far reach across the galaxy left many Space Marines stranded without a Primarch, a Legion or a cause to believe in, outside of the grand schemes of Horus or the Emperor. These Orphans of War became the galaxy's boogeymen: some fought the Legions on their own terms; others ruled over petty kingdoms; others became nothing more than pirates.

[b][u]New Event: 'Monsters and Martyrs'[/u][/b]
Isstvan III and V are but ash and Horus has set his plan in motion. In the  wake of his Heresy, both Loyalist and Traitors begin to find something new... Space Marines with no Legion, renegades, exiles and abandoned warriors who have formed warbands across the galaxy to fight for their own goals.

[u]Three collectable Warlords[/u] lead the sail the stars in their own desperate missions:

● [b]Atesh Tarsa[/b]: A survivor of Isstvan V and an apothecary who found a new home aboard the Iron Hands vessel Sisypheum. Cut off from his Legion, he now saves the lives of his new brothers in and out of combat.
● [b]Endryd Haar[/b]: A former World Eater who never got the Butcher's Nails. He massacred both Loyalists and Traitors on his way to Terra pursuing a personal quest to kill Horus himself. 
● [b]Ulrach Branthan[/b]: Captain of the Sisypheum, one of the few vessels that escaped Isstvan V. Branthan didn't escape the Drop Site Massacre without being fatally wounded, and only being bound to an ancient artefact called The Iron Heart was keeping him alive afterwards.

[b][u]How to Get Orphans of War Cards[/u][/b]
You can collect the Orphans of War faction's cards in several ways:
● Each reward crate in the 'Monsters and Martyrs' event has at least 1 Orphans of War card.
● Orphans of War crates in the shop have at least 3 Orphans of War cards, 1 of them rare of better.
● A constructed deck in the shop, with Atesh Tarsa as warlord and an exclusive card back. Any duplicates you receive are converted into gems.
● Cards for sale with gems in the Daily Shop.
● VIP subscribers will find  1 guaranteed Orphans of War card in their Daily Mission crate during the duration of the 'Monsters and Martyrs' event.

The Orphans of War are now live. Lead your own warband!

notes.title: Ultramarines Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/2aff57b3314938353978b892cdd87da9e18b5b98.jpg[/img]

[i]"Ours is the better way"[/i]
– Roboute Guilliman, Primarch of the Ultramarines, XIII Legion

The Horus Heresy: Legions continues its fourth major content expansion, The Battle of Calth. The Ultramarines come forward today with courage and honour. Are you ready to fight for the Imperium?

[b][u]New Legion: Ultramarines[/u][/b]
Hailing from the distant Five Hundred Worlds of Ultramar, the XIII Legion is the most numerous of the Legiones Astartes. They pride themselves in their martial discipline that looks not for mastery of any field, but for total adaptability to respond to changing situations.

[b][u]New Event: 'Betrayal at Calth'[/u][/b]
The Ultramarines muster at Calth by order of Horus, unaware of the impending betrayal by the Word Bearers, sent to cripple them so that they cannot join their Loyalist brothers in the fight against the Warmaster. Take part in one of the defining episodes of the Horus Heresy!

Three collectable Warlords lead the hosts of Ultramar in the bloody fight against the traitors:

● [b]Aeonid Thiel[/b]: Bearing a red helmet as a mark of Censure for running theoreticals on how to fight against Astartes, Sergeant Thiel's stratagems turned out to be crucial for the survival of the Legion during their first taste of betrayal.
● [b]Marius Gage[/b]: The First Chapter Master of the Ultramarines lost his hand to a Daemon during the opening attack on Calth. He would go on to command the Legion's flagship, The Macragge's Honour, into an epic pursuit in the warp.
● [b]Roboute Guilliman[/b]: The Primarch of the XIII Legion, one of the most loyal sons of the Emperor. His military prowess was matched by his superior statesmanship, with which he built the vast Real of Ultramar for the Imperium.

[u][b]New Trait: Courage[/b][/u]
The Ultramarines proved to be able to make a historic comeback at Calth. This has been distilled in a new trait, Courage: if the opponent controls more units than you when you play a card with Courage, it will trigger an additional effect to help you turn the tide of battle–– or at least, delay the inevitable making the traitors pay for it!

[u][b]How to get Ultramarines Cards[/b][/u]
You can collect the XIII Legion's cards in several ways:
● Each reward crate in the 'Betrayal at Calth' event has at least 1 Ultramarines card.
● Ultramarines crates in the shop have at least 3 Ultramarines cards, 1 of them rare of better.
● A constructed deck in the shop, with Aeonid Thiel as warlord and an exclusive card back. Any duplicates you receive are converted into gems.
● Cards for sale with gems in the Daily Shop.
● VIP subscribers will find 1 guaranteed Ultramarines card in their Daily Mission crate during the duration of the 'Betrayal at Calth' event.

The Ultramarines are now live. We march for Macragge!

notes.title: Word Bearers Legion Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/412f8a36a66de260ca39b40ff65a06428353350f.jpg[/img]

The Horus Heresy: Legions begins its fourth major content expansion, The Battle of Calth. The Word Bearers march to battle first. Are you ready to become a weapon of the Ruinous Powers?

[b][u]New Legion: Word Bearers[/u][/b]
Imbued by unshakeable faith in the Ruinous Powers, the XVII Legion has desecrated the Emperor's great design and allowed Daemons to possess their Space Marines. As they march for Calth, millions of fanatic cultists follow them to die fighting for their masters in battle or to become sacrifices for their unholy rituals.

Three collectable Warlords lead the masses of believers and warriors against the forces of the False Emperor:

● [b]Argel Tal[/b]: Lord of the Gal Vorbak, and host of the Daemon Raum, who possessed him during his pilgrimage into the Eye of Terror. Embittered by the horrors of the warp, he nonetheless serves the holy purpose of the Chaos gods.
● [b]Erebus[/b]: The self-proclaimed Hand of Destiny and architect of the Horus Heresy.  A worshiper of Chaos whose power and dark knowledge has grown so large he can summon Daemons into realspace... if enough blood is spilled.
● [b]Lorgar Aurelian[/b]: The Primarch of the XVII Legion believed the Emperor to be a god once, and was punished for it. Now he comes back, transfigured by the Primordial Truth and gifted by the Ruinous Powers with a new faith.

[b][u]New Trait: Daemonhost[/u][/b]
Troops bearing this trait receive a random buff out of a selection of five and add 'Daemon' to their unit type, becoming a hybrid troop– for better and for worse. Daemonhost buffs stack just like Marks of Chaos but, after receiving all five, your unit will get a unique 6th buff that makes it stronger with every further Daemonhost stack.

[b][u]How to Get Word Bearers Cards[/u][/b]
You can collect the XVII Legion's cards in several ways:
● Each reward crate in the 'The First Heretic' event has at least 1 Word Bearers card.
● Word Bearers crates in the shop have at least 3 Word Bearers cards, 1 of them rare of better.
● A constructed deck in the shop, with Argel Tal as warlord and an exclusive card back. Any duplicates you receive are converted into gems.
● Cards for sale with gems in the Daily Shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1edadbdd3de93c5ac8553e6f9447b38eba38d2af.jpg[/img]

The Word Bearers are now live. May the Primordial Truth reign supreme!

notes.title: Balance changes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/3e9001af6244ec873e1fe5fa766c51783d4dd497.jpg[/img]

[i]"How ironic..."[/i]
– Khalophis, possessing Canis Vertex

The balance changes are now live! In the face of Canis Vertex's overwhelming dominance, all Legions have stepped up their strategies to develop some ways of dealing with it. Check out the details!

Neutral:
- Canis Vertex initiative changed to 'Very Low'
- Veletaris' ability can now also hit Titan Weapons
- Missile Battery can now target non-Warlord enemies (including Titan Weapons)
- Krak Grenade now deals 5 damage to Vehicles, Structures and Titan Weapons, 2 to other units
- Aratan's effect becomes 'Stun a non-warlord enemy, and deal 2 damage to it for every enemy'
- Malcador’s Observer can now target non-Warlord enemies (including Titan Weapons)
- Telemoht's rally now stuns Vehicles, Structures and Titan Weapons
- Seek & Destroy can now target non-Warlord enemies (including Titan Weapons)
- Possess can now target any non-Warlord enemy (including Titan Weapons)

Sons of Horus:
- Abaddon's ability can now target any non-Warlord enemy (including Titan Weapons)

Iron Hands:
- Volkite Support: ability becomes 'Deal 5 damage to a Vehicle, Structure or Titan Weapon, or 2 to any other unit'
- Rapier Laser's ability can now target Titan Weapons
- The Hammer now deals damage to Titan Weapons as well
- The Storm now decreases only the cost of enemy troops, not all enemy cards.

Salamanders:
- Ancient Xavor's ability becomes 'Survivor 3. Has +3/0 while your opponent has more units' (instead of 'more troops')

Death Guard:
- Durak Rask's ability can now target damaged Titan Weapons

Night Lords:
- Mawdrym's Relentless ability now damages troops and Titan Weapons
- Night Scythes' Rally can now target only enemy troops (so that it is never forced to destroy a friendly troop).

Raven Guard:
- Dravian Klyde: while in play, gives Sentenced 3 to Vehicles and Titan Weapons

Iron Warriors:
- 5th Support Squad's ability now damages a random non-Warlord enemy (including Titan Weapons)
- Wrack & Ruin's effect becomes 'Deal 4 damage. If target is a Vehicle, Structure or Titan Weapon, deal 10 additional damage'

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/edf2577fa0ebd097755a6f3bfabdffe90f598d74.jpg[/img]

[i]"It is my duty to pass on what I've learned to others."[/i]
– Sanakht

Update v1.4.4 is out with some major improvements to how decks can be shared! You can now share them in the Lodge and Global chats, or copy them to your clipboard and share them anywhere, in a readable text format that can be automatically imported by other players.

How to share a deck:
1) In Cards, click the eye icon next to the deck's name to open the full-deck view.
2) The 'share' button on the top right corner offers three options: share to Lodge, to Global chat, or to clipboard.
3) Once copied to clipboard, you can paste the deck in a readable text format anywhere you like.
4) To import a deck, go to Cards -> Change deck, click on the notepad icon and paste the text.
5) You need to own the warlord to import a deck. Any cards not owned will be highlighted and need to be replaced.

Will you share your battle wisdom, or keep the secret to yourself?

The Emperor's Children get a round of tweaks in this round of balance changes. The endgame will become more dangerous for everyone as Melgator's threat gets reduced, while two unsung warlords, Darr and Mawdrym, get a rework and vie for a glorious comeback.

[u][b]Neutral:[/b][/u]
- Melgator: Ability becomes 'Rally: Return a troop with 4 or less Attack to its owner's hand'
- Skitarii Protector: Change stats from 5/5 to 4/5
- Fhorste Ogryns: Description becomes 'Front Line. Gain +1/0 when your Warlord is damaged' and change stats from 5/6 to 4/6
- Vultarax: Backlash now deals 3 damage to adjacent units, instead of 2
- Catacombs of Tizca: Can now only be played on troops

[b][u]Emperor's Children:[/u][/b]
- Fulgrim's Whispers: reduces cost by 1 when you trigger Perfection with any card, instead of only Tactics
- Eudicius Squad: Gain Flank and change stats from 6/4 to 5/4
- Sardaeron: Gain 'Perfection: Gain Shield'
- Eidolon: Gain 'Perfection: Stun the enemy warlord' and change stats from 9/9 to 9/8
- Discipline: Heal 2 for every enemy instead of 1

[u][b]World Eaters:[/b][/u]
- Shabran Darr: Gain 'Rage: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy'. Change Health from 35 to 30. Ability now also damages Titan parts adjacent to Warlord, not only troops

[u][b]Night Lords:[/b][/u]
- Flaymaster Mawdrym: Replace 'Start with an extra card' with 'Relentless: Deal 1 damage to damaged enemy troops' and increase Initiative from Low to Medium

notes.title: New event format: Canis Vertex Unleashed
notes.content:

[i]"I am the Lord of Hellfire!"[/i]
– Khalophis, possessing Canis Vertex

Khalophis binds his soul to Canis Vertex, an ancient Warlord Titan, to defend Tizca. However he succumbs to its immense power and is now attacking friend and foe alike. You must all band together and take him down. It's a Raid!

This new event differs from the standard format in several ways:

[u]1. PVE Boss Fight[/u]
● Canis Vertex will fight you at a number of fixed stages of every event run. Be careful, he gets stronger through the run! 
● You have only one chance to defeat Canis Vertex at every stage it appears. Losing will cost you a life and, if you still have some left, let you continue from the same stage fighting a regular player.
● Victories against Canis Vertex are added to a global milestones tally.

[u]2. Global Milestones[/u]
● Gather points defeating Canis Vertex  to reach milestones and unlock amazing new cosmetics and collectable warlords!
● All players contribute points for victories against Canis Vertex, even those who are not in a Lodge!
● Rewards will be unlocked for all players at the end of the event. Check out every icon in the milestones bar to check what's at stake!

[u]3. New content to unlock[/u]
● 100,000 points: Ordo Sinister badge
● 300,000 points: Prospero card back
● 750,000 points: Seneschal Prime Lucretia Elunnirai, Imperial Army warlord
● 1,500,000 points: Magus Prime Tacitus Proctor, Mechanicum warlord
● 2,500,000 points: Canis Vertex, Possessed Warlord Titan, Chaos warlord

Start playing now and defeat Canis Vertex before it destroys Tizca... and your rewards!

The devastation unleashed at Prospero is sending ripples through the Warp. Even those on far away locations are feeling the effects. This has brought about balance changes!

[b][u]Neutral:[/u][/b]
- Jubac Starsight: Changed stats 2/4 to 2/3
- Secutarii Axiarch: Changed stats 2/3 to 2/2
- Skitarii Protector: Changed stats 4/5 to 5/5
- Possess: Can now target any troop except Structures (instead of only Infantry or Astartes)

[b][u]Legio Custodes:[/u][/b]
- Valdor's Reckoning: Changed cost to 16, and cost reduction condition to '-1 Cost when your Warlord attacks and kills an enemy troop'

[b][u]Iron Hands:[/u][/b]

- Iron Father: Ability becomes 'Rally and Relentless: give +1/+1 to your other troops' (instead of only Iron Hands troops)
- Tarragon: Changed stats 6/9 to 7/9
- The Storm: Reduced cost from 2 to 1
- The Hammer: Ability becomes 'Draw a card. Deal damage to all enemy troops equal to the number of cards in your hand'.

[b][u]Thousand Sons:[/u][/b]
- Magnus: Ability now deals 1-2 damage (instead of 1-3)
- Magnus' Whispers of Chaos: Increased cost from 25 to 27
- Phosis T'kar: No longer starts with an extra card
- Meketre Cabal: Changed stats 3/2 to 3/3 and put in play only one Psychic Barrier
