notes.title: Update v1.3.8 Release notes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699872/2616406eced578dd121c6b6d74d12e2eb2d3aa18.jpg[/img]

This update prepares the ground for the upcoming Prospero expansion crates, including 20 new neutral cards, focused on the Mechanicum allies of the Thousand Sons. It also brings various improvements and bug fixes:
● The [b][u]20 new neutral cards[/u][/b] to complete the Burning of Prospero expansion will become available shortly before the end of the current event. 
● [b][u]Burning of Prospero expansion crates[/u][/b] will become available at the same time. They will cost 100 coins, and include the 20 new neutral cards as well as all cards from Space Wolves, Thousand Sons and Custodes
● [b][u]Secret Orders now apply to Custodes[/u][/b] troops, as well as Infantry and Astartes.
● [b][u]New keyboard shortcuts[/u][/b] to navigate menus. Even more shortcuts will be added in the future!
● There should be no more issues updating texts for cards and cosmetics.
● Bug fixes for auto-attack troops, and with Angron & Sevatar attack bonuses not always updating correctly.
● Refactored random algorithms to prevent some odd behaviour with Psychic Powers.
● Some interface improvements, particularly on the Profile menu.

The list of new [u][b]keyboard shortcuts[/b][/u] is as follows:
● Left / Right arrow keys to switch menus from main menu.
● Up / Down keys to switch between Friendly and Ranked modes on the main menu.
● Left / Right arrow keys to select Warlords and card backs.
● Left / Right Arrow keys to switch between All Cards / Your Cards in Collection.
● Arrow keys to choose deck.
● Enter key to search for a Battle; press again to cancel opponent search.
● Enter key to accept and close pop ups.
● Enter key to accept rewards and close reward pop ups.

notes.title: The Legio Custodes start their vigil!
notes.content:
[i]"In the name of the Emperor, death."[/i]
– Constantin Valdor, Captain-General of the Legio Custodes
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699872/2904e4c3f6101777b2ff83ebc39965a281ca91f1.jpg[/img]

For the first time, a non-Astartes Faction makes its debut! The Legio Custodes stands ready to defend Terra and beyond. Devoted to the Emperor with the full might and resources of the Imperium to support them, their duty only ends in death, and the Legiones Astartes will find they are facing a superior class of warrior that won't go down easily– or at all.

[b][u]New Faction: Legio Custodes[/u][/b]
The Legio Custodes has arrived! Led by Captain-General Constatin Valdor, a contingent of Emperor's Custodians has left Terra behind to censure the Thousand Sons in Prospero. The Legio Custodes showcases a balance between overwhelming power and their duty as the Emperor's last line of defence: First Strike allows a Custodes to avoid retaliation on killing blows when attacking, while troops with Sentinel bring high stats and powerful abilities but negate card draw at the start of your turn.

[u][b]New Event: Censure[/b][/u]
The Legio Custodes lands on Prospero to purge the sorcerous Thousand Sons in a new event: Censure. Play them both and witness the clash between the Emperor's Custodians and the Red Sorcerers! It's time to purge the foes of the the Imperium!

Three collectable Warlords are coming to join the Emperor's censure force first:

● [b]Arascid Nassau[/b]: A master of the Guardian Spear clad in black auramite, brought to Prospero from the depths of the Vaults of Rython below the Imperial Palace.
●[b] Vetranio Shapura[/b]: His untimely death while defending the Emperor during the Great Crusade earned Shapura the glory of being interred in a Contemptor-Galatus Dreadnought armour. 
● [b]Constantin Valdor[/b]: The First Custodian and Captain-General of the Legio Custodes. Rumoured to be as powerful as a Primarch and loyal to the Emperor since before the Imperium was born.

May the light of the Emperor blind their foes!

[b][u]How to Get Legio Custodes Cards[/u][/b]
You can collect the Emperor's Custodians in several ways:
● Each reward crate in the 'Censure' event has at least 1 Legio Custodes card.
● Legion crates in the shop have at least 3 Legio Custodes cards, 1 of them rare of better.
● A constructed deck in the shop, with Arascid Nassau. Any duplicates you receive are converted into gems.
● Cards for sale with gems in the Daily Shop.
● Daily Mission crates for VIP subscribers include 1 Legio Custodes card during the 'Censure' event.

The Legio Custodes is now live. Let the eternal vigil begin!

The most fan requested Legion is making an ominous entrance! The Thousand Sons are now live and ready to defy history in Prospero where their fate was sealed by the schemings of the Chaos gods and the folly of man. 

[u][b]New Legion: Thousand Sons[/b][/u]

The XV Legion features a heavy focus on their Psyker background, with a set of unique new mechanics to play in a whole new way: conjure psychic energy, overwhelm your opponents with powers that can be played multiple times per turn and use precognition to protect your units from attacks!

[b][u]New Event: Prospero Burns[/u][/b]
The Space Wolves make planetfall on Prospero and launch a massive offensive against the Thousand Sons in Tizca. Leman Russ seeks Magnus the Red in the City of Light as his Wolves tear it apart battling the Red Sorcerers. Choose your side and fight for who you think really did nothing wrong!

notes.title: Update v1.3.4 release notes
notes.content:
"Righteousness cannot be held at bay."
– Bulveye Greybeard, Jarl of the 13th Company

Update v1.3.4 is now available, with a few improvements and numerous fixes:

[b]New features:[/b]
● When challenging another player from the Friends menu, you can now choose to go first in case of both players having the same Initiative. This is designed to allow tournament matches to choose the starting order.
● Add 6 more deck slots.
● Add Lodge badges for Space Wolves, Thousand Sons and Custodes

[b]Gameplay fixes:[/b]
● Units ‘destroyed’ in combat (eg. with Urdrakule) will now trigger Battle Honour abilities (eg. from Lucius or Night Haunter).
● Dealing 0 damage (eg. with Void Engagement) will no longer trigger abilities that happen when a unit is damaged (eg. Ogryn Sergeant).
● When having two ‘Rhino 77/235’ in play, there is no longer a possibility of them trying to draw the same Astartes, and drawing only one card as a result in spite of having two or more available.
● Prevent random damage (eg. from Thorbrand Hunters) from being allocated to a troop already dying from a ‘destroy’ effect (eg. from Deathsworn Pack).
● Fix bug displaying icon for Unstoppable gained from Mark of Tzeentch.
● Fix some rare instances of Angron’s Attack bonus not being updated correctly.

[b]Other fixes:[/b]
● Fix bug that could cause a ranked victory not to get correctly recorded in rare instances.
● Fix bug on Collection not showing when there are new Space Wolves cards.

– Inscription on the Sagittarus.

For the first time, The Horus Heresy: Legions will expand its focus from Legiones Astartes to include a new faction: The Legio Custodes.

The Custodians, defenders of the Imperial Palace and the Emperor himself, were part of the Prospero offensive, and their individual might is superior to that of a Space Marine.

notes.title: Space Wolves release
notes.content:
The Space Wolves are landing today, May 10th! You will be able to obtain the new cards and warlords in several different ways:
[list]
[*] [b]Event prizes[/b]: take part in the new timed event, ‘The Night of the Wolf’! Not only will you be able to play as the Space Wolves in the event, you will also get at least one guaranteed Space Wolves card in each reward crate.
[*] [b]Legion crates[/b] in the shop, which provide 5 cards out of which at least 3 are Space Wolves, and at least 1 of them is Rare or better.
[*] A [b]constructed deck[/b] in the shop, featuring Ohthere Wyrdmake as warlord, an exclusive card back, and a full deck of 30 cards including 20 Space Wolves cards. If you already own any of the cards in the deck, any spare duplicates will be converted into gems as normal.
[*] Each day, there will be at least 1[b] card for sale in the Daily Shop[/b] which you can purchase using gems.
[*] For the duration of ‘The Night of the Wolf’ event, the improved [b]Daily Mission crates for VIP subscribers[/b] will also include at least 1 guaranteed Space Wolves card. 
[/list]

The Space Wolves will first become available in the shop two hours before the end of the current event and the start of ‘The Night of the Wolf’. The daily rotation will take place at that same time, two hours later than usual.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699872/3771642f5f05549db06d0cec7c380019784767e4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Prospero update - release notes
notes.content:
The Prospero expansion is about to begin, and it brings more than just new cards. Take a look at the new features and improvements included in the latest update, available to download now:

[b]Share Match Replays and Decks with your Lodge[/b]
A much requested feature is finally here! Use the new 'Share' button in the Battle Log to share replays in your Lodge chat.
In addition, you can now share decks with your Lodge, either to show your deck-building skills or to ask for advice. Use the eye icon from the Deck editing menu to see your full deck, and then the new 'share' button to send it to your Lodge chat. Please note that, if you make further changes to the deck after sharing it, other Lodge members who press the link will see the most up to date version.

[b]Improved Collection View[/b]
See which cards you own from each faction in a single view in your Collection, to make it easier to take a screenshot and share it when asking for deck-building advice. From your Collection, press the new list icon at the top right of the screen to activate this view.

[b]Warlord Chats in Collection[/b]
You can now listen to all Warlord chats from the Collection. Go to any Warlord and find the chat icon to listen to their 6 combat chats, even if you haven't collected them all yet.

[b]Improved Match Replays Controls[/b]
Review your match replays with improved controls: 
-> 'Pause' will now stop any actions queued from pressing the 'Next' button.
-> Advancing with 'Next' will now speed up some animations to move forward faster.

[b]Support for 4:3 screen ratio[/b] 
The game now supports an increased range of screen formats, in full screen or windowed mode, up to 4:3 screen ratio.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699872/2616406eced578dd121c6b6d74d12e2eb2d3aa18.jpg[/img]

notes.content:

– Lord Commander Thaddeus Fayle

As the May season gets underway, a few warlords have received changes to rebalance the competitive landscape:

notes.title: Minor update brings volume control and fixes
notes.content:
Listen to the cacophony of war! 
– Marius Vairosean, first Noise Marine

A minor update has been released with a number of fixes and improvements to make for a smoother experience while playing. You will find handling cards in your hand and in the deck menu easier, see more Lodges to join and be able set the volume for music and sound. Even more improvements will keep coming over time.

This update keep the version number at 1.3.1, to maintain cross-platform compatibility with mobile devices. Mobile players will get volume sliders in the next update.

Detailed changes:
● Add volume bars for music and sound effects.
● Synchronize all achievements with Steam, including those gained on mobile.
● Remember windowed/full screen mode between sessions.
● Improve handling of cards in hand.
● Add a few onboarding tips to Cards menu. 
● Remove special Alpha Legion sounds from troops in other legions.
● Fix error leaving card displayed when editing deck.
● Fix ‘Exit game’ popup not working on some menus.
● Fix text of tips in Russian not displayed correctly.
● Fix number of open lodges displayed in list.
● Fix selecting some lodge flags.
● Fix many other small under-the-hood issues.

notes.title: Seamless cross-platform play
notes.content:
The game will include seamless cross-platform play between desktop and mobile. Whether you want to play on your data-slate on the go, or from the comfort of your golden throne at home, it will always be time for Heresy. Veteran players will be able to carry over their progress on PC and back to mobile, while new players will find an established community to engage with on any device.
Read more about it on the [url=http://www.horusheresylegions.com/the-horus-heresy-legions-launches-on-pc/]Horus Heresy: Legions website[/url]
